+"""TypedDict contracts for domain models - Assistente Acadêmico.
+
+This module provides type-safe contracts for all domain data structures,
+enabling static type checking and improving maintainability.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import TypedDict, Optional, Literal
+try:
+    from typing import NotRequired
+except ImportError:
+    from typing_extensions import NotRequired
+from uuid import UUID
+
+
+# =============================================================================
+# Project Types
+# =============================================================================
+
+ProjectType = Literal["case", "paper_project", "paper_final"]
+ProjectPhase = Literal["report", "debate", "dissertation", "paper_project", "paper_final"]
+
+
+class ProjectFieldRules(TypedDict):
+    limit: int
+    required: NotRequired[bool]
+
+
+class ProjectFields(TypedDict):
+    """Base project fields that can appear in any project type."""
+    title: str
+    institution: str
+    course: str
+    city: str
+    assignment_prompt: str
+    # Case-specific fields
+    facts: str
+    problem: str
+    decision_basis: str
+    decision_a: str
+    decision_b: str
+    thesis_a_title: str
+    thesis_a: str
+    thesis_b_title: str
+    thesis_b: str
+    criteria: str
+    # Paper-specific fields
+    research_object: str
+    problem_context: str
+    hypothesis: str
+    objective_general: str
+    introduction: str
+    conclusion: str
+    abstract: str
+    keywords: str
+    development: str
+
+
+class CriterionDict(TypedDict):
+    id: str
+    title: str
+    definition: str
+    basis: str
+
+
+class DevelopmentSectionDict(TypedDict):
+    id: str
+    title: str
+    body: str
+
+
+class SourceDict(TypedDict):
+    id: str
+    title: str
+    author: str
+    kind: str
+    reference: str
+    notes: str
+
+
+class DeliveryDict(TypedDict):
+    delivered: bool
+    at: int
+
+
+class DeliveriesDict(TypedDict):
+    report: NotRequired[DeliveryDict]
+    dissertation: NotRequired[DeliveryDict]
+    paper_project: NotRequired[DeliveryDict]
+    paper_final: NotRequired[DeliveryDict]
+
+
+class WorkflowCheckDict(TypedDict):
+    """Dictionary of workflow check IDs to their completed state."""
+    pass
+
+
+class ProjectPayload(TypedDict):
+    """Complete project payload for autosave and API operations."""
+    version: int
+    fields: ProjectFields
+    source_ids: list[str]
+    criteria: list[CriterionDict]
+    schedule: dict
+    deliveries: DeliveriesDict
+    checks: WorkflowCheckDict
+    development_sections: list[DevelopmentSectionDict]
+
+
+# =============================================================================
+# AI Action Types
+# =============================================================================
+
+AIActionName = Literal[
+    "review", "chat", "checklist", "proposal_chat", "suggest_problem",
+    "suggest_theses", "case_structure", "research", "review_criteria",
+    "review_references", "review_development", "debate_coach"
+]
+
+SuggestionActionName = Literal[
+    "proposal_chat", "suggest_problem", "suggest_theses", "case_structure",
+    "review_criteria", "review_references", "review_development"
+]
+
+
+class AISuggestionItem(TypedDict):
+    field_id: str
+    text: str
+    declined: NotRequired[bool]
+    notice: NotRequired[str]
+
+
+class AIChecklistItem(TypedDict):
+    id: str
+    confidence: float
+    evidence: str
+
+
+class AIResponse(TypedDict):
+    answer: str
+    suggestions: list[AISuggestionItem]
+    rewrite: str
+    checklist: list[AIChecklistItem]
+
+
+class AIContext(TypedDict):
+    """Context sent to AI providers."""
+    action: AIActionName
+    message: str
+    instruction: str
+    messages: list[dict]
+    field_id: str
+    project_type: ProjectType
+    project_context: dict
+    source_ids: list[str]
+    development_ids: list[str]
+    criterion_ids: list[str]
+    checklist: list[dict]
+    evidence_fields: list[str]
+    selected_text: NotRequired[str]
+    search_web: NotRequired[bool]
+    assignment_prompt: str
+    title: str
+    case_facts: str
+    legal_question: str
+    conceptual_basis: str
+    possible_decision_a: str
+    possible_decision_b: str
+    thesis_a_title: str
+    thesis_a_argument: str
+    thesis_b_title: str
+    thesis_b_argument: str
+    criteria_and_values: str
+    research_object: str
+    problem_context: str
+    hypothesis: str
+    objective_general: str
+    introduction: str
+    conclusion: str
+    abstract: str
+    keywords: str
+    development: str
+    fields: dict
+    sources: NotRequired[list[SourceDict]]
+
+
+# =============================================================================
+# JEV Types
+# =============================================================================
+
+class JEVScoreAnswer(TypedDict):
+    score: int
+    confidence: float
+    probabilities: list[float]
+    observation: str
+
+
+class JEVCriterionResult(TypedDict):
+    id: str
+    label: str
+    score: int
+    confidence: float
+    probabilities: list[float]
+    observation: str
+
+
+class JEVSectionResult(TypedDict):
+    model: str
+    section: str
+    criteria: list[JEVCriterionResult]
+    probability_threshold: float
+    unassessed_checks: list[str]
+    usage: dict
+
+
+class JEVReportResult(TypedDict):
+    model: str
+    criteria: list[JEVCriterionResult]
+    expected_points: float
+    assessable_points: float
+    grade_range: dict
+    probability_threshold: float
+    unassessed_points: float
+    usage: dict
+
+
+class JEVValidationResult(TypedDict):
+    status: Literal["adequado", "revisar", "nao_avaliado"]
+    observations: list[str]
+    proposal_present: bool
+
+
+class JEVExplanation(TypedDict):
+    interpretation: str
+    evidence: list[str]
+    next_steps: list[str]
+    model: str
+    provider: str
+
+
+# =============================================================================
+# Provider Types
+# =============================================================================
+
+ProviderName = Literal["deepseek", "gemini", "jev"]
+
+class ProviderUsage(TypedDict):
+    prompt_tokens: int
+    completion_tokens: int
+    prompt_cache_hit_tokens: NotRequired[int]
+
+
+class ProviderResponse(TypedDict):
+    model: str
+    result: dict
+    usage: ProviderUsage
+    provider: ProviderName
+    fallback_reason: NotRequired[str]
+
+
+# =============================================================================
+# Research Catalog Types
+# =============================================================================
+
+CatalogKind = Literal["legislation", "case-law", "book"]
+
+class CatalogEntry(TypedDict):
+    id: str
+    kind: CatalogKind
+    title: str
+    reference: str
+    author: str
+    abstract: str
+    source_year: int
+    source: str
+    link: NotRequired[str]
+
+
+class CatalogSearchResult(TypedDict):
+    entries: list[CatalogEntry]
+
+
+# =============================================================================
+# Account/Sharing Types
+# =============================================================================
+
+class AccountProfile(TypedDict):
+    id: str
+    email: str
+    name: str
+    avatar_url: str
+    terms_accepted: bool
+    ai_consent: bool
+    sharing_allow_admin_view: bool
+    sharing_allow_admin_comments: bool
+    sharing_inherit_default: bool
+    deletion_request_pending: bool
+    ai_analysis_limit: int
+    deepseek_explanation_limit: int
+    project_credits: int
+    project_consumed: int
+
+
+class ProjectSharingPreferences(TypedDict):
+    allow_admin_view: bool
+    allow_admin_comments: bool
+    inherit_account_default: bool
+
+
+# =============================================================================
+# Rate Limiting Types
+# =============================================================================
+
+RateLimitAction = Literal[
+    "project_create", "ai_analysis", "ai_jev_section", "ai_jev_report",
+    "ai_jev_explanation", "legal_recommendations", "pdf_export", "duplicate"
+]
+
+class RateLimitInfo(TypedDict):
+    limit: int
+    window_seconds: int
+    current: int
+    remaining: int
+    reset_at: int
+\ No newline at end of file

+"""Roteiros acadêmicos, conferências e tópicos: dados puros, sem HTTP ou banco."""
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+from uuid import uuid4
+
+WORKFLOWS = json.loads(Path(__file__).with_name("academic-workflows.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+PHASE_LABELS = {"report": "Relatório", "debate": "Debate", "dissertation": "Dissertação", "paper_project": "Projeto de Paper", "paper_final": "Paper Final"}
+
+
+def workflow_sections(project_type):
+    return WORKFLOWS.get(project_type, WORKFLOWS["case"])
+
+
+def normalize_checks(raw, project_type):
+    allowed = {key for section in workflow_sections(project_type) for key, _ in section.get("checks", [])}
+    source = raw if isinstance(raw, dict) else {}
+    return {key: value is True for key, value in source.items() if key in allowed}
+
+
+def review_groups(sections, checks, phase):
+    """Agrupa as conferências da fase atual para a revisão final do roteiro."""
+    source = checks if isinstance(checks, dict) else {}
+    groups = []
+    for section in sections:
+        if section.get("phase") != phase or not section.get("checks"):
+            continue
+        items = [{"label": label, "done": bool(source.get(key))} for key, label in section["checks"]]
+        groups.append({
+            "title": section["title"],
+            "items": items,
+            "done": sum(item["done"] for item in items),
+            "total": len(items),
+        })
+    done = sum(group["done"] for group in groups)
+    total = sum(group["total"] for group in groups)
+    return {"groups": groups, "done": done, "total": total, "percent": round(done / total * 100) if total else 100}
+
+
+def normalize_deliveries(raw):
+    source = raw if isinstance(raw, dict) else {}
+    result = {}
+    for key in ("report", "dissertation", "paper_project", "paper_final"):
+        value = source.get(key)
+        if isinstance(value, dict) and value.get("delivered") is True:
+            result[key] = {"delivered": True, "at": int(value.get("at") or 0)}
+        elif value is True:
+            result[key] = {"delivered": True, "at": 0}
+    return result
+
+
+def normalize_development(raw):
+    if not isinstance(raw, list):
+        return []
+    rows = []
+    for item in raw[:20]:
+        if not isinstance(item, dict):
+            continue
+        title = str(item.get("title") or "").strip()[:240]
+        body = str(item.get("body") or "").strip()[:30000]
+        if title or body:
+            rows.append({"id": str(item.get("id") or uuid4())[:80], "title": title, "body": body})
+    return rows

+from flask import Blueprint, abort, jsonify, redirect, render_template, request, url_for
+
+from ..auth import current_account_id, login_required, require_csrf
+from ..store.accounts import (
+    accept_terms,
+    get_account,
+    update_profile,
+    get_account_sharing_preferences,
+    set_account_sharing_preferences,
+    get_effective_project_sharing,
+    request_self_deletion,
+    cancel_self_deletion,
+    confirm_self_deletion,
+    get_account_grants_summary,
+    export_account_data,
+)
+from ..store.projects import list_projects, get_project
+from ..store.sharing import get_sharing
+
+
+account_bp = Blueprint("account", __name__)
+
+
+@account_bp.get("/account/settings")
+@login_required
+def settings():
+    account = get_account(current_account_id())
+    if account is None:
+        abort(401)
+    return render_template("account/settings.html", account=account)
+
+
+@account_bp.post("/account/settings/profile")
+@login_required
+@require_csrf
+def save_profile():
+    account_id = current_account_id()
+    update_profile(
+        account_id,
+        {
+            "city": request.form.get("city"),
+            "disciplines": request.form.get("disciplines", "").splitlines(),
+            "teachers": request.form.get("teachers", "").splitlines(),
+            "institution": request.form.get("institution"),
+            "course": request.form.get("course"),
+            "discipline": request.form.get("discipline"),
+            "professor": request.form.get("professor"),
+        },
+        request.form.get("name", ""),
+    )
+    return redirect(url_for("account.settings", saved="profile"))
+
+
+@account_bp.post("/account/settings/terms")
+@login_required
+@require_csrf
+def save_terms():
+    if request.form.get("accept") != "on":
+        abort(400, description="É necessário aceitar os termos para continuar.")
+    try:
+        accept_terms(
+            current_account_id(),
+            request.form.get("accept") == "on",
+            request.form.get("ai_consent") == "on",
+        )
+    except ValueError as error:
+        abort(400, description=str(error))
+    return redirect(url_for("account.settings", saved="terms"))
+
+
+# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+# Sharing Preferences (Account Level + Inheritance)
+# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+@account_bp.get("/account/sharing")
+@login_required
+def sharing_preferences():
+    account_id = current_account_id()
+    prefs = get_account_sharing_preferences(account_id)
+    return jsonify({"ok": True, "preferences": prefs})
+
+
+@account_bp.post("/account/sharing")
+@login_required
+@require_csrf
+def save_sharing_preferences():
+    account_id = current_account_id()
+    body = request.get_json(silent=True) or {}
+    try:
+        prefs = set_account_sharing_preferences(account_id, body)
+    except ValueError as error:
+        return jsonify({"error": "invalid_sharing_preferences", "message": str(error)}), 400
+    return jsonify({"ok": True, "preferences": prefs})
+
+
+@account_bp.get("/account/projects/<project_id>/sharing/effective")
+@login_required
+def effective_project_sharing(project_id):
+    account_id = current_account_id()
+    project = get_project(account_id, project_id)
+    if project is None:
+        abort(404)
+    effective = get_effective_project_sharing(account_id, project_id)
+    project_sharing = get_sharing(account_id, project_id)
+    return jsonify({
+        "ok": True,
+        "effective": effective,
+        "project_override": project_sharing,
+    })
+
+
+# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+# Self Deletion (Auto-exclusão pelo próprio usuário)
+# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+@account_bp.post("/account/deletion/request")
+@login_required
+@require_csrf
+def request_deletion():
+    account_id = current_account_id()
+    try:
+        result = request_self_deletion(account_id)
+    except ValueError as error:
+        return jsonify({"error": "deletion_request_failed", "message": str(error)}), 400
+    return jsonify({"ok": True, **result})
+
+
+@account_bp.post("/account/deletion/cancel")
+@login_required
+@require_csrf
+def cancel_deletion():
+    account_id = current_account_id()
+    result = cancel_self_deletion(account_id)
+    return jsonify({"ok": True, **result})
+
+
+@account_bp.post("/account/deletion/confirm")
+@login_required
+@require_csrf
+def confirm_deletion():
+    account_id = current_account_id()
+    try:
+        result = confirm_self_deletion(account_id)
+    except ValueError as error:
+        return jsonify({"error": "deletion_failed", "message": str(error)}), 400
+    # A conta foi deletada - a sessão será invalidada
+    return jsonify({"ok": True, **result})
+
+
+# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+# Account Grants Summary
+# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+@account_bp.get("/account/grants")
+@login_required
+def account_grants():
+    account_id = current_account_id()
+    summary = get_account_grants_summary(account_id)
+    return jsonify({"ok": True, **summary})
+
+
+# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+# Account Data Export (LGPD/GDPR)
+# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+@account_bp.get("/account/export")
+@login_required
+def export_data():
+    account_id = current_account_id()
+    try:
+        data = export_account_data(account_id)
+    except ValueError as error:
+        return jsonify({"error": "export_failed", "message": str(error)}), 400
+    from flask import Response
+    return Response(
+        json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),
+        mimetype="application/json",
+        headers={
+            "Content-Disposition": f'attachment; filename="assistente-academico-export-{account_id}.json"',
+        },
+    )

+import json
+
+from flask import Blueprint, abort, jsonify, redirect, render_template, request, url_for
+
+from ..auth import admin_required, current_account_id, require_csrf
+from ..store.accounts import get_account
+from ..store.admin import (
+    AdminSchemaUnavailable,
+    AdminValidationError,
+    get_admin_account,
+    list_account_projects,
+    list_admin_accounts,
+    set_account_blocked,
+    set_account_plan,
+    set_project_credits,
+    global_usage,
+    operational_health,
+    set_account_limits,
+)
+from ..store.sharing import add_admin_comment, get_shared_project, list_comments, list_shared_projects
+
+
+admin_bp = Blueprint("admin", __name__, url_prefix="/admin")
+
+
+def _current_admin():
+    account = get_account(current_account_id())
+    if account is None:
+        abort(401)
+    return account
+
+
+def _schema_error(error):
+    abort(503, description=str(error))
+
+
+@admin_bp.get("/")
+@admin_required
+def index():
+    return redirect(url_for("admin.accounts"))
+
+
+@admin_bp.get("/dashboard")
+@admin_required
+def dashboard():
+    return render_template(
+        "admin/dashboard.html",
+        account=_current_admin(),
+    )
+
+
+@admin_bp.get("/accounts")
+@admin_required
+def accounts():
+    try:
+        managed_accounts = list_admin_accounts()
+    except AdminSchemaUnavailable as error:
+        _schema_error(error)
+    return render_template(
+        "admin/accounts.html",
+        account=_current_admin(),
+        managed_accounts=managed_accounts,
+    )
+
+
+@admin_bp.post("/accounts/<account_id>/plan")
+@admin_required
+@require_csrf
+def update_plan(account_id):
+    try:
+        updated = set_account_plan(account_id, request.form.get("plan_code", ""))
+    except AdminSchemaUnavailable as error:
+        _schema_error(error)
+    except AdminValidationError as error:
+        abort(400, description=str(error))
+    if updated is None:
+        abort(404)
+    return redirect(url_for("admin.accounts", saved="plan"))
+
+
+@admin_bp.post("/accounts/<account_id>/credits")
+@admin_bp.post("/accounts/<account_id>/project-credits")
+@admin_required
+@require_csrf
+def update_credits(account_id):
+    raw_remaining = request.form.get("project_remaining", "")
+    try:
+        remaining = int(raw_remaining)
+    except (TypeError, ValueError):
+        abort(400, description="Os créditos de projeto devem ser um número inteiro.")
+    try:
+        updated = set_project_credits(account_id, remaining)
+    except AdminSchemaUnavailable as error:
+        _schema_error(error)
+    except AdminValidationError as error:
+        abort(400, description=str(error))
+    if updated is None:
+        abort(404)
+    return redirect(url_for("admin.accounts", saved="credits"))
+
+
+@admin_bp.post("/accounts/<account_id>/block")
+@admin_required
+@require_csrf
+def update_block(account_id):
+    raw_blocked = request.form.get("blocked")
+    if raw_blocked not in {"0", "1"}:
+        abort(400, description="O estado de bloqueio é inválido.")
+    try:
+        updated = set_account_blocked(
+            account_id,
+            raw_blocked == "1",
+            actor_id=current_account_id(),
+        )
+    except AdminSchemaUnavailable as error:
+        _schema_error(error)
+    except AdminValidationError as error:
+        abort(400, description=str(error))
+    if updated is None:
+        abort(404)
+    return redirect(url_for("admin.accounts", saved="block"))

+    except AdminSchemaUnavailable as error:
+        _schema_error(error)
+    if managed_account is None or projects is None:
+        abort(404)
+    return render_template(
+        "admin/account_projects.html",
+        account=_current_admin(),
+        managed_account=managed_account,
+        projects=projects,
+    )
+

+@admin_bp.get("/projects")

+def projects():
+    return render_template(
+        "admin/projects.html",
+        account=_current_admin(),
+        projects=list_shared_projects(),
+    )
+
+
+def _mask_email(email: str) -> str:
+    """Mascarar email para LGPD - mostra apenas primeiro e último caractere do local-part."""
+    if not email or "@" not in email:
+        return email
+    local, domain = email.split("@", 1)
+    if len(local) <= 2:
+        masked_local = local[0] + "*" * (len(local) - 1)
+    else:
+        masked_local = local[0] + "*" * (len(local) - 2) + local[-1]
+    return f"{masked_local}@{domain}"
+
+
+@admin_bp.get("/projects/<project_id>")
+@admin_required
+def project(project_id):
+    row = get_shared_project(project_id)
+    if row is None:
+        abort(404)
+    payload = json.loads(row["payload"] or "{}")
+    payload.update({"id": row["id"], "project_type": row["project_type"], "title": row["title"], "revision": row["revision"]})
+    return render_template(
+        "admin/project.html",
+        account=_current_admin(),
+        project=payload,
+        owner_email=_mask_email(row["email"]),
+        allow_comments=bool(row["allow_admin_comments"]),
+        comments=list_comments(project_id) if bool(row["allow_admin_comments"]) else [],
+    )

+        abort(403)
+    return redirect(url_for("admin.project", project_id=project_id))

+import os

+)

+
+def _ai_account():
+    account = get_account(current_account_id())
+    if account is None:
+        abort(401)
+    if not account["terms_accepted"]:
+        return None, (jsonify({"error": "terms_required", "message": "Aceite os termos antes de usar a assistência."}), 403)
+    if not account["ai_consent"]:
+        return None, (jsonify({"error": "ai_consent_required", "message": "Autorize o uso de IA no perfil antes de pedir assistência."}), 403)
+    return account, None
+
+
+def _request_id(body: dict) -> str:
+    # SEMPRE gerar server-side; ignorar cliente para evitar colisão/DoS
+    normalized = normalize_request_id(str(uuid4()))
+    if normalized is None:
+        raise ValueError("request_id inválido")
+    return normalized
+
+
+def _deepseek_for_action():
+    return DeepSeekClient(
+        load_secret("DEEPSEEK_API_KEY", "DEEPSEEK_API_KEY_FILE", "/run/secrets/deepseek_api_key"),
+        api_url=os.environ.get("DEEPSEEK_API_URL", "https://api.deepseek.com/chat/completions"),
+        model=os.environ.get("DEEPSEEK_MODEL", "deepseek-chat"),
+        timeout=int(os.environ.get("DEEPSEEK_TIMEOUT", "30")),
+    )
+
+
+def _gemini_for_action():
+    return GeminiClient(
+        load_secret("GEMINI_API_KEY", "GEMINI_API_KEY_FILE", "/run/secrets/gemini_api_key"),
+        api_url=os.environ.get("GEMINI_API_URL", "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{model}:generateContent"),
+        model=os.environ.get("GEMINI_MODEL", "gemini-2.5-flash"),
+        timeout=int(os.environ.get("GEMINI_TIMEOUT", "30")),
+    )
+
+
+_FALLBACK_ERROR_CODES = {
+    "provider_busy",
+    "provider_unreachable",
+    "provider_auth",
+    "provider_quota",
+    "secret_unavailable",
+    "secret_invalid",
+    "invalid_response",
+    "response_too_large",
+}
+
+
+def _fallback_allowed(error):
+    return isinstance(error, ProviderError) and error.code in _FALLBACK_ERROR_CODES
+
+
+def _complete_with_fallback(messages, validator, max_tokens):
+    first_error = None
+    try:
+        client = _deepseek_for_action()
+        response = client.complete_json(messages, max_tokens=max_tokens)
+        validator(response.get("result"))
+        response["provider"] = "deepseek"
+        return response
+    except (ProviderError, OSError) as deepseek_error:
+        if isinstance(deepseek_error, ProviderError) and not _fallback_allowed(deepseek_error):
+            raise
+        first_error = deepseek_error if isinstance(deepseek_error, ProviderError) else ProviderError("provider_unreachable", "Não foi possível conectar ao DeepSeek.", 503, retryable=True)
+    except (ValueError, TypeError) as deepseek_error:
+        first_error = ProviderError("invalid_response", "A resposta DeepSeek não respeitou o contrato estruturado.", 502, retryable=True)
+    try:
+        client = _gemini_for_action()
+        response = client.complete_json(messages, max_tokens=max_tokens)
+        validator(response.get("result"))
+        response["provider"] = "gemini"
+        response["fallback_reason"] = first_error.code if first_error else "invalid_response"
+        return response
+    except (ValueError, TypeError) as error:
+        raise ProviderError("invalid_response", "DeepSeek e Gemini não respeitaram o contrato estruturado.", 502, retryable=True) from error
+    except ProviderError as error:
+        raise error from first_error
+
+
+def _complete_action(context):
+    return _complete_with_fallback(
+        action_messages(context),
+        lambda result: validate_action_result(result, context),
+        int(os.environ.get("PROJECT_AI_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS", "2200")),
+    )
+
+
+def _jev_analysis(project, section=None):
+    key = load_secret("TYPESAFE_API_KEY", "TYPESAFE_API_KEY_FILE", "/run/secrets/typesafe_api_key")
+    client = JevClient(
+        key,
+        api_url=os.environ.get("TYPESAFE_API_URL", "https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone"),
+        model=os.environ.get("TYPESAFE_MODEL", "jev-latest"),
+        timeout=int(os.environ.get("JEV_TIMEOUT", "60")),
+    )
+    raw = client.score(jev_state(project), jev_questions(section))
+    return normalize_jev_result(raw, section), raw
+

+@ai_bp.post("/projects/<project_id>/ai/action")
+@login_required
+@require_csrf
+def action(project_id):
+    account, error_response = _ai_account()
+    if error_response:
+        return error_response
+    project = get_project(current_account_id(), project_id)
+    if project is None:
+        abort(404)
+    body = request.get_json(silent=True) or {}
+    action_name = body.get("action")
+    if action_name not in PROJECT_AI_ACTIONS or action_name == "research":
+        return jsonify({"error": "invalid_ai_action", "message": "Ação de assistência inválida."}), 400
+    if action_name == "debate_coach" and project.get("project_type") != "case":
+        return jsonify({"error": "invalid_ai_action", "message": "O apoio ao debate só existe no Case."}), 400
+    if action_name == "review" and body.get("field_id") not in ALLOWED_FIELDS:
+        return jsonify({"error": "invalid_ai_request", "message": "Campo não permitido."}), 400
+    try:
+        request_id = _request_id(body)
+        if body.get("project_revision") is not None and int(body["project_revision"]) != int(project["revision"]):
+            return jsonify({"error": "stale_project_revision", "revision": project["revision"]}), 409
+        context = action_context(project, action_name, body, sources=list_sources(current_account_id()))
+        reserve_usage(current_account_id(), project_id, request_id, action_name)
+        provider_response = _complete_action(context)
+        result = validate_action_result(provider_response.get("result"), context)
+        result.update({"action": action_name, "model": provider_response.get("model", ""), "provider": provider_response.get("provider", "deepseek")})
+        if provider_response.get("fallback_reason"):
+            result["fallback_reason"] = provider_response["fallback_reason"]
+        record_provider_usage(request_id, result["provider"], f"assistant:{action_name}", result["model"] or "unknown", "complete", provider_response.get("usage"))
+        if action_name in SUGGESTION_ACTIONS and result["suggestions"]:
+            try:
+                jev_key = load_secret("TYPESAFE_API_KEY", "TYPESAFE_API_KEY_FILE", "/run/secrets/typesafe_api_key")
+                jev_client = JevClient(jev_key, api_url=os.environ.get("TYPESAFE_API_URL", "https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone"), model=os.environ.get("TYPESAFE_MODEL", "jev-latest"), timeout=int(os.environ.get("JEV_TIMEOUT", "60")))
+                suggestion_state = legacy_state(project, sources=list_sources(current_account_id()))
+                suggestion_state["action"] = action_name
+                suggestion_state["suggestion"] = result["answer"]
+                jev_raw = jev_client.score(suggestion_state, {
+                    criterion_id: {"type": "score", "instructions": title, "criteria": ["0", "1", "2", "3"]}
+                    for criterion_id, title in JEV_SUGGESTION_CRITERIA[action_name]
+                })
+                result["validation"] = normalized_jev_suggestion(action_name, context, jev_raw)
+                record_provider_usage(request_id, "jev", f"suggestion:{action_name}", jev_raw.get("model", "jev-latest"), "complete", jev_raw.get("usage"))
+            except ProviderError:
+                result["validation"] = {"status": "nao_avaliado", "observations": ["O JEV não está disponível agora; confira a sugestão manualmente."], "proposal_present": bool(context.get("assignment_prompt"))}
+        finish_usage(request_id)
+        return jsonify({"ok": True, "request_id": request_id, "response": result})
+    except UsageError as error:
+        return jsonify({"error": error.code, "message": str(error)}), error.status
+    except (ValueError, TypeError) as error:
+        try:
+            refund_usage(request_id)
+        except Exception:
+            pass
+        return jsonify({"error": "invalid_ai_request", "message": str(error)}), 400
+    except ProviderError as error:
+        try:
+            refund_usage(request_id)
+        except Exception:
+            pass
+        return jsonify({"error": error.code, "message": str(error)}), error.status
+
+

+@ai_bp.post("/projects/<project_id>/ai/jev-explanation")
+@login_required
+@require_csrf
+def jev_explanation(project_id):

+    if not isinstance(criterion, str) or (criterion not in field_map and criterion not in checklist_ids):

+    try:

+        provider_response = _complete_action(context)

+            "next_steps": [item["text"] for item in result.get("suggestions", [])][:2],
+            "model": provider_response.get("model", ""),
+            "provider": provider_response.get("provider", "deepseek"),

+        finish_usage(request_id)

+    if not account["ai_consent"]:

+    project = get_project(current_account_id(), project_id)

+    try:

+    if payload["project_revision"] != project["revision"]:
+        return jsonify({"error": "stale_project_revision", "revision": project["revision"]}), 409
+    try:
+        if payload["catalog_source_ids"]:
+            candidates = entries_by_ids(payload["catalog_source_ids"])
+            if len(candidates) != len(payload["catalog_source_ids"]):
+                return jsonify({"error": "invalid_catalog_source", "message": "Uma fonte não pertence ao catálogo disponível."}), 400
+        else:
+            query = " ".join([payload["problem_question"], *payload["keywords"]]).strip()
+            candidates = []
+            for kind in ("legislation", "case-law", "book"):
+                candidates.extend(search_catalog(query, kind=kind, limit=8)["entries"])
+    except ResearchUnavailable:
+        return jsonify({"error": "catalog_unavailable", "message": "O catálogo jurídico não está disponível no momento."}), 503
+    if not candidates:
+        return jsonify({
+            "ok": True,
+            "request_id": payload["request_id"],
+            "provider": {"name": "none", "model": "", "fallback_used": False, "fallback_reason": None},
+            "recommendations": {"law": [], "jurisprudence": [], "doctrine": []},
+            "coverage": {"candidate_count": 0, "by_kind": {"legislation": 0, "case-law": 0, "book": 0}, "scope": "catálogo jurídico local; pista inicial"},
+            "warnings": ["Nenhum candidato foi encontrado neste recorte do catálogo."],
+        })
+    try:
+        reserve_usage(current_account_id(), project_id, payload["request_id"], "legal_recommendations")
+    except UsageError as error:
+        return jsonify({"error": error.code, "message": str(error)}), error.status
+
+    def record(provider, model, status, usage):
+        record_provider_usage(payload["request_id"], provider, "legal_recommendations", model or "unknown", status, usage)
+
+    try:
+        result = recommend(
+            payload,
+            project,
+            candidates,
+            deepseek_factory=lambda: DeepSeekClient(
+                load_secret("DEEPSEEK_API_KEY", "DEEPSEEK_API_KEY_FILE", "/run/secrets/deepseek_api_key"),
+                api_url=os.environ.get("DEEPSEEK_API_URL", "https://api.deepseek.com/chat/completions"),
+                model=os.environ.get("DEEPSEEK_MODEL", "deepseek-chat"),
+                timeout=int(os.environ.get("DEEPSEEK_TIMEOUT", "30")),
+            ),
+            gemini_factory=lambda: GeminiClient(
+                load_secret("GEMINI_API_KEY", "GEMINI_API_KEY_FILE", "/run/secrets/gemini_api_key"),
+                api_url=os.environ.get("GEMINI_API_URL", "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{model}:generateContent"),
+                model=os.environ.get("GEMINI_MODEL", "gemini-2.5-flash"),
+                timeout=int(os.environ.get("GEMINI_TIMEOUT", "30")),
+            ),
+            record_attempt=record,
+        )
+        finish_usage(payload["request_id"])
+        return jsonify({"ok": True, "request_id": payload["request_id"], **result})
+    except ProviderError as error:
+        refund_usage(payload["request_id"])
+        return jsonify({"error": error.code, "message": str(error)}), error.status
+
+
+@ai_bp.post("/projects/<project_id>/ai/legal-recommendations/attach")
+@login_required
+@require_csrf
+def attach_catalog_source(project_id):
+    if get_project(current_account_id(), project_id) is None:
+        abort(404)
+    body = request.get_json(silent=True) or {}
+    source_id = body.get("source_id")
+    if not isinstance(source_id, str) or not source_id.strip():
+        return jsonify({"error": "invalid_catalog_source"}), 400
+    try:
+        entries = entries_by_ids([source_id])
+    except ResearchUnavailable:
+        return jsonify({"error": "catalog_unavailable", "message": "O catálogo jurídico não está disponível no momento."}), 503
+    if not entries:
+        return jsonify({"error": "invalid_catalog_source"}), 404
+    entry = entries[0]
+    kind = {"case-law": "case_law", "legislation": "legislation", "book": "book"}.get(entry.get("kind"), "other")
+    reference = entry.get("reference") or entry.get("source") or ""
+    notes = "Fonte adicionada a partir do catálogo jurídico. Confira os dados antes de citar."
+    if entry.get("link"):
+        notes += " Origem: " + entry["link"]
+    personal_id = create_source(current_account_id(), entry.get("title", "Fonte jurídica"), entry.get("author", ""), kind, reference, notes)
+    return jsonify({"ok": True, "source_id": personal_id, "title": entry.get("title", "Fonte jurídica"), "author": entry.get("author", ""), "reference": reference})
diff --git a/app/routes/auth.py b/app/routes/auth.py
@@ -0,0 +1,47 @@
+from uuid import uuid4
+
+from flask import Blueprint, abort, current_app, redirect, request, session, url_for
+
+from ..auth import csrf_token, require_csrf
+from ..store.db import get_db
+
+
+auth_bp = Blueprint("auth", __name__, url_prefix="/auth")
+
+
+@auth_bp.post("/dev-login")
+def dev_login():
+    if not current_app.config["ALLOW_DEV_AUTH"]:
+        abort(404)
+    email = (request.form.get("email") or "dev@example.test").strip().lower()[:240]
+    name = (request.form.get("name") or "Conta de teste").strip()[:160]
+    account_id = get_db().execute("SELECT id FROM accounts WHERE email = ?", (email,)).fetchone()
+    if account_id is None:
+        account_id = str(uuid4())
+        if current_app.testing:
+            get_db().execute(
+                "INSERT INTO accounts (id, email, name, project_limit, ai_limit, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 100, 100, strftime('%s','now'))",
+                (account_id, email, name),
+            )
+        else:
+            get_db().execute(
+                "INSERT INTO accounts (id, email, name, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, strftime('%s','now'))",
+                (account_id, email, name),
+            )
+        get_db().commit()
+    resolved_account_id = account_id if isinstance(account_id, str) else account_id["id"]
+    from ..store.accounts import get_account
+    if get_account(resolved_account_id).get("is_blocked"):
+        session.clear()
+        abort(403, description="Esta conta está impedida de acessar o sistema.")
+    session.clear()
+    session["account_id"] = resolved_account_id
+    csrf_token()
+    return redirect(url_for("projects.account"))
+
+
+@auth_bp.post("/logout")
+@require_csrf
+def logout():
+    session.clear()
+    return redirect(url_for("public.home"))

+from flask import Blueprint, Response, abort, request
+
+from ..auth import current_account_id, login_required
+from ..services.export import ExportUnavailable, build_project_html, render_pdf
+from ..store.projects import get_project
+from ..store.sources import list_sources
+
+
+export_bp = Blueprint("export", __name__)
+
+
+@export_bp.get("/projects/<project_id>/export")
+@login_required
+def project_export(project_id):
+    project = get_project(current_account_id(), project_id)
+    if project is None:
+        abort(404)
+    if project['project_type'] == 'case':
+        phase = request.args.get('phase', 'report')
+        if phase not in {'report', 'debate', 'dissertation'}:
+            abort(400, description='Documento inválido.')
+        project['export_phase'] = phase
+    source_ids = set(project.get("source_ids", []))
+    sources = [source for source in list_sources(current_account_id()) if source["id"] in source_ids]
+    export_format = request.args.get("format", "html")
+    if export_format == "html":
+        return Response(build_project_html(project, sources), mimetype="text/html")
+    if export_format == "pdf":
+        try:
+            pdf = render_pdf(project, sources)
+        except ExportUnavailable as error:
+            abort(503, description=str(error))
+        except Exception:
+            abort(503, description="Não foi possível gerar o PDF neste momento.")
+        return Response(pdf, mimetype="application/pdf", headers={"Content-Disposition": "attachment; filename=assistente-academico.pdf"})
+    abort(400, description="Formato de exportação inválido.")

diff --git a/app/routes/oauth.py b/app/routes/oauth.py
@@ -0,0 +1,71 @@
+import secrets
+
+from flask import Blueprint, current_app, redirect, request, session, url_for
+
+from ..auth import csrf_token
+from ..services.google_oauth import (
+    GoogleOAuthClient,
+    GoogleOAuthConfig,
+    GoogleOAuthError,
+    new_code_verifier,
+    new_nonce,
+    new_state,
+)
+from ..store.accounts import upsert_google_account
+
+
+oauth_bp = Blueprint("oauth", __name__)
+
+
+def _client():
+    return GoogleOAuthClient(GoogleOAuthConfig.from_mapping(current_app.config))
+
+
+@oauth_bp.get("/oauth/google/start")
+def google_start():
+    client = _client()
+    if not client.config.configured:
+        return redirect(url_for("public.home", google_login="unconfigured"))
+    state = new_state()
+    nonce = new_nonce()
+    code_verifier = new_code_verifier()
+    session["google_oauth"] = {"state": state, "nonce": nonce, "code_verifier": code_verifier}
+    try:
+        location = client.authorization_url(state, nonce, code_verifier)
+    except GoogleOAuthError as error:
+        current_app.logger.warning("google_oauth_start_failed code=%s", str(error))
+        session.pop("google_oauth", None)
+        return redirect(url_for("public.home", google_login="failed"))
+    return redirect(location)
+
+
+@oauth_bp.get("/oauth/google/callback")
+def google_callback():
+    flow = session.pop("google_oauth", None)
+    state = request.args.get("state", "")
+    code = request.args.get("code", "")
+    if (
+        not isinstance(flow, dict)
+        or not isinstance(state, str)
+        or not state
+        or not secrets.compare_digest(state, str(flow.get("state", "")))
+        or request.args.get("error")
+        or not isinstance(code, str)
+        or not code
+        or len(code) > 2048
+    ):
+        return redirect(url_for("public.home", google_login="failed"))
+    try:
+        claims = _client().exchange_code(code, str(flow["code_verifier"]), str(flow["nonce"]))
+        account_id = upsert_google_account(claims)
+        from ..store.accounts import get_account
+        if get_account(account_id).get("is_blocked"):
+            raise GoogleOAuthError("account_blocked")
+    except (GoogleOAuthError, KeyError, TypeError, ValueError) as error:
+        code = str(error) if isinstance(error, GoogleOAuthError) else type(error).__name__
+        current_app.logger.warning("google_oauth_callback_failed code=%s", code)
+        return redirect(url_for("public.home", google_login="failed"))
+    session.clear()
+    session["account_id"] = account_id
+    csrf_token()
+    return redirect(url_for("projects.account"))

@@ -0,0 +1,412 @@
+from ..services.assistant import ALLOWED_FIELDS
+import json
+from copy import deepcopy
+
+from flask import Blueprint, abort, jsonify, redirect, render_template, request, url_for
+
+from ..auth import current_account_id, login_required, require_csrf
+from ..domain.case import case_progress, case_sections, normalize_case_fields, normalize_criteria
+from ..domain.paper import normalize_paper_fields, paper_progress, paper_sections
+from ..domain.workflow import PHASE_LABELS, normalize_checks, normalize_deliveries, normalize_development, review_groups
+from ..domain.schedule import account_calendar, normalize_schedule, schedule_summary, schedule_templates
+import json
+import time
+from uuid import uuid4
+
+from ..store.accounts import get_account
+from ..store.projects import ProjectConflict, ProjectQuotaError, create_project, delete_project, get_project, list_edit_activity, list_projects, save_project
+from ..store.sharing import get_sharing, list_comments, save_sharing
+from ..store.sources import SOURCE_KINDS, create_source as create_library_source, list_sources, owned_source_ids
+from ..store.revisions import create_revision, list_revisions, get_revision, diff_revisions, restore_revision
+from ..services.quarto_documents import render_document_pdf, QuartoUnavailableError, QuartoBusyError, QuartoRenderError, QuartoDocumentError
+
+
+projects_bp = Blueprint("projects", __name__)
+
+
+@projects_bp.get("/account")
+@login_required
+def account():
+    projects = list_projects(current_account_id())
+    from datetime import date
+    today = date.today()
+    start = today.replace(day=1).isoformat()
+    end = date(today.year + (today.month == 12), 1 if today.month == 12 else today.month + 1, 1).isoformat()
+    return render_template(
+        "account/home.html",
+        account=get_account(current_account_id()),
+        projects=projects,
+        account_calendar=account_calendar(projects, list_edit_activity(current_account_id(), start, end)),
+    )
+
+
+@projects_bp.post("/projects")
+@login_required
+@require_csrf
+def create():
+    account = get_account(current_account_id())
+    if account is None:
+        abort(401)
+    if not account["terms_accepted"]:
+        return redirect(url_for("account.settings", required="terms"))
+    project_type = request.form.get("project_type", "case")
+    if project_type not in {"case", "paper_project", "paper_final"}:
+        abort(400, description="Tipo de projeto inválido.")
+    try:
+        project_id = create_project(current_account_id(), project_type)
+    except ProjectQuotaError:
+        return redirect(url_for("projects.account", error="project_quota"))
+    return redirect(url_for("projects.editor", project_id=project_id))
+
+
+@projects_bp.post("/projects/<project_id>/delete")
+@login_required
+@require_csrf
+def delete(project_id):
+    if not delete_project(current_account_id(), project_id):
+        abort(404)
+    return redirect(url_for("projects.account", deleted="1"))
+
+
+@projects_bp.get("/projects/<project_id>")
+@login_required
+def editor(project_id):
+    project = get_project(current_account_id(), project_id)
+    if project is None:
+        abort(404)
+    project["schedule"] = normalize_schedule(
+        project.get("schedule"),
+        project.get("fields", {}).get("deliveryDate", ""),
+        project["project_type"],
+    )
+    project["source_ids"] = project.get("source_ids", [])
+    project["criteria"] = normalize_criteria(project.get("criteria", []))
+    project["checks"] = normalize_checks(project.get("checks"), project["project_type"])
+    project["deliveries"] = normalize_deliveries(project.get("deliveries"))
+    project["development_sections"] = normalize_development(project.get("development_sections"))
+    if not project["development_sections"]:
+        previous = project.get("fields", {}).get("dissertation_foundation") or project.get("fields", {}).get("development")
+        if previous:
+            project["development_sections"] = [{"id": "existing", "title": "Fundamentação", "body": previous}]
+    is_case = project["project_type"] == "case"
+    is_paper = project["project_type"] in {"paper_project", "paper_final"}
+    sections = deepcopy(case_sections() if is_case else paper_sections(project["project_type"]))
+    review_phase = "report" if is_case else project["project_type"]
+    review_summaries = {
+        phase: review_groups(sections, project["checks"], phase)
+        for phase in {item.get("phase") for item in sections}
+    }
+    profile = (get_account(current_account_id()) or {}).get("profile", {})
+    for section in sections:
+        for field in section["fields"]:
+            if field.get("source"):
+                values = list(profile.get(field["source"], []))
+                current = project.get("fields", {}).get(field["id"], "")
+                if current and current not in values:
+                    values.append(current)
+                field["type"] = "select"
+                field["options"] = [["", "Selecione…"]] + [[value, value] for value in values]
+                field["hint"] = "Cadastre suas opções em Meu perfil. Alterar o perfil não muda este trabalho."
+    return render_template(
+        "projects/editor.html",
+        project=project,
+        sources=list_sources(current_account_id()),
+        case_sections=sections if is_case else [],
+        case_progress=case_progress(project.get("fields", {})) if is_case else None,
+        paper_sections=sections if is_paper else [],
+        paper_progress=paper_progress(project.get("fields", {}), project["project_type"]) if is_paper else None,
+        review_summary=review_summaries.get(review_phase, {"groups": [], "done": 0, "total": 0, "percent": 100}),
+        review_summaries=review_summaries,
+        schedule_summary=schedule_summary(project["schedule"], project["project_type"]),
+        schedule_templates=schedule_templates(project["project_type"]),
+        sharing=get_sharing(current_account_id(), project_id),
+        comments=list_comments(project_id),
+        ai_allowed_fields=ALLOWED_FIELDS,
+        phase_labels=PHASE_LABELS,
+    )
+
+
+@projects_bp.post("/projects/<project_id>/save")
+@login_required
+@require_csrf
+def save(project_id):
+    body = request.get_json(silent=True) or {}
+    current_project = get_project(current_account_id(), project_id)
+    if current_project is None:
+        abort(404)
+    try:
+        revision = int(body.get("revision"))
+    except (TypeError, ValueError):
+        abort(400, description="Revisão inválida.")
+    payload = body.get("payload")
+    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
+        abort(400, description="Projeto inválido.")
+    fields = payload.get("fields") if isinstance(payload.get("fields"), dict) else {}
+    fields = current_project.get("fields", {}) | fields
+    if current_project["project_type"] == "case":
+        normalized_fields = normalize_case_fields(fields)
+    elif current_project["project_type"] in {"paper_project", "paper_final"}:
+        normalized_fields = normalize_paper_fields(fields, current_project["project_type"])
+    else:
+        normalized_fields = {"title": str(fields.get("title") or "")[:240]}
+    requested_project_source_ids = payload.get("source_ids") if isinstance(payload.get("source_ids"), list) else []
+    valid_project_source_ids = owned_source_ids(current_account_id(), requested_project_source_ids)
+    project_source_ids = [source_id for source_id in requested_project_source_ids if source_id in valid_project_source_ids]
+    criteria = normalize_criteria(payload.get("criteria")) if current_project["project_type"] == "case" else []
+    schedule = normalize_schedule(
+        payload.get("schedule"),
+        normalized_fields.get("deliveryDate", ""),
+        current_project["project_type"],
+    )
+    payload = {
+        "version": 1,
+        "fields": normalized_fields,
+        "checks": normalize_checks(payload.get("checks"), current_project["project_type"]),
+        "deliveries": normalize_deliveries(payload.get("deliveries")),
+        "development_sections": normalize_development(payload.get("development_sections")),
+        "source_ids": project_source_ids,
+        "criteria": criteria,
+        "schedule": schedule,
+    }
+    try:
+        next_revision = save_project(current_account_id(), project_id, revision, payload)
+    except ProjectConflict as error:
+        return jsonify({"error": "project_conflict", "revision": error.current_revision}), 409
+    if next_revision is None:
+        abort(404)
+    return jsonify({"ok": True, "revision": next_revision})
+
+
+@projects_bp.post("/projects/<project_id>/sources")
+@login_required
+@require_csrf
+def create_source(project_id):
+    if get_project(current_account_id(), project_id) is None:
+        abort(404)
+    body = request.get_json(silent=True) or {}
+    title = str(body.get("title") or "").strip()
+    if not title:
+        return jsonify({"error": "invalid_source", "message": "Informe o título da fonte."}), 400
+    kind = str(body.get("kind") or "other")
+    source_id = create_library_source(
+        current_account_id(),
+        title,
+        body.get("author", ""),
+        kind if kind in SOURCE_KINDS else "other",
+        body.get("reference", ""),
+        body.get("notes", ""),
+    )
+    source = next(item for item in list_sources(current_account_id()) if item["id"] == source_id)
+    return jsonify({"ok": True, "source": source})
+
+
+@projects_bp.post("/projects/<project_id>/sharing")
+@login_required
+@require_csrf
+def update_sharing(project_id):
+    sharing = save_sharing(current_account_id(), project_id, request.form.get("allow_admin_view") == "on", request.form.get("allow_admin_comments") == "on")
+    if sharing is None:
+        abort(404)
+    return redirect(url_for("projects.editor", project_id=project_id, saved="sharing"))
+
+
+@projects_bp.post("/projects/<project_id>/paper-mode")
+@login_required
+@require_csrf
+def paper_mode(project_id):
+    from ..store.projects import switch_paper_mode
+    body = request.get_json(silent=True) or {}
+    try:
+        revision = int(body.get("revision"))
+        updated = switch_paper_mode(current_account_id(), project_id, body.get("project_type"), revision)
+    except ProjectConflict as error:
+        return jsonify({"error": "project_conflict", "revision": error.current_revision}), 409
+    except (ValueError, TypeError):
+        abort(400, description="Roteiro ou revisão inválidos.")
+    if updated is None:
+        abort(404)
+    return jsonify({"ok": True, "revision": updated})
+
+
+# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+# Duplicate Project
+# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+@projects_bp.post("/projects/<project_id>/duplicate")
+@login_required
+@require_csrf
+def duplicate(project_id):
+    body = request.get_json(silent=True) or {}
+    try:
+        revision = int(body.get("revision"))
+    except (TypeError, ValueError):
+        abort(400, description="Revisão inválida.")
+
+    project = get_project(current_account_id(), project_id)
+    if project is None:
+        abort(404)
+
+    if int(revision) != int(project["revision"]):
+        return jsonify({"error": "project_conflict", "revision": project["revision"]}), 409
+
+    # Verifica se a conta tem crédito de projeto
+    account = get_account(current_account_id())
+    if account is None:
+        abort(401)
+    if not account["unlimited"] and int(account["project_remaining"] or 0) <= 0:
+        return jsonify({"error": "project_quota", "message": "Sem créditos de projeto disponíveis."}), 402
+
+    try:
+        new_project_id = create_project(current_account_id(), project["project_type"])
+    except ProjectQuotaError:
+        return jsonify({"error": "project_quota", "message": "Sem créditos de projeto disponíveis."}), 402
+
+    # Copia o payload completo
+    payload = {k: v for k, v in project.items() if k not in {"id", "revision", "created_at", "updated_at", "title"}}
+    payload["version"] = 1
+    payload["fields"] = {**project.get("fields", {}), "title": f"Cópia de {project.get('title', 'Projeto')}"}
+    new_title = payload["fields"]["title"][:240]
+
+    from ..store.projects import get_db
+    import time
+    now = int(time.time())
+    db = get_db()
+    db.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+    try:
+        # Atualiza o novo projeto com o payload copiado
+        encoded = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
+        db.execute(
+            """UPDATE projects SET title = ?, payload = ?, updated_at = ?
+               WHERE id = ? AND account_id = ?""",
+            (new_title, encoded, now, new_project_id, current_account_id()),
+        )
+        # Cria revisão inicial do projeto duplicado
+        create_revision(current_account_id(), new_project_id, 1, new_title, project["project_type"], payload)
+        db.commit()
+    except Exception:
+        db.rollback()
+        # Tenta limpar o projeto criado se falhar
+        try:
+            db.execute("DELETE FROM projects WHERE id = ?", (new_project_id,))
+            db.execute("UPDATE accounts SET project_used = CASE WHEN project_used > 0 THEN project_used - 1 ELSE 0 END WHERE id = ?", (current_account_id(),))
+            db.commit()
+        except Exception:
+            pass
+        return jsonify({"error": "duplicate_failed", "message": "Falha ao duplicar projeto."}), 500
+
+    return jsonify({"ok": True, "project_id": new_project_id, "revision": 1})
+
+
+# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+# Quarto PDF Export
+# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+_DOCUMENT_KINDS = {
+    "case_report": "case",
+    "paper_project": "paper",
+    "paper_final": "paper",
+}
+
+@projects_bp.post("/projects/<project_id>/export/pdf")
+@login_required
+@require_csrf
+def export_pdf(project_id):
+    project = get_project(current_account_id(), project_id)
+    if project is None:
+        abort(404)
+
+    body = request.get_json(silent=True) or {}
+    document_kind = body.get("document_kind")
+
+    if document_kind not in _DOCUMENT_KINDS:
+        return jsonify({"error": "invalid_document_kind", "message": "Tipo de documento inválido."}), 400
+
+    expected_type = _DOCUMENT_KINDS[document_kind]
+    if project.get("project_type") != expected_type:
+        return jsonify({"error": "project_type_mismatch", "message": "Tipo de documento não corresponde ao projeto."}), 400
+
+    try:
+        pdf_bytes = render_document_pdf(project, document_kind)
+    except QuartoUnavailableError:
+        return jsonify({"error": "quarto_unavailable", "message": "O renderizador Quarto não está disponível."}), 503
+    except QuartoBusyError:
+        return jsonify({"error": "quarto_busy", "message": "Há muitas renderizações em andamento. Tente novamente."}), 503
+    except QuartoRenderError as error:
+        return jsonify({"error": "quarto_render_error", "message": str(error)}), 500
+    except QuartoDocumentError as error:
+        return jsonify({"error": "invalid_document", "message": str(error)}), 400
+
+    from flask import Response
+    return Response(
+        pdf_bytes,
+        mimetype="application/pdf",
+        headers={
+            "Content-Disposition": f'attachment; filename="{project["title"] or "documento"}.pdf"',
+            "Content-Length": str(len(pdf_bytes)),
+        },
+    )
+
+
+# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+# Revisions (History, Diff, Restore)
+# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+@projects_bp.get("/projects/<project_id>/revisions")
+@login_required
+def revisions_list(project_id):
+    project = get_project(current_account_id(), project_id)
+    if project is None:
+        abort(404)
+
+    revs = list_revisions(project_id, current_account_id())
+    return jsonify({"ok": True, "revisions": revs})
+
+
+@projects_bp.get("/projects/<project_id>/revisions/diff")
+@login_required
+def revisions_diff(project_id):
+    project = get_project(current_account_id(), project_id)
+    if project is None:
+        abort(404)
+
+    snapshot_a = request.args.get("a")
+    snapshot_b = request.args.get("b")
+    if not snapshot_a or not snapshot_b:
+        return jsonify({"error": "missing_snapshots", "message": "Informe os snapshots 'a' e 'b'."}), 400
+
+    diff = diff_revisions(current_account_id(), project_id, snapshot_a, snapshot_b)
+    if diff is None:
+        return jsonify({"error": "revision_not_found", "message": "Uma das revisões não foi encontrada."}), 404
+
+    return jsonify({"ok": True, "diff": diff})
+
+
+@projects_bp.post("/projects/<project_id>/revisions/restore")
+@login_required
+@require_csrf
+def revisions_restore(project_id):
+    project = get_project(current_account_id(), project_id)
+    if project is None:
+        abort(404)
+
+    body = request.get_json(silent=True) or {}
+    snapshot_id = body.get("snapshot_id")
+    try:
+        expected_revision = int(body.get("revision"))
+    except (TypeError, ValueError):
+        return jsonify({"error": "invalid_revision", "message": "Revisão inválida."}), 400
+
+    if not snapshot_id:
+        return jsonify({"error": "missing_snapshot", "message": "Informe o snapshot_id."}), 400
+
+    try:
+        next_revision = restore_revision(current_account_id(), project_id, snapshot_id, expected_revision)
+    except ProjectConflict as error:
+        return jsonify({"error": "project_conflict", "revision": error.current_revision}), 409
+    except Exception:
+        return jsonify({"error": "restore_failed", "message": "Falha ao restaurar revisão."}), 500
+
+    if next_revision is None:
+        return jsonify({"error": "restore_failed", "message": "Revisão não encontrada ou projeto inexistente."}), 404
+
+    return jsonify({"ok": True, "revision": next_revision})

@@ -0,0 +1,280 @@
+import json
+import re
+import unicodedata
+from copy import deepcopy
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from flask import Blueprint, abort, current_app, jsonify, render_template, request, send_from_directory
+
+from ..auth import require_csrf
+from ..domain.workflow import workflow_sections
+from ..services.research import ResearchUnavailable, search_catalog, entries_by_ids
+
+
+public_bp = Blueprint("public", __name__)
+
+
+def _camel_case(value):
+    return re.sub(r"_([a-z])", lambda match: match.group(1).upper(), value)
+
+
+def _demo_workflow_key(model_id, workflow):
+    if model_id == "civil-personality":
+        return "case", "report"
+    if model_id == "projeto-paper-modelo":
+        return "paper_project", "paper_project"
+    if model_id == "paper-final-modelo":
+        return "paper_final", "paper_final"
+    if workflow.get("fields", {}).get("paperKind") == "project":
+        return "paper_project", "paper_project"
+    return "paper_final", "paper_final"
+
+
+def _normalise_demo_title(value):
+    value = unicodedata.normalize("NFD", str(value or "").casefold())
+    value = "".join(character for character in value if unicodedata.category(character) != "Mn")
+    return " ".join(value.replace("·", " ").replace(".", " ").split())
+
+
+def _demo_stage_sections(model_id, stage_title, sections):
+    """Relaciona o conteúdo preenchido ao mesmo estágio usado no editor.
+
+    Os modelos legados têm subtítulos vazios (por exemplo, cabeçalhos de
+    agrupamento). Por isso, a associação não deve depender da posição bruta
+    da lista de parágrafos: o título do estágio e o título textual da seção
+    são as identidades estáveis.
+    """
+    maps = {
+        "civil-personality": {
+            "1 · Descrição do caso": ("1 descricao do caso",),
+            "2.1 · Decisões possíveis": ("2 1 descricao das decisoes possiveis",),
+            "2.2.1 · Argumentação da tese A": ("2 2 1",),
+            "2.2.2 · Argumentação da tese B": ("2 2 2",),
+            "2.3 · Critérios e valores": ("2 3 descricao dos criterios e valores",),
+        },
+        "projeto-paper-modelo": {
+            "Identificação e delimitação": ("1 tema", "2 titulo e delimitacao do tema"),
+            "Problema de pesquisa": ("3 problema",),
+            "Hipótese": ("4 hipoteses",),
+            "Justificativa": ("5 justificativa",),
+            "Objetivos": ("6 objetivos gerais e especificos",),
+            "Referencial teórico": ("7 referencial teorico",),
+            "Metodologia": ("8 metodologia",),
+            "Referências do projeto": ("9 referencias",),
+        },
+        "paper-final-modelo": {
+            "Introdução": ("1 introducao",),
+            "Desenvolvimento": ("2 o inquerito policial", "3 a lei", "4 valor probatorio"),
+            "Conclusão": ("5 conclusao",),
+            "Referências finais": ("referencias",),
+        },
+    }
+    patterns = maps.get(model_id, {}).get(stage_title, ())
+    if not patterns:
+        return ()
+    normalized_sections = [_normalise_demo_title(section.get("title")) for section in sections]
+    return tuple(
+        index
+        for index, title in enumerate(normalized_sections)
+        if any(title.startswith(pattern) for pattern in patterns)
+    )
+
+
+def _build_demo_stages(model_id, workflow, sections):
+    workflow_key, phase = _demo_workflow_key(model_id, workflow)
+    values = workflow.get("fields", {}) if isinstance(workflow, dict) else {}
+    stages = []
+    for index, original in enumerate(workflow_sections(workflow_key)):
+        if original.get("phase", "report") != phase:
+            continue
+        stage = deepcopy(original)
+        fields = []
+        for field in stage.get("fields", []):
+            field = deepcopy(field)
+            field_id = str(field.get("id") or "")
+            candidates = [field_id, _camel_case(field_id)]
+            if field_id == "authors":
+                candidates.insert(0, "author")
+            field["value"] = next((values[key] for key in candidates if key in values), "")
+            fields.append(field)
+        stage["fields"] = fields
+        if stage.get("custom") == "criteria":
+            stage["criteria_text"] = values.get("criteriaText", "")
+        if stage.get("custom") == "development":
+            stage["development_sections"] = values.get("developmentSections", [])
+        stage["demo_sections"] = [
+            deepcopy(sections[item])
+            for item in _demo_stage_sections(model_id, stage.get("title", ""), sections)
+            if item < len(sections)
+        ]
+        stages.append(stage)
+    return stages
+
+
+# A demonstração pública usa somente conteúdo estático, anonimizado e versionado.
+# A fonte de verdade foi extraída dos modelos preenchidos do projeto de referência;
+# não há conta, projeto ou dado de produção neste arquivo.
+def _load_demo_models():
+    source = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "domain" / "public-models.json"
+    raw_models = json.loads(source.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    models = []
+    for raw in raw_models:
+        raw_sections = []
+        for section in raw.get("sections", []):
+            paragraphs = []
+            for item in section.get("paragraphs", []):
+                if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("quote"):
+                    value = f'“{item["quote"]}”'
+                else:
+                    value = str(item)
+                if value.strip():
+                    paragraphs.append(value)
+            paragraphs = tuple(paragraphs)
+            raw_sections.append({"title": section.get("title", "Seção"), "paragraphs": paragraphs})
+        sections = [section for section in raw_sections if section["paragraphs"]]
+        model_id = raw.get("id", "")
+        if model_id == "civil-personality":
+            question_label = "Questão do caso"
+            question = next((paragraph for section in sections for paragraph in section["paragraphs"] if "quais são os limites" in paragraph.lower()), "")
+        elif model_id == "projeto-paper-modelo":
+            question_label = "Problema de pesquisa"
+            question = next((section["paragraphs"][-1] for section in sections if "problema" in section["title"].lower() and section["paragraphs"]), "")
+        else:
+            question_label = "Resumo"
+            question = raw.get("abstract", "")
+        workflow = deepcopy(raw.get("workflow", {}))
+        field_values = dict(workflow.get("fields", {}))
+        field_values.setdefault("title", raw.get("title", ""))
+        field_values.setdefault("author", raw.get("authors", ""))
+        field_values.setdefault("discipline", raw.get("discipline", ""))
+        field_values.setdefault("teacher", raw.get("teacher", ""))
+        field_values.setdefault("city", raw.get("city", ""))
+        field_values.setdefault("year", raw.get("year", ""))
+        class_info = raw.get("classInfo", "")
+        if class_info:
+            field_values.setdefault("classInfo", class_info)
+            field_values.setdefault("shift", class_info.split(",", 1)[0].strip())
+            if "," in class_info:
+                field_values.setdefault("period", class_info.split(",", 1)[1].strip())
+        workflow["fields"] = field_values
+        models.append({
+            "id": model_id,
+            "type_label": raw.get("typeLabel", "Modelo preenchido"),
+            "title": raw.get("title", ""),
+            "authors": raw.get("authors", ""),
+            "discipline": raw.get("discipline", ""),
+            "teacher": raw.get("teacher", ""),
+            "class_info": raw.get("classInfo", ""),
+            "delivery_date": raw.get("deliveryDate", ""),
+            "city": raw.get("city", ""),
+            "year": raw.get("year", ""),
+            "question_label": question_label,
+            "question": question,
+            "summary": raw.get("summary", "Modelo preenchido em modo somente leitura."),
+            "abstract": raw.get("abstract", ""),
+            "keywords": raw.get("keywords", []),
+            "sections": sections,
+            "citations": raw.get("citations", []),
+            "sources": raw.get("sources", []),
+            "workflow": workflow,
+            "stages": _build_demo_stages(model_id, workflow, raw_sections),
+        })
+    return tuple(models)
+
+
+PUBLIC_DEMO_MODELS = _load_demo_models()
+_PUBLIC_PIX_NAMES = frozenset({"avulso-ai.svg", "sem-ia.svg", "com-ia.svg"})
+
+
+@public_bp.get("/")
+def home():
+    return render_template(
+        "public/home.html",
+        demo_models=PUBLIC_DEMO_MODELS,
+        google_login=request.args.get("google_login", ""),
+        pricing_only=False,
+    )
+
+
+@public_bp.get("/planos", strict_slashes=False)
+def pricing():
+    return render_template(
+        "public/home.html",
+        demo_models=PUBLIC_DEMO_MODELS,
+        google_login="",
+        pricing_only=True,
+    )
+
+
+@public_bp.get("/termos", strict_slashes=False)
+def terms():
+    return render_template("public/terms.html")
+
+
+@public_bp.get("/privacidade", strict_slashes=False)
+def privacy():
+    return render_template("public/privacy.html")
+
+
+@public_bp.get("/ajuda-ia", strict_slashes=False)
+def ai_help():
+    return render_template("public/ai-help.html")
+
+
+@public_bp.get("/jornada", strict_slashes=False)
+def journey():
+    return render_template("public/journey.html")
+
+
+@public_bp.get("/pix/<path:filename>")
+def pix_asset(filename):
+    if filename not in _PUBLIC_PIX_NAMES:
+        abort(404)
+    # Use safe_join to prevent path traversal
+    static_folder = Path(current_app.static_folder)
+    pix_dir = static_folder / "pix"
+    # Ensure the resolved path is within pix_dir
+    file_path = pix_dir / filename
+    try:
+        file_path.resolve().relative_to(pix_dir.resolve())
+    except ValueError:
+        abort(404)
+    return send_from_directory(pix_dir, filename, mimetype="image/svg+xml", max_age=3600)
+
+
+# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+# Research Catalog (Public API)
+# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+@public_bp.get("/api/research/catalog")
+def research_catalog():
+    """Catálogo jurídico público com metadata para auxiliar IA/JEV."""
+    q = request.args.get("q", "").strip()
+    kind = request.args.get("kind")
+    limit = request.args.get("limit", 20, type=int)
+    limit = max(1, min(limit, 100))
+
+    try:
+        result = search_catalog(q, kind=kind, limit=limit)
+    except ResearchUnavailable:
+        return jsonify({"error": "catalog_unavailable", "message": "O catálogo jurídico não está disponível no momento."}), 503
+
+    return jsonify({"ok": True, **result})
+
+
+@public_bp.post("/api/research/catalog/entries")
+@require_csrf
+def research_catalog_entries():
+    """Obtém entradas completas do catálogo por IDs."""
+    body = request.get_json(silent=True) or {}
+    ids = body.get("ids")
+    if not isinstance(ids, list) or not ids:
+        return jsonify({"error": "invalid_ids", "message": "Informe uma lista de IDs."}), 400
+    ids = [str(id_) for id_ in ids if isinstance(id_, str)][:50]
+
+    try:
+        entries = entries_by_ids(ids)
+    except ResearchUnavailable:
+        return jsonify({"error": "catalog_unavailable", "message": "O catálogo jurídico não está disponível no momento."}), 503
+
+    return jsonify({"ok": True, "entries": entries})
