diff --git a/app/store/accounts.py b/app/store/accounts.py
@@ -0,0 +1,421 @@
+import json
+import time
+from uuid import uuid4
+
+from flask import current_app
+
+from .db import get_db
+from ..config import PLAN_CODES, PLAN_LABELS, MAX_ACCOUNT_LIMIT
+
+
+def upsert_google_account(claims: dict) -> str:
+    subject = str(claims.get("sub") or "").strip()[:255]
+    email = str(claims.get("email") or "").strip().lower()[:240]
+    name = str(claims.get("name") or "").strip()[:160]
+    if not subject or not email:
+        raise ValueError("claims Google incompletos")
+    database = get_db()
+    row = database.execute("SELECT id FROM accounts WHERE google_sub = ? OR email = ?", (subject, email)).fetchone()
+    now = int(time.time())
+    if row is None:
+        account_id = str(uuid4())
+        database.execute(
+            "INSERT INTO accounts (id, google_sub, email, name, created_at, last_login) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
+            (account_id, subject, email, name, now, now),
+        )
+    else:
+        account_id = row["id"]
+        database.execute(
+            "UPDATE accounts SET google_sub = ?, email = ?, name = ?, last_login = ? WHERE id = ?",
+            (subject, email, name, now, account_id),
+        )
+    database.commit()
+    return account_id
+
+
+def get_account(account_id: str) -> dict | None:
+    row = get_db().execute("SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE id = ?", (account_id,)).fetchone()
+    if row is None:
+        return None
+    try:
+        profile = json.loads(row["profile_json"] or "{}")
+    except json.JSONDecodeError:
+        profile = {}
+    is_admin = row["email"].lower() in current_app.config.get("ADMIN_EMAILS", set())
+    return {
+        "id": row["id"],
+        "email": row["email"],
+        "name": row["name"],
+        "profile": profile if isinstance(profile, dict) else {},
+        "terms_accepted": bool(row["terms_accepted"]),
+        "terms_version": row["terms_version"],
+        "ai_consent": bool(row["ai_consent"]),
+        "is_blocked": bool(row["is_blocked"]),
+        "is_admin": is_admin,
+        "plan_code": row["plan_code"] or "livre",
+        "project_limit": int(row["project_limit"] or 0),
+        "project_used": int(row["project_used"] or 0),
+        "ai_limit": int(row["ai_limit"] or 0),
+        "ai_used": int(row["ai_used"] or 0),
+        "project_remaining": None if is_admin else max(0, int(row["project_limit"] or 0) - int(row["project_used"] or 0)),
+        "ai_remaining": None if is_admin else max(0, int(row["ai_limit"] or 0) - int(row["ai_used"] or 0)),
+        "unlimited": is_admin,
+        # Novos campos v12
+        "sharing_preferences_version": int(row["sharing_preferences_version"] or 1),
+        "sharing_allow_admin_view": bool(row["sharing_allow_admin_view"]),
+        "sharing_allow_admin_comments": bool(row["sharing_allow_admin_comments"]),
+        "sharing_inherit_default": bool(row["sharing_inherit_default"]),
+        "deletion_request_pending": bool(row["deletion_request_pending"]),
+        "ai_analysis_limit": int(row["ai_analysis_limit"] or 0),
+        "deepseek_explanation_limit": int(row["deepseek_explanation_limit"] or 0),
+    }
+
+
+def update_profile(account_id: str, profile: dict, name: str) -> dict:
+    clean = {
+        "city": str(profile.get("city") or "").strip()[:160],
+        "disciplines": list(dict.fromkeys(str(value).strip()[:160] for value in profile.get("disciplines", []) if str(value).strip()))[:40],
+        "teachers": list(dict.fromkeys(str(value).strip()[:160] for value in profile.get("teachers", []) if str(value).strip()))[:40],
+        "institution": str(profile.get("institution") or "").strip()[:160],
+        "course": str(profile.get("course") or "").strip()[:160],
+        "discipline": str(profile.get("discipline") or "").strip()[:160],
+        "professor": str(profile.get("professor") or "").strip()[:160],
+    }
+    get_db().execute(
+        "UPDATE accounts SET name = ?, profile_json = ? WHERE id = ?",
+        (str(name or "").strip()[:160], json.dumps(clean, ensure_ascii=False), account_id),
+    )
+    get_db().commit()
+    return get_account(account_id)
+
+
+def accept_terms(account_id: str, accept: bool, ai_consent: bool) -> dict:
+    if not accept:
+        raise ValueError("os termos precisam ser aceitos")
+    now = int(time.time())
+    get_db().execute(
+        """UPDATE accounts SET terms_accepted = 1, terms_version = ?, terms_accepted_at = ?, ai_consent = ?
+           WHERE id = ?""",
+        ("2026-10", now, int(bool(ai_consent)), account_id),
+    )
+    get_db().commit()
+    return get_account(account_id)
+
+
+# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+# Sharing Preferences v2 (com herança)
+# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+def get_account_sharing_preferences(account_id: str) -> dict:
+    """Retorna preferências de compartilhamento no nível da conta."""
+    row = get_db().execute(
+        "SELECT sharing_preferences_version, sharing_allow_admin_view, sharing_allow_admin_comments, sharing_inherit_default "
+        "FROM accounts WHERE id = ?",
+        (account_id,),
+    ).fetchone()
+    if row is None:
+        return {
+            "version": 1,
+            "allow_admin_view": False,
+            "allow_admin_comments": False,
+            "inherit_default": True,
+        }
+    return {
+        "version": int(row["sharing_preferences_version"] or 1),
+        "allow_admin_view": bool(row["sharing_allow_admin_view"]),
+        "allow_admin_comments": bool(row["sharing_allow_admin_comments"]),
+        "inherit_default": bool(row["sharing_inherit_default"]),
+    }
+
+
+def set_account_sharing_preferences(account_id: str, payload: dict) -> dict:
+    """Atualiza preferências de compartilhamento no nível da conta.
+
+    Regras de validação:
+    - allow_admin_comments requer allow_admin_view
+    - version é incrementado a cada mudança
+    """
+    allow_view = bool(payload.get("allow_admin_view", False))
+    allow_comments = bool(payload.get("allow_admin_comments", False))
+    inherit_default = bool(payload.get("inherit_account_default", True))
+
+    if allow_comments and not allow_view:
+        raise ValueError("Comentários administrativos requerem visualização administrativa.")
+
+    now = int(time.time())
+    get_db().execute(
+        """UPDATE accounts
+           SET sharing_allow_admin_view = ?, sharing_allow_admin_comments = ?,
+               sharing_inherit_default = ?, sharing_preferences_version = sharing_preferences_version + 1
+           WHERE id = ?""",
+        (int(allow_view), int(allow_comments), int(inherit_default), account_id),
+    )
+    get_db().commit()
+    return get_account_sharing_preferences(account_id)
+
+
+def get_effective_project_sharing(account_id: str, project_id: str) -> dict:
+    """Calcula permissões efetivas do projeto (override vs herança da conta)."""
+    from .sharing import get_sharing
+    project_sharing = get_sharing(account_id, project_id)
+    account_prefs = get_account_sharing_preferences(account_id)
+
+    if project_sharing.get("inherit_account_default", True):
+        # Herda da conta
+        return {
+            "allow_admin_view": account_prefs["allow_admin_view"],
+            "allow_admin_comments": account_prefs["allow_admin_comments"],
+            "inherited": True,
+        }
+    else:
+        # Override no projeto
+        return {
+            "allow_admin_view": project_sharing["allow_admin_view"],
+            "allow_admin_comments": project_sharing["allow_admin_comments"],
+            "inherited": False,
+        }
+
+
+# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+# Deletion Request (auto-exclusão pelo próprio usuário)
+# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+def request_self_deletion(account_id: str) -> dict:
+    """Usuário solicita exclusão da própria conta."""
+    now = int(time.time())
+    db = get_db()
+    db.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+    # Verifica se já existe pedido pendente
+    existing = db.execute(
+        "SELECT status FROM deletion_requests WHERE account_id = ?",
+        (account_id,),
+    ).fetchone()
+    if existing and existing["status"] == "pending":
+        db.rollback()
+        raise ValueError("Já existe uma solicitação de exclusão pendente.")
+
+    # Cria pedido de exclusão
+    db.execute(
+        """INSERT INTO deletion_requests (account_id, requested_by, status, created_at)
+           VALUES (?, ?, 'pending', ?)""",
+        (account_id, account_id, now),
+    )
+    # Marca conta como com pedido pendente
+    db.execute(
+        "UPDATE accounts SET deletion_request_pending = 1 WHERE id = ?",
+        (account_id,),
+    )
+    db.commit()
+    return {"status": "pending", "created_at": now}
+
+
+def cancel_self_deletion(account_id: str) -> dict:
+    """Usuário cancela sua própria solicitação de exclusão."""
+    db = get_db()
+    db.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+    db.execute(
+        "DELETE FROM deletion_requests WHERE account_id = ? AND status = 'pending'",
+        (account_id,),
+    )
+    db.execute(
+        "UPDATE accounts SET deletion_request_pending = 0 WHERE id = ?",
+        (account_id,),
+    )
+    db.commit()
+    return {"status": "cancelled"}
+
+
+def confirm_self_deletion(account_id: str) -> dict:
+    """Usuário confirma exclusão - deleta tudo em cascata."""
+    db = get_db()
+    db.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+    # Atualiza status do pedido
+    db.execute(
+        "UPDATE deletion_requests SET status = 'accepted', resolved_at = ? WHERE account_id = ? AND status = 'pending'",
+        (int(time.time()), account_id),
+    )
+    # Deleta a conta (cascata via FK)
+    db.execute("DELETE FROM accounts WHERE id = ?", (account_id,))
+    db.commit()
+    return {"status": "accepted", "executed": True}
+
+
+# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+# Account Grants (Ledger de créditos)
+# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+def create_account_grant(
+    account_id: str,
+    plan_code: str,
+    project_credits: int = 0,
+    ai_analysis_credits: int = 0,
+    deepseek_explanation_credits: int = 0,
+    expires_at: int | None = None,
+) -> str:
+    """Cria grant de créditos para a conta."""
+    grant_id = str(uuid4())
+    now = int(time.time())
+    get_db().execute(
+        """INSERT INTO account_grants
+           (grant_id, account_id, plan_code, project_credits, project_consumed,
+            ai_analysis_credits, ai_analysis_consumed,
+            deepseek_explanation_credits, deepseek_explanation_consumed,
+            created_at, expires_at)
+           VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 0, ?, 0, ?, 0, ?, ?)""",
+        (grant_id, account_id, plan_code, project_credits, ai_analysis_credits,
+         deepseek_explanation_credits, now, expires_at),
+    )
+    get_db().commit()
+    return grant_id
+
+
+def consume_project_credit(account_id: str) -> bool:
+    """Consome 1 crédito de projeto do grant mais antigo com saldo."""
+    db = get_db()
+    db.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+    row = db.execute(
+        """SELECT grant_id, project_credits, project_consumed
+           FROM account_grants
+           WHERE account_id = ? AND project_consumed < project_credits
+           ORDER BY created_at ASC
+           LIMIT 1""",
+        (account_id,),
+    ).fetchone()
+    if row is None:
+        db.rollback()
+        return False
+    db.execute(
+        "UPDATE account_grants SET project_consumed = project_consumed + 1 WHERE grant_id = ?",
+        (row["grant_id"],),
+    )
+    db.commit()
+    return True
+
+
+def refund_project_credit(account_id: str) -> bool:
+    """Devolve 1 crédito de projeto (usado ao deletar projeto)."""
+    db = get_db()
+    db.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+    row = db.execute(
+        """SELECT grant_id, project_consumed
+           FROM account_grants
+           WHERE account_id = ? AND project_consumed > 0
+           ORDER BY created_at DESC
+           LIMIT 1""",
+        (account_id,),
+    ).fetchone()
+    if row is None:
+        db.rollback()
+        return False
+    db.execute(
+        "UPDATE account_grants SET project_consumed = project_consumed - 1 WHERE grant_id = ?",
+        (row["grant_id"],),
+    )
+    db.commit()
+    return True
+
+
+def get_account_grants_summary(account_id: str) -> dict:
+    """Retorna resumo de grants da conta."""
+    rows = get_db().execute(
+        """SELECT grant_id, plan_code, project_credits, project_consumed,
+                  ai_analysis_credits, ai_analysis_consumed,
+                  deepseek_explanation_credits, deepseek_explanation_consumed,
+                  created_at, expires_at
+           FROM account_grants WHERE account_id = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC""",
+        (account_id,),
+    ).fetchall()
+    grants = []
+    for row in rows:
+        grants.append({
+            "grant_id": row["grant_id"],
+            "plan_code": row["plan_code"],
+            "project_credits": row["project_credits"],
+            "project_consumed": row["project_consumed"],
+            "project_remaining": row["project_credits"] - row["project_consumed"],
+            "ai_analysis_credits": row["ai_analysis_credits"],
+            "ai_analysis_consumed": row["ai_analysis_consumed"],
+            "ai_analysis_remaining": row["ai_analysis_credits"] - row["ai_analysis_consumed"],
+            "deepseek_explanation_credits": row["deepseek_explanation_credits"],
+            "deepseek_explanation_consumed": row["deepseek_explanation_consumed"],
+            "deepseek_explanation_remaining": row["deepseek_explanation_credits"] - row["deepseek_explanation_consumed"],
+            "created_at": row["created_at"],
+            "expires_at": row["expires_at"],
+        })
+    return {"grants": grants}
+
+
+# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+# Account Export (LGPD)
+# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+def export_account_data(account_id: str) -> dict:
+    """Exporta todos os dados da conta para LGPD/GDPR."""
+    from .projects import list_projects, get_project
+    from .sharing import list_comments
+    from .sources import list_sources
+    from .ai_usage import get_db as get_ai_db
+
+    account = get_account(account_id)
+    if not account:
+        raise ValueError("Conta não encontrada")
+
+    projects_data = []
+    for project in list_projects(account_id):
+        full_project = get_project(account_id, project["id"])
+        if full_project:
+            projects_data.append(full_project)
+
+    # Revisions
+    revisions = []
+    for project in list_projects(account_id):
+        rev_rows = get_db().execute(
+            """SELECT snapshot_id, revision, title, project_type, payload, created_at
+               FROM project_revisions WHERE project_id = ? ORDER BY revision DESC""",
+            (project["id"],),
+        ).fetchall()
+        for rev in rev_rows:
+            try:
+                payload = json.loads(rev["payload"])
+            except (TypeError, ValueError, json.JSONDecodeError):
+                payload = {}
+            revisions.append({
+                "project_id": project["id"],
+                "snapshot_id": rev["snapshot_id"],
+                "revision": rev["revision"],
+                "title": rev["title"],
+                "project_type": rev["project_type"],
+                "payload": payload,
+                "created_at": rev["created_at"],
+            })
+
+    # Comments received (as owner)
+    comments = []
+    for project in list_projects(account_id):
+        proj_comments = list_comments(project["id"])
+        for c in proj_comments:
+            c["project_id"] = project["id"]
+            comments.append(c)
+
+    # Sources
+    sources_data = list_sources(account_id)
+
+    # AI Usage
+    ai_usage = get_ai_db().execute(
+        """SELECT request_id, action, units, status, created_at, updated_at
+           FROM ai_usage_reservations WHERE account_id = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC""",
+        (account_id,),
+    ).fetchall()
+
+    provider_usage = get_ai_db().execute(
+        """SELECT request_id, provider, operation, model, input_tokens, output_tokens, status, created_at
+           FROM provider_usage WHERE account_id = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC""",
+        (account_id,),
+    ).fetchall()
+
+    return {
+        "account": account,
+        "projects": projects_data,
+        "revisions": revisions,
+        "comments": comments,
+        "sources": sources_data,
+        "ai_usage_reservations": [dict(r) for r in ai_usage],
+        "provider_usage": [dict(r) for r in provider_usage],
+        "exported_at": int(time.time()),
+    }
diff --git a/app/store/admin.py b/app/store/admin.py
@@ -0,0 +1,384 @@
+"""Operações administrativas manuais.
+
+O módulo depende de uma extensão aditiva da tabela ``accounts`` que é aplicada
+pelo schema/migração da aplicação. Nenhuma operação aqui concede plano por
+pagamento nem devolve o payload de projetos privados.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import time
+import shutil
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any
+
+from flask import current_app
+
+from .db import get_db
+
+
+PLAN_CODES = ("livre", "avulso_ai", "sem_ia", "com_ia")
+PLAN_LABELS = {
+    "livre": "Sem plano",
+    "avulso_ai": "Avulso com IA",
+    "sem_ia": "Plano sem IA",
+    "com_ia": "Plano com IA",
+}
+MAX_ACCOUNT_LIMIT = 1000
+
+# These are deliberately explicit: the parent migration must add exactly these
+# administrative fields (with compatible integer/text types and safe defaults).
+REQUIRED_ACCOUNT_COLUMNS = (
+    "plan_code",
+    "project_limit",
+    "project_used",
+    "ai_limit",
+    "ai_used",
+    "is_blocked",
+    "ai_analysis_limit",
+    "deepseek_explanation_limit",
+)
+
+
+class AdminSchemaUnavailable(RuntimeError):
+    """Raised when the parent application has not applied the admin migration."""
+
+    def __init__(self, missing: set[str]):
+        self.missing = tuple(sorted(missing))
+        super().__init__(
+            "A migração administrativa ainda não foi aplicada; faltam: "
+            + ", ".join(self.missing)
+        )
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class AdminValidationError(ValueError):
+    """An input that an administrator must correct before retrying."""
+
+    message: str
+
+    def __str__(self) -> str:
+        return self.message
+
+
+def _account_columns() -> set[str]:
+    return {row["name"] for row in get_db().execute("PRAGMA table_info(accounts)").fetchall()}
+
+
+def _require_admin_schema() -> None:
+    missing = set(REQUIRED_ACCOUNT_COLUMNS) - _account_columns()
+    if missing:
+        raise AdminSchemaUnavailable(missing)
+
+
+def _is_admin_email(email: str) -> bool:
+    return str(email or "").strip().lower() in current_app.config.get("ADMIN_EMAILS", set())
+
+
+def _account_dict(row: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    project_used = max(0, int(row["project_used"] or 0))
+    project_limit = max(0, int(row["project_limit"] or 0))
+    ai_used = max(0, int(row["ai_used"] or 0))
+    ai_limit = max(0, int(row["ai_limit"] or 0))
+    plan_code = row["plan_code"] if row["plan_code"] in PLAN_CODES else "livre"
+    is_admin = _is_admin_email(row["email"])
+    return {
+        "id": row["id"],
+        "email": row["email"],
+        "name": row["name"],
+        "plan_code": plan_code,
+        "plan_label": PLAN_LABELS[plan_code],
+        "project_limit": project_limit,
+        "project_used": project_used,
+        "project_remaining": None if is_admin else max(0, project_limit - project_used),
+        "ai_limit": ai_limit,
+        "ai_used": ai_used,
+        "ai_remaining": None if is_admin else max(0, ai_limit - ai_used),
+        "is_blocked": bool(row["is_blocked"]),
+        "is_admin": is_admin,
+        "unlimited": is_admin,
+        "project_count": int(row["project_count"] or 0),
+        "created_at": row["created_at"],
+        "last_login": row["last_login"],
+        # Novos campos v12
+        "ai_analysis_limit": int(row["ai_analysis_limit"] or 0),
+        "deepseek_explanation_limit": int(row["deepseek_explanation_limit"] or 0),
+    }
+
+
+def list_admin_accounts() -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Return account balances and identity metadata, never project payloads."""
+    _require_admin_schema()
+    rows = get_db().execute(
+        """SELECT a.id, a.email, a.name, a.plan_code,
+                  a.project_limit, a.project_used, a.ai_limit, a.ai_used,
+                  a.is_blocked, a.created_at, a.last_login,
+                  a.ai_analysis_limit, a.deepseek_explanation_limit,
+                  COUNT(p.id) AS project_count
+           FROM accounts AS a
+           LEFT JOIN projects AS p ON p.account_id = a.id
+           GROUP BY a.id, a.email, a.name, a.plan_code,
+                    a.project_limit, a.project_used, a.ai_limit, a.ai_used,
+                    a.is_blocked, a.created_at, a.last_login,
+                    a.ai_analysis_limit, a.deepseek_explanation_limit
+           ORDER BY a.created_at ASC, a.email ASC"""
+    ).fetchall()
+    return [_account_dict(row) for row in rows]
+
+
+def get_admin_account(account_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
+    _require_admin_schema()
+    row = get_db().execute(
+        """SELECT a.id, a.email, a.name, a.plan_code,
+                  a.project_limit, a.project_used, a.ai_limit, a.ai_used,
+                  a.is_blocked, a.created_at, a.last_login,
+                  a.ai_analysis_limit, a.deepseek_explanation_limit,
+                  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM projects p WHERE p.account_id = a.id) AS project_count
+           FROM accounts a WHERE a.id = ?""",
+        (account_id,),
+    ).fetchone()
+    return _account_dict(row) if row else None
+
+
+def set_account_plan(account_id: str, plan_code: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Change only the manually displayed plan badge; do not change balances."""
+    _require_admin_schema()
+    if not isinstance(plan_code, str) or plan_code not in PLAN_CODES:
+        raise AdminValidationError("Plano inválido.")
+    database = get_db()
+    database.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+    row = database.execute("SELECT id FROM accounts WHERE id = ?", (account_id,)).fetchone()
+    if row is None:
+        database.rollback()
+        return None
+    database.execute("UPDATE accounts SET plan_code = ? WHERE id = ?", (plan_code, account_id))
+    database.commit()
+    return get_admin_account(account_id)
+
+
+def set_project_credits(account_id: str, project_remaining: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Set available project credits independently of the plan badge."""
+    _require_admin_schema()
+    if (
+        isinstance(project_remaining, bool)
+        or not isinstance(project_remaining, int)
+        or not 0 <= project_remaining <= MAX_ACCOUNT_LIMIT
+    ):
+        raise AdminValidationError(
+            f"Os créditos de projeto devem ser um inteiro entre 0 e {MAX_ACCOUNT_LIMIT}."
+        )
+    database = get_db()
+    database.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+    row = database.execute(
+        "SELECT project_used FROM accounts WHERE id = ?", (account_id,)
+    ).fetchone()
+    if row is None:
+        database.rollback()
+        return None
+    project_used = max(0, int(row["project_used"] or 0))
+    if project_used + project_remaining > MAX_ACCOUNT_LIMIT:
+        database.rollback()
+        raise AdminValidationError(
+            f"O total concedido não pode ultrapassar {MAX_ACCOUNT_LIMIT} projetos."
+        )
+    database.execute(
+        "UPDATE accounts SET project_limit = ? WHERE id = ?",
+        (project_used + project_remaining, account_id),
+    )
+    database.commit()
+    return get_admin_account(account_id)
+
+
+def set_account_blocked(account_id: str, blocked: bool, actor_id: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Set a manual block flag, protecting the current administrator from lockout."""
+    _require_admin_schema()
+    if type(blocked) is not bool:
+        raise AdminValidationError("O estado de bloqueio é inválido.")
+    database = get_db()
+    database.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+    row = database.execute(
+        """SELECT id, email, is_blocked
+           FROM accounts WHERE id = ?""",
+        (account_id,),
+    ).fetchone()
+    if row is None:
+        database.rollback()
+        return None
+    if actor_id and actor_id == account_id:
+        database.rollback()
+        raise AdminValidationError("A conta administrativa atual não pode bloquear a própria sessão.")
+    if blocked and _is_admin_email(row["email"]):
+        admin_count = database.execute(
+            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts WHERE lower(email) IN ({})".format(
+                ",".join("?" for _ in current_app.config.get("ADMIN_EMAILS", set()))
+            ),
+            tuple(sorted(current_app.config.get("ADMIN_EMAILS", set()))),
+        ).fetchone()[0] if current_app.config.get("ADMIN_EMAILS", set()) else 0
+        if admin_count <= 1:
+            database.rollback()
+            raise AdminValidationError("Não bloqueie a única conta administradora configurada.")
+    database.execute(
+        "UPDATE accounts SET is_blocked = ? WHERE id = ?", (int(blocked), account_id)
+    )
+    database.commit()
+    return get_admin_account(account_id)
+
+
+def list_account_projects(account_id: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]] | None:
+    """List safe project metadata; private payloads never leave the database."""
+    _require_admin_schema()
+    if get_db().execute("SELECT 1 FROM accounts WHERE id = ?", (account_id,)).fetchone() is None:
+        return None
+    rows = get_db().execute(
+        """SELECT p.id, p.title, p.project_type, p.created_at, p.updated_at,
+                  COALESCE(s.allow_admin_view, 0) AS allow_admin_view,
+                  COALESCE(s.allow_admin_comments, 0) AS allow_admin_comments
+           FROM projects p
+           LEFT JOIN project_sharing s ON s.project_id = p.id AND s.account_id = p.account_id
+           WHERE p.account_id = ?
+           ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC, p.created_at DESC""",
+        (account_id,),
+    ).fetchall()
+    return [
+        {
+            "id": row["id"],
+            "title": row["title"],
+            "project_type": row["project_type"],
+            "created_at": row["created_at"],
+            "updated_at": row["updated_at"],
+            "allow_admin_view": bool(row["allow_admin_view"]),
+            "allow_admin_comments": bool(row["allow_admin_view"] and row["allow_admin_comments"]),
+        }
+        for row in rows
+    ]
+
+
+# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+# Admin: Health, Usage Global, Limits
+# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def global_usage() -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Retorna estatísticas globais de uso de IA (DeepSeek + JEV/Typesafe)."""
+    db = get_db()
+    # Usage reservations
+    usage_stats = db.execute(
+        """SELECT
+            COUNT(*) as total_reservations,
+            SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'complete' THEN units ELSE 0 END) as completed,
+            SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'refunded' THEN units ELSE 0 END) as refunded,
+            SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'reserved' THEN units ELSE 0 END) as reserved
+           FROM ai_usage_reservations"""
+    ).fetchone()
+
+    # Provider usage
+    provider_stats = db.execute(
+        """SELECT provider, operation, COUNT(*) as calls,
+                  SUM(input_tokens) as total_input_tokens,
+                  SUM(output_tokens) as total_output_tokens
+           FROM provider_usage
+           GROUP BY provider, operation"""
+    ).fetchall()
+
+    # DeepSeek usage
+    deepseek_stats = db.execute(
+        """SELECT COUNT(*) as calls,
+                  SUM(input_tokens) as total_input_tokens,
+                  SUM(output_tokens) as total_output_tokens,
+                  SUM(estimated_cost_usd) as total_cost
+           FROM deepseek_usage"""
+    ).fetchone()
+
+    return {
+        "reservations": dict(usage_stats) if usage_stats else {},
+        "by_provider": [dict(row) for row in provider_stats],
+        "deepseek": dict(deepseek_stats) if deepseek_stats else {},
+    }
+
+
+def operational_health() -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Retorna health check operacional do sistema."""
+    db = get_db()
+
+    # DB integrity
+    integrity = db.execute("PRAGMA integrity_check").fetchone()[0]
+
+    # Notification queue stats
+    notif_stats = db.execute(
+        """SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count
+           FROM notification_outbox
+           GROUP BY status"""
+    ).fetchall()
+
+    # Active sessions (last 24h)
+    now = int(time.time())
+    day_ago = now - 86400
+    active_sessions = db.execute(
+        "SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM sessions WHERE expires_at > ?", (day_ago,)
+    ).fetchone()
+
+    # Disk usage
+    usage = shutil.disk_usage("/")
+    disk = {
+        "total_bytes": usage.total,
+        "free_bytes": usage.free,
+        "used_percent": round((usage.total - usage.free) / usage.total * 100, 1) if usage.total else 0,
+    }
+
+    # Database size
+    db_path = current_app.config.get("DATABASE", "")
+    db_size = 0
+    if db_path:
+        from pathlib import Path
+        for path in (Path(db_path), Path(str(db_path) + "-wal"), Path(str(db_path) + "-shm")):
+            if path.exists():
+                db_size += path.stat().st_size
+
+    return {
+        "database": {
+            "integrity": integrity,
+            "notifications": {row["status"]: row["count"] for row in notif_stats},
+            "size_bytes": db_size,
+        },
+        "active_sessions_24h": active_sessions["count"] if active_sessions else 0,
+        "disk": disk,
+    }
+
+
+def set_account_limits(account_id: str, payload: dict) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
+    """Admin define limites customizados da conta."""
+    _require_admin_schema()
+    db = get_db()
+    db.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+
+    row = db.execute("SELECT id FROM accounts WHERE id = ?", (account_id,)).fetchone()
+    if row is None:
+        db.rollback()
+        return None
+
+    # Validação dos limites
+    ai_analysis_limit = payload.get("ai_analysis_limit")
+    deepseek_explanation_limit = payload.get("deepseek_explanation_limit")
+    is_admin = payload.get("is_admin")
+
+    if ai_analysis_limit is not None:
+        if not isinstance(ai_analysis_limit, int) or not (0 <= ai_analysis_limit <= MAX_ACCOUNT_LIMIT):
+            db.rollback()
+            raise AdminValidationError(f"Limite de análise IA deve ser inteiro entre 0 e {MAX_ACCOUNT_LIMIT}.")
+        db.execute("UPDATE accounts SET ai_analysis_limit = ? WHERE id = ?", (ai_analysis_limit, account_id))
+
+    if deepseek_explanation_limit is not None:
+        if not isinstance(deepseek_explanation_limit, int) or not (0 <= deepseek_explanation_limit <= MAX_ACCOUNT_LIMIT):
+            db.rollback()
+            raise AdminValidationError(f"Limite de explicação DeepSeek deve ser inteiro entre 0 e {MAX_ACCOUNT_LIMIT}.")
+        db.execute("UPDATE accounts SET deepseek_explanation_limit = ? WHERE id = ?", (deepseek_explanation_limit, account_id))
+
+    if is_admin is not None:
+        if not isinstance(is_admin, bool):
+            db.rollback()
+            raise AdminValidationError("O campo is_admin deve ser booleano.")
+        # Atualiza ai_limit baseado nos novos limites
+        new_ai_limit = int(ai_analysis_limit or 0) + int(deepseek_explanation_limit or 0)
+        db.execute("UPDATE accounts SET is_admin = ?, ai_limit = ? WHERE id = ?",
+                   (int(is_admin), new_ai_limit, account_id))
+
+    db.commit()
+    return get_admin_account(account_id)
diff --git a/app/store/ai_usage.py b/app/store/ai_usage.py
@@ -0,0 +1,94 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import time
+from flask import current_app
+from .db import get_db
+
+
+class UsageError(RuntimeError):
+    def __init__(self, code: str, message: str, status: int):
+        self.code = code
+        self.status = status
+        super().__init__(message)
+
+
+def reserve_usage(account_id: str, project_id: str, request_id: str, action: str) -> None:
+    database = get_db()
+    database.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+    existing = database.execute(
+        "SELECT status FROM ai_usage_reservations WHERE request_id = ?", (request_id,)
+    ).fetchone()
+    if existing is not None:
+        database.rollback()
+        raise UsageError("duplicate_usage_request", "Esta solicitação já foi processada.", 409)
+    project = database.execute(
+        "SELECT 1 FROM projects WHERE id = ? AND account_id = ?", (project_id, account_id)
+    ).fetchone()
+    if project is None:
+        database.rollback()
+        raise UsageError("project_not_found", "Projeto não encontrado.", 404)
+    account = database.execute(
+        "SELECT email, ai_limit, ai_used FROM accounts WHERE id = ?", (account_id,)
+    ).fetchone()
+    if account is None:
+        database.rollback()
+        raise UsageError("account_not_found", "Conta não encontrada.", 401)
+    admin_emails = current_app.config.get("ADMIN_EMAILS", set())
+    is_admin = str(account["email"] or "").lower() in admin_emails
+    if not is_admin and int(account["ai_used"] or 0) >= int(account["ai_limit"] or 0):
+        database.rollback()
+        raise UsageError("ai_quota_exhausted", "O limite de assistência desta conta foi atingido.", 429)
+    now = int(time.time())
+    database.execute(
+        "INSERT INTO ai_usage_reservations (request_id, account_id, project_id, action, units, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 1, 'reserved', ?, ?)",
+        (request_id, account_id, project_id, action, now, now),
+    )
+    database.execute("UPDATE accounts SET ai_used = ai_used + 1 WHERE id = ?", (account_id,))
+    database.commit()
+
+
+def finish_usage(request_id: str) -> None:
+    database = get_db()
+    database.execute(
+        "UPDATE ai_usage_reservations SET status = 'complete', updated_at = ? WHERE request_id = ? AND status = 'reserved'",
+        (int(time.time()), request_id),
+    )
+    database.commit()
+
+
+def refund_usage(request_id: str) -> None:
+    database = get_db()
+    database.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+    row = database.execute(
+        "SELECT account_id FROM ai_usage_reservations WHERE request_id = ? AND status = 'reserved'",
+        (request_id,),
+    ).fetchone()
+    if row is not None:
+        database.execute(
+            "UPDATE ai_usage_reservations SET status = 'refunded', updated_at = ? WHERE request_id = ?",
+            (int(time.time()), request_id),
+        )
+        database.execute(
+            "UPDATE accounts SET ai_used = CASE WHEN ai_used > 0 THEN ai_used - 1 ELSE 0 END WHERE id = ?",
+            (row["account_id"],),
+        )
+    database.commit()
+
+
+def record_provider_usage(request_id: str, provider: str, operation: str, model: str, status: str, usage: dict | None = None) -> None:
+    usage = usage if isinstance(usage, dict) else {}
+    database = get_db()
+    database.execute(
+        "INSERT INTO provider_usage (request_id, provider, operation, model, input_tokens, output_tokens, status, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
+        (
+            request_id,
+            provider[:80],
+            operation[:120],
+            model[:160],
+            usage.get("prompt_tokens", usage.get("input_tokens")) if isinstance(usage.get("prompt_tokens", usage.get("input_tokens")), int) else None,
+            usage.get("completion_tokens", usage.get("output_tokens")) if isinstance(usage.get("completion_tokens", usage.get("output_tokens")), int) else None,
+            status[:40],
+            int(time.time()),
+        ),
+    )
+    database.commit()
diff --git a/app/store/db.py b/app/store/db.py
@@ -0,0 +1,159 @@
+import sqlite3
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from flask import current_app, g
+
+
+def get_db():
+    if "db" not in g:
+        database = Path(current_app.config["DATABASE"])
+        database.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        connection = sqlite3.connect(database)
+        connection.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
+        connection.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
+        connection.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL")
+        connection.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000")
+        g.db = connection
+    return g.db
+
+
+def close_db(_error=None):
+    connection = g.pop("db", None)
+    if connection is not None:
+        connection.close()
+
+
+def _remove_automatic_messaging(database):
+    columns = {row["name"] for row in database.execute("PRAGMA table_info(accounts)")}
+    outbox = database.execute(
+        "SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'notification_outbox'"
+    ).fetchone()
+    old_columns = {"whatsapp_phone", "whatsapp_opt_in", "whatsapp_opt_in_at", "whatsapp_opt_out_at"} & columns
+    if not old_columns and outbox is None:
+        return
+    database.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = OFF")
+    try:
+        database.execute("BEGIN")
+        if outbox is not None:
+            database.execute("DROP TABLE notification_outbox")
+        for name in sorted(old_columns):
+            database.execute(f"ALTER TABLE accounts DROP COLUMN {name}")
+        database.execute("UPDATE app_meta SET value = '11' WHERE key = 'schema_version'")
+        database.commit()
+    except Exception:
+        database.rollback()
+        raise
+    finally:
+        database.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
+
+
+def _migrate_schema_v12(database):
+    """Migração para schema v12 - funcionalidades do legado"""
+    # Novas colunas em accounts
+    account_columns = {row["name"] for row in database.execute("PRAGMA table_info(accounts)")}
+    account_additions = {
+        "sharing_preferences_version": "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1",
+        "sharing_allow_admin_view": "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0",
+        "sharing_allow_admin_comments": "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0",
+        "sharing_inherit_default": "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1",
+        "deletion_request_pending": "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0",
+        "ai_analysis_limit": "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0",
+        "deepseek_explanation_limit": "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0",
+    }
+    for name, definition in account_additions.items():
+        if name not in account_columns:
+            database.execute(f"ALTER TABLE accounts ADD COLUMN {name} {definition}")
+
+    # Nova coluna em project_sharing
+    sharing_columns = {row["name"] for row in database.execute("PRAGMA table_info(project_sharing)")}
+    if "inherit_account_default" not in sharing_columns:
+        database.execute("ALTER TABLE project_sharing ADD COLUMN inherit_account_default INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1")
+
+    # Novas tabelas
+    # project_revisions
+    database.execute("""
+        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_revisions (
+            snapshot_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+            project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+            account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+            revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
+            title TEXT NOT NULL,
+            project_type TEXT NOT NULL,
+            payload TEXT NOT NULL,
+            created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
+        )
+    """)
+    database.execute("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_revisions_project ON project_revisions(project_id, revision DESC)")
+
+    # deletion_requests
+    database.execute("""
+        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS deletion_requests (
+            account_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES accounts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+            requested_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id),
+            status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('pending','accepted','rejected')),
+            created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
+            resolved_at INTEGER
+        )
+    """)
+
+    # notification_outbox
+    database.execute("""
+        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notification_outbox (
+            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
+            account_id TEXT REFERENCES accounts(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
+            destination TEXT,
+            kind TEXT NOT NULL,
+            project_id TEXT REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
+            idempotency_key TEXT UNIQUE,
+            text TEXT NOT NULL,
+            status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('pending','processing','sent','failed')),
+            attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
+            next_attempt_at INTEGER,
+            created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
+        )
+    """)
+    database.execute("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_notif_status ON notification_outbox(status, next_attempt_at)")
+
+    # account_grants
+    database.execute("""
+        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS account_grants (
+            grant_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+            account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+            plan_code TEXT NOT NULL,
+            project_credits INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
+            project_consumed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
+            ai_analysis_credits INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
+            ai_analysis_consumed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
+            deepseek_explanation_credits INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
+            deepseek_explanation_consumed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
+            created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
+            expires_at INTEGER
+        )
+    """)
+
+    # Atualizar versão do schema
+    database.execute("UPDATE app_meta SET value = '12' WHERE key = 'schema_version'")
+
+
+def init_db():
+    database = get_db()
+    schema = Path(current_app.root_path) / "store" / "schema.sql"
+    database.executescript(schema.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    _remove_automatic_messaging(database)
+    columns = {row["name"] for row in database.execute("PRAGMA table_info(accounts)")}
+    additions = {"plan_code": "TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'livre'", "project_limit": "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0", "project_used": "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0", "ai_limit": "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0", "ai_used": "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0", "is_blocked": "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0"}
+    added_usage = "project_used" not in columns
+    for name, definition in additions.items():
+        if name not in columns:
+            database.execute(f"ALTER TABLE accounts ADD COLUMN {name} {definition}")
+    if added_usage:
+        database.execute("UPDATE accounts SET project_used = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM projects p WHERE p.account_id = accounts.id)")
+    database.execute("UPDATE projects SET payload = json_remove(payload, '$.timeline') WHERE json_valid(payload) AND json_type(payload, '$.timeline') IS NOT NULL")
+
+    # Migração para v12
+    meta = database.execute("SELECT value FROM app_meta WHERE key = 'schema_version'").fetchone()
+    current_version = int(meta["value"]) if meta else 0
+    if current_version < 12:
+        _migrate_schema_v12(database)
+
+    database.commit()

@@ -0,0 +1,117 @@
+"""Exportação completa de dados da conta (LGPD/GDPR)."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import time
+from typing import Any
+
+from .db import get_db
+from .projects import list_projects, get_project
+from .sources import list_sources
+from .sharing import list_comments
+from .revisions import list_revisions
+
+
+def export_account_data(account_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Exporta todos os dados da conta para LGPD/GDPR."""
+    from .accounts import get_account
+
+    account = get_account(account_id)
+    if not account:
+        raise ValueError("Conta não encontrada")
+
+    # Projetos completos
+    projects_data = []
+    for project in list_projects(account_id):
+        full_project = get_project(account_id, project["id"])
+        if full_project:
+            projects_data.append(full_project)
+
+    # Revisões
+    revisions = []
+    for project in list_projects(account_id):
+        rev_list = list_revisions(project["id"], account_id)
+        for rev in rev_list:
+            revisions.append({
+                "project_id": project["id"],
+                "snapshot_id": rev["snapshot_id"],
+                "revision": rev["revision"],
+                "title": rev["title"],
+                "project_type": rev["project_type"],
+                "payload": rev["payload"],
+                "created_at": rev["created_at"],
+            })
+
+    # Comentários recebidos (como proprietário dos projetos)
+    comments = []
+    for project in list_projects(account_id):
+        proj_comments = list_comments(project["id"])
+        for c in proj_comments:
+            c = dict(c)
+            c["project_id"] = project["id"]
+            comments.append(c)
+
+    # Fontes da biblioteca
+    sources_data = list_sources(account_id)
+
+    # Uso de IA - reservas
+    ai_usage = get_db().execute(
+        """SELECT request_id, action, units, status, created_at, updated_at
+           FROM ai_usage_reservations WHERE account_id = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC""",
+        (account_id,),
+    ).fetchall()
+
+    # Uso de IA - provedores
+    provider_usage = get_db().execute(
+        """SELECT request_id, provider, operation, model, input_tokens, output_tokens, status, created_at
+           FROM provider_usage WHERE account_id = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC""",
+        (account_id,),
+    ).fetchall()
+
+    # Grants
+    grants = get_db().execute(
+        """SELECT grant_id, plan_code, project_credits, project_consumed,
+                  ai_analysis_credits, ai_analysis_consumed,
+                  deepseek_explanation_credits, deepseek_explanation_consumed,
+                  created_at, expires_at
+           FROM account_grants WHERE account_id = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC""",
+        (account_id,),
+    ).fetchall()
+
+    # Sessões
+    sessions = get_db().execute(
+        "SELECT id, created_at, expires_at FROM sessions WHERE account_id = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC",
+        (account_id,),
+    ).fetchall()
+
+    # Pedido de exclusão
+    deletion_request = get_db().execute(
+        "SELECT status, created_at, resolved_at FROM deletion_requests WHERE account_id = ?",
+        (account_id,),
+    ).fetchone()
+
+    # Preferências de compartilhamento
+    sharing_prefs = get_db().execute(
+        """SELECT sharing_preferences_version, sharing_allow_admin_view,
+                  sharing_allow_admin_comments, sharing_inherit_default
+           FROM accounts WHERE id = ?""",
+        (account_id,),
+    ).fetchone()
+
+    return {
+        "account": {
+            **account,
+            "sharing_preferences": dict(sharing_prefs) if sharing_prefs else {},
+            "deletion_request": dict(deletion_request) if deletion_request else None,
+        },
+        "projects": projects_data,
+        "revisions": revisions,
+        "comments": comments,
+        "sources": sources_data,
+        "ai_usage_reservations": [dict(r) for r in ai_usage],
+        "provider_usage": [dict(r) for r in provider_usage],
+        "grants": [dict(r) for r in grants],
+        "sessions": [dict(r) for r in sessions],
+        "exported_at": int(time.time()),
+    }

@@ -0,0 +1,202 @@
+"""Ledger de créditos da conta (account_grants)."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import time
+from uuid import uuid4
+
+from .db import get_db
+
+
+def create_grant(
+    account_id: str,
+    plan_code: str,
+    project_credits: int = 0,
+    ai_analysis_credits: int = 0,
+    deepseek_explanation_credits: int = 0,
+    expires_at: int | None = None,
+) -> str:
+    """Cria um grant de créditos para a conta."""
+    grant_id = str(uuid4())
+    now = int(time.time())
+    db = get_db()
+    db.execute(
+        """INSERT INTO account_grants
+           (grant_id, account_id, plan_code, project_credits, project_consumed,
+            ai_analysis_credits, ai_analysis_consumed,
+            deepseek_explanation_credits, deepseek_explanation_consumed,
+            created_at, expires_at)
+           VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 0, ?, 0, ?, 0, ?, ?)""",
+        (
+            grant_id,
+            account_id,
+            plan_code,
+            project_credits,
+            ai_analysis_credits,
+            deepseek_explanation_credits,
+            now,
+            expires_at,
+        ),
+    )
+    db.commit()
+    return grant_id
+
+
+def list_grants(account_id: str) -> list[dict]:
+    """Lista grants da conta (mais recentes primeiro)."""
+    rows = get_db().execute(
+        """SELECT grant_id, plan_code, project_credits, project_consumed,
+                  ai_analysis_credits, ai_analysis_consumed,
+                  deepseek_explanation_credits, deepseek_explanation_consumed,
+                  created_at, expires_at
+           FROM account_grants
+           WHERE account_id = ?
+           ORDER BY created_at DESC""",
+        (account_id,),
+    ).fetchall()
+    grants = []
+    for row in rows:
+        grants.append({
+            "grant_id": row["grant_id"],
+            "plan_code": row["plan_code"],
+            "project_credits": row["project_credits"],
+            "project_consumed": row["project_consumed"],
+            "project_remaining": row["project_credits"] - row["project_consumed"],
+            "ai_analysis_credits": row["ai_analysis_credits"],
+            "ai_analysis_consumed": row["ai_analysis_consumed"],
+            "ai_analysis_remaining": row["ai_analysis_credits"] - row["ai_analysis_consumed"],
+            "deepseek_explanation_credits": row["deepseek_explanation_credits"],
+            "deepseek_explanation_consumed": row["deepseek_explanation_consumed"],
+            "deepseek_explanation_remaining": row["deepseek_explanation_credits"] - row["deepseek_explanation_consumed"],
+            "created_at": row["created_at"],
+            "expires_at": row["expires_at"],
+        })
+    return grants
+
+
+def consume_project_credit(account_id: str) -> bool:
+    """Consome 1 crédito de projeto do grant mais antigo com saldo (FIFO)."""
+    db = get_db()
+    db.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+    row = db.execute(
+        """SELECT grant_id, project_credits, project_consumed
+           FROM account_grants
+           WHERE account_id = ? AND project_consumed < project_credits
+           ORDER BY created_at ASC
+           LIMIT 1""",
+        (account_id,),
+    ).fetchone()
+    if row is None:
+        db.rollback()
+        return False
+    db.execute(
+        "UPDATE account_grants SET project_consumed = project_consumed + 1 WHERE grant_id = ?",
+        (row["grant_id"],),
+    )
+    db.commit()
+    return True
+
+
+def refund_project_credit(account_id: str) -> bool:
+    """Devolve 1 crédito de projeto (LIFO - devolve do grant mais recente consumido)."""
+    db = get_db()
+    db.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+    row = db.execute(
+        """SELECT grant_id, project_consumed
+           FROM account_grants
+           WHERE account_id = ? AND project_consumed > 0
+           ORDER BY created_at DESC
+           LIMIT 1""",
+        (account_id,),
+    ).fetchone()
+    if row is None:
+        db.rollback()
+        return False
+    db.execute(
+        "UPDATE account_grants SET project_consumed = project_consumed - 1 WHERE grant_id = ?",
+        (row["grant_id"],),
+    )
+    db.commit()
+    return True
+
+
+def consume_ai_analysis_credit(account_id: str) -> bool:
+    """Consome 1 crédito de análise IA (FIFO)."""
+    db = get_db()
+    db.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+    row = db.execute(
+        """SELECT grant_id, ai_analysis_credits, ai_analysis_consumed
+           FROM account_grants
+           WHERE account_id = ? AND ai_analysis_consumed < ai_analysis_credits
+           ORDER BY created_at ASC
+           LIMIT 1""",
+        (account_id,),
+    ).fetchone()
+    if row is None:
+        db.rollback()
+        return False
+    db.execute(
+        "UPDATE account_grants SET ai_analysis_consumed = ai_analysis_consumed + 1 WHERE grant_id = ?",
+        (row["grant_id"],),
+    )
+    db.commit()
+    return True
+
+
+def consume_deepseek_explanation_credit(account_id: str) -> bool:
+    """Consome 1 crédito de explicação DeepSeek (FIFO)."""
+    db = get_db()
+    db.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+    row = db.execute(
+        """SELECT grant_id, deepseek_explanation_credits, deepseek_explanation_consumed
+           FROM account_grants
+           WHERE account_id = ? AND deepseek_explanation_consumed < deepseek_explanation_credits
+           ORDER BY created_at ASC
+           LIMIT 1""",
+        (account_id,),
+    ).fetchone()
+    if row is None:
+        db.rollback()
+        return False
+    db.execute(
+        "UPDATE account_grants SET deepseek_explanation_consumed = deepseek_explanation_consumed + 1 WHERE grant_id = ?",
+        (row["grant_id"],),
+    )
+    db.commit()
+    return True
+
+
+def get_available_credits(account_id: str) -> dict:
+    """Retorna créditos disponíveis agregados (soma de todos os grants não expirados)."""
+    now = int(time.time())
+    rows = get_db().execute(
+        """SELECT
+            SUM(project_credits - project_consumed) as project_remaining,
+            SUM(ai_analysis_credits - ai_analysis_consumed) as ai_analysis_remaining,
+            SUM(deepseek_explanation_credits - deepseek_explanation_consumed) as deepseek_explanation_remaining
+           FROM account_grants
+           WHERE account_id = ? AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > ?)""",
+        (account_id, now),
+    ).fetchone()
+    return {
+        "project": max(0, rows["project_remaining"] or 0),
+        "ai_analysis": max(0, rows["ai_analysis_remaining"] or 0),
+        "deepseek_explanation": max(0, rows["deepseek_explanation_remaining"] or 0),
+    }
+
+
+def get_grants_summary(account_id: str) -> dict:
+    """Retorna resumo detalhado dos grants para exibição no admin/perfil."""
+    return {"grants": list_grants(account_id)}
+
+
+def cleanup_expired_grants() -> int:
+    """Remove grants expirados (opcional, rodar periodicamente)."""
+    now = int(time.time())
+    db = get_db()
+    cursor = db.execute(
+        "DELETE FROM account_grants WHERE expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at < ?",
+        (now,),
+    )
+    db.commit()
+    return cursor.rowcount

@@ -0,0 +1,157 @@
+"""Fila de notificações (notification_outbox) - sem envio WhatsApp."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sqlite3
+import time
+from uuid import uuid4
+from typing import Any
+
+from .db import get_db
+
+
+NOTIFICATION_KINDS = {
+    "admin_comment",
+    "project_shared",
+    "ai_analysis_ready",
+    "quarto_export_ready",
+    "system_announcement",
+    "deletion_requested",
+    "deletion_confirmed",
+}
+
+
+def enqueue_notification(
+    kind: str,
+    text: str,
+    account_id: str | None = None,
+    project_id: str | None = None,
+    destination: str | None = None,
+    idempotency_key: str | None = None,
+    next_attempt_at: int | None = None,
+) -> int | None:
+    """Adiciona notificação à fila de saída."""
+    if kind not in NOTIFICATION_KINDS:
+        raise ValueError(f"Tipo de notificação inválido: {kind}")
+    if not text or not text.strip():
+        raise ValueError("Texto da notificação não pode ser vazio")
+
+    if idempotency_key is None:
+        idempotency_key = f"{kind}:{account_id or 'global'}:{project_id or 'none'}:{uuid4().hex[:16]}"
+
+    now = int(time.time())
+    if next_attempt_at is None:
+        next_attempt_at = now
+
+    db = get_db()
+    db.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+    try:
+        cursor = db.execute(
+            """INSERT INTO notification_outbox
+               (account_id, destination, kind, project_id, idempotency_key, text, status, attempts, next_attempt_at, created_at)
+               VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'pending', 0, ?, ?)""",
+            (account_id, destination, kind, project_id, idempotency_key, text.strip()[:3000], next_attempt_at, now),
+        )
+        notification_id = cursor.lastrowid
+        db.commit()
+        return notification_id
+    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:
+        # Chave idempotente duplicada - ignora silenciosamente
+        db.rollback()
+        return None
+    except Exception:
+        db.rollback()
+        raise
+
+
+def get_pending_notifications(limit: int = 100) -> list[dict]:
+    """Obtém notificações pendentes para processamento."""
+    rows = get_db().execute(
+        """SELECT id, account_id, destination, kind, project_id, idempotency_key, text, attempts, next_attempt_at, created_at
+           FROM notification_outbox
+           WHERE status = 'pending' AND next_attempt_at <= ?
+           ORDER BY created_at ASC
+           LIMIT ?""",
+        (int(time.time()), limit),
+    ).fetchall()
+    return [dict(row) for row in rows]
+
+
+def mark_notification_processing(notification_id: int) -> bool:
+    """Marca notificação como em processamento."""
+    db = get_db()
+    cursor = db.execute(
+        "UPDATE notification_outbox SET status = 'processing', attempts = attempts + 1 WHERE id = ? AND status = 'pending'",
+        (notification_id,),
+    )
+    db.commit()
+    return cursor.rowcount > 0
+
+
+def mark_notification_sent(notification_id: int) -> bool:
+    """Marca notificação como enviada."""
+    db = get_db()
+    cursor = db.execute(
+        "UPDATE notification_outbox SET status = 'sent', next_attempt_at = NULL WHERE id = ?",
+        (notification_id,),
+    )
+    db.commit()
+    return cursor.rowcount > 0
+
+
+def mark_notification_failed(notification_id: int, next_retry_seconds: int = 300) -> bool:
+    """Marca notificação como falha e agenda nova tentativa."""
+    next_attempt = int(time.time()) + next_retry_seconds
+    db = get_db()
+    cursor = db.execute(
+        "UPDATE notification_outbox SET status = 'failed', next_attempt_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
+        (next_attempt, notification_id),
+    )
+    db.commit()
+    return cursor.rowcount > 0
+
+
+def list_account_notifications(account_id: str, limit: int = 50, status: str | None = None) -> list[dict]:
+    """Lista notificações de uma conta (para exibição no perfil/admin)."""
+    query = """SELECT id, kind, project_id, text, status, attempts, created_at, next_attempt_at
+               FROM notification_outbox WHERE account_id = ?"""
+    params = [account_id]
+    if status:
+        query += " AND status = ?"
+        params.append(status)
+    query += " ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT ?"
+    params.append(limit)
+
+    rows = get_db().execute(query, tuple(params)).fetchall()
+    return [dict(row) for row in rows]
+
+
+def get_notification_stats() -> dict:
+    """Estatísticas da fila de notificações (para admin dashboard)."""
+    db = get_db()
+    rows = db.execute(
+        """SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count
+           FROM notification_outbox
+           GROUP BY status"""
+    ).fetchall()
+    stats = {row["status"]: row["count"] for row in rows}
+    # Total de hoje
+    today_start = int(time.time()) - (int(time.time()) % 86400)
+    today_count = db.execute(
+        "SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM notification_outbox WHERE created_at >= ?",
+        (today_start,),
+    ).fetchone()
+    stats["today"] = today_count["count"] if today_count else 0
+    return stats
+
+
+def cleanup_old_notifications(days: int = 30) -> int:
+    """Remove notificações antigas (enviadas/falhadas)."""
+    cutoff = int(time.time()) - (days * 86400)
+    db = get_db()
+    cursor = db.execute(
+        "DELETE FROM notification_outbox WHERE status IN ('sent', 'failed') AND created_at < ?",
+        (cutoff,),
+    )
+    db.commit()
+    return cursor.rowcount

diff --git a/app/store/projects.py b/app/store/projects.py
@@ -0,0 +1,185 @@
+import json
+import time
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta
+from uuid import uuid4
+
+try:
+    from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
+except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover - Python suportado já inclui zoneinfo.
+    ZoneInfo = None
+
+from .db import get_db
+from ..domain.schedule import normalize_schedule, schedule_deadlines, schedule_summary
+
+
+def _edit_date(timestamp: int | None = None) -> str:
+    moment = datetime.fromtimestamp(timestamp or time.time(), ZoneInfo("America/Sao_Paulo")) if ZoneInfo else datetime.now()
+    return moment.date().isoformat()
+
+
+class ProjectConflict(Exception):
+    def __init__(self, current_revision):
+        self.current_revision = current_revision
+        super().__init__("A versão do projeto mudou em outra sessão.")
+
+
+class ProjectQuotaError(RuntimeError):
+    """A conta não possui crédito de projeto disponível."""
+
+
+def _row_payload(row):
+    payload = json.loads(row["payload"])
+    payload.pop("timeline", None)
+    payload["id"] = row["id"]
+    payload["project_type"] = row["project_type"]
+    payload["title"] = row["title"]
+    payload["revision"] = row["revision"]
+    return payload
+
+
+def create_project(account_id, project_type):
+    project_id = str(uuid4())
+    now = int(time.time())
+    from .accounts import get_account
+    database = get_db()
+    database.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+    account = get_account(account_id)
+    if account is None:
+        database.rollback()
+        raise ProjectQuotaError("Conta não encontrada.")
+    if not account["unlimited"] and int(account["project_remaining"] or 0) <= 0:
+        database.rollback()
+        raise ProjectQuotaError("A conta não possui crédito de projeto disponível.")
+    profile = account.get("profile", {})
+    fields = {"title": "", "authors": account.get("name", ""), **{key: profile.get(key, "") for key in ("institution", "course", "city")}}
+    payload = {"version": 1, "fields": fields, "source_ids": [], "criteria": [], "deliveries": {}, "schedule": {"report_date": "", "debate_date": "", "dissertation_date": "", "final_date": "", "tasks": []}}
+    database.execute(
+        """INSERT INTO projects
+           (id, account_id, project_type, title, revision, payload, created_at, updated_at)
+           VALUES (?, ?, ?, '', 1, ?, ?, ?)""",
+        (project_id, account_id, project_type, json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False), now, now),
+    )
+    database.execute("UPDATE accounts SET project_used = project_used + 1 WHERE id = ?", (account_id,))
+    database.commit()
+    return project_id
+
+
+def delete_project(account_id, project_id):
+    """Exclui um projeto do proprietário e reduz o contador de projetos."""
+    database = get_db()
+    database.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+    row = database.execute(
+        "SELECT id FROM projects WHERE id = ? AND account_id = ?",
+        (project_id, account_id),
+    ).fetchone()
+    if row is None:
+        database.rollback()
+        return False
+    database.execute("DELETE FROM projects WHERE id = ? AND account_id = ?", (project_id, account_id))
+    database.execute(
+        "UPDATE accounts SET project_used = CASE WHEN project_used > 0 THEN project_used - 1 ELSE 0 END WHERE id = ?",
+        (account_id,),
+    )
+    database.commit()
+    return True
+
+
+def list_projects(account_id):
+    rows = get_db().execute(
+        "SELECT id, project_type, title, revision, updated_at, payload FROM projects WHERE account_id = ? ORDER BY updated_at DESC",
+        (account_id,),
+    ).fetchall()
+    projects = []
+    for row in rows:
+        project = {key: row[key] for key in ("id", "project_type", "title", "revision", "updated_at")}
+        try:
+            payload = json.loads(row["payload"])
+        except (TypeError, ValueError, json.JSONDecodeError):
+            payload = {}
+        fields = payload.get("fields") if isinstance(payload, dict) else {}
+        fields = fields if isinstance(fields, dict) else {}
+        schedule = normalize_schedule(
+            payload.get("schedule") if isinstance(payload, dict) else {},
+            fields.get("deliveryDate", ""),
+            row["project_type"],
+        )
+        project["deadlines"] = schedule_deadlines(schedule, row["project_type"], row["id"], row["title"])
+        project["schedule_summary"] = schedule_summary(schedule, row["project_type"])
+        projects.append(project)
+    return projects
+
+
+def get_project(account_id, project_id):
+    row = get_db().execute(
+        "SELECT * FROM projects WHERE id = ? AND account_id = ?",
+        (project_id, account_id),
+    ).fetchone()
+    return _row_payload(row) if row else None
+
+
+def save_project(account_id, project_id, expected_revision, payload):
+    database = get_db()
+    now = int(time.time())
+    title = str(payload.get("fields", {}).get("title") or "")[:240]
+    encoded = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
+    database.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+    row = database.execute(
+        "SELECT revision FROM projects WHERE id = ? AND account_id = ?",
+        (project_id, account_id),
+    ).fetchone()
+    if row is None:
+        database.rollback()
+        return None
+    if int(expected_revision) != int(row["revision"]):
+        database.rollback()
+        raise ProjectConflict(row["revision"])
+    next_revision = int(row["revision"]) + 1
+    database.execute(
+        """UPDATE projects SET title = ?, revision = ?, payload = ?, updated_at = ?
+           WHERE id = ? AND account_id = ?""",
+        (title, next_revision, encoded, now, project_id, account_id),
+    )
+    edit_date = _edit_date(now)
+    database.execute(
+        """INSERT INTO project_edit_days (account_id, project_id, edit_date, edit_count, updated_at)
+           VALUES (?, ?, ?, 1, ?)
+           ON CONFLICT(project_id, edit_date) DO UPDATE SET
+             edit_count = project_edit_days.edit_count + 1,
+             updated_at = excluded.updated_at""",
+        (account_id, project_id, edit_date, now),
+    )
+    cutoff = (datetime.fromtimestamp(now, ZoneInfo("America/Sao_Paulo")) - timedelta(days=365)).date().isoformat() if ZoneInfo else ""
+    if cutoff:
+        database.execute("DELETE FROM project_edit_days WHERE account_id = ? AND edit_date < ?", (account_id, cutoff))
+    database.commit()
+    return next_revision
+
+
+def list_edit_activity(account_id, start_date: str, end_date: str) -> list[dict]:
+    rows = get_db().execute(
+        """SELECT edit_date AS date, SUM(edit_count) AS count
+           FROM project_edit_days
+           WHERE account_id = ? AND edit_date >= ? AND edit_date < ?
+           GROUP BY edit_date ORDER BY edit_date""",
+        (account_id, start_date, end_date),
+    ).fetchall()
+    return [{"date": row["date"], "count": int(row["count"] or 0)} for row in rows]
+
+
+def switch_paper_mode(account_id, project_id, project_type, expected_revision):
+    """Alterna Projeto/Paper Final mantendo identidade, fontes e planejamento."""
+    if project_type not in {"paper_project", "paper_final"}:
+        raise ValueError("Roteiro de Paper inválido.")
+    db = get_db()
+    db.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+    row = db.execute("SELECT project_type, revision FROM projects WHERE id = ? AND account_id = ?", (project_id, account_id)).fetchone()
+    if row is None or row["project_type"] not in {"paper_project", "paper_final"}:
+        db.rollback()
+        return None
+    if int(expected_revision) != row["revision"]:
+        db.rollback()
+        raise ProjectConflict(row["revision"])
+    revision = row["revision"] + 1
+    db.execute("UPDATE projects SET project_type = ?, revision = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?", (project_type, revision, int(time.time()), project_id))
+    db.commit()
+    return revision
diff --git a/app/store/revisions.py b/app/store/revisions.py
@@ -0,0 +1,173 @@
+"""Operações de revisão de projetos (histórico, diff, retenção 30)."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import time
+from uuid import uuid4
+
+from .db import get_db
+
+
+MAX_REVISIONS_PER_PROJECT = 30
+MAX_REVISION_AGE_DAYS = 30
+
+
+def create_revision(
+    account_id: str,
+    project_id: str,
+    revision: int,
+    title: str,
+    project_type: str,
+    payload: dict,
+) -> str:
+    """Cria um snapshot de revisão do projeto."""
+    snapshot_id = str(uuid4())
+    now = int(time.time())
+    db = get_db()
+    db.execute(
+        """INSERT INTO project_revisions
+           (snapshot_id, project_id, account_id, revision, title, project_type, payload, created_at)
+           VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)""",
+        (
+            snapshot_id,
+            project_id,
+            account_id,
+            revision,
+            title[:240],
+            project_type,
+            json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")),
+            now,
+        ),
+    )
+    # Limpeza: manter apenas as últimas MAX_REVISIONS_PER_PROJECT revisões
+    db.execute(
+        """DELETE FROM project_revisions
+           WHERE project_id = ? AND snapshot_id NOT IN (
+               SELECT snapshot_id FROM project_revisions
+               WHERE project_id = ?
+               ORDER BY revision DESC LIMIT ?
+           )""",
+        (project_id, project_id, MAX_REVISIONS_PER_PROJECT),
+    )
+    # Limpeza por idade (opcional, rodar periodicamente)
+    db.commit()
+    return snapshot_id
+
+
+def list_revisions(project_id: str, account_id: str) -> list[dict]:
+    """Lista revisões de um projeto (mais recentes primeiro)."""
+    rows = get_db().execute(
+        """SELECT snapshot_id, revision, title, project_type, payload, created_at
+           FROM project_revisions
+           WHERE project_id = ? AND account_id = ?
+           ORDER BY revision DESC""",
+        (project_id, account_id),
+    ).fetchall()
+    return [
+        {
+            "snapshot_id": row["snapshot_id"],
+            "revision": row["revision"],
+            "title": row["title"],
+            "project_type": row["project_type"],
+            "payload": json.loads(row["payload"]),
+            "created_at": row["created_at"],
+        }
+        for row in rows
+    ]
+
+
+def get_revision(account_id: str, project_id: str, snapshot_id: str) -> dict | None:
+    """Obtém uma revisão específica."""
+    row = get_db().execute(
+        """SELECT snapshot_id, revision, title, project_type, payload, created_at
+           FROM project_revisions
+           WHERE project_id = ? AND account_id = ? AND snapshot_id = ?""",
+        (project_id, account_id, snapshot_id),
+    ).fetchone()
+    if row is None:
+        return None
+    return {
+        "snapshot_id": row["snapshot_id"],
+        "revision": row["revision"],
+        "title": row["title"],
+        "project_type": row["project_type"],
+        "payload": json.loads(row["payload"]),
+        "created_at": row["created_at"],
+    }
+
+
+def diff_revisions(
+    account_id: str,
+    project_id: str,
+    snapshot_id_a: str,
+    snapshot_id_b: str,
+) -> dict | None:
+    """Compara duas revisões e retorna diff simplificado."""
+    rev_a = get_revision(account_id, project_id, snapshot_id_a)
+    rev_b = get_revision(account_id, project_id, snapshot_id_b)
+    if not rev_a or not rev_b:
+        return None
+
+    payload_a = rev_a.get("payload", {})
+    payload_b = rev_b.get("payload", {})
+
+    fields_a = payload_a.get("fields", {}) if isinstance(payload_a, dict) else {}
+    fields_b = payload_b.get("fields", {}) if isinstance(payload_b, dict) else {}
+
+    all_keys = set(fields_a.keys()) | set(fields_b.keys())
+    diff = {}
+    for key in sorted(all_keys):
+        val_a = fields_a.get(key, "")
+        val_b = fields_b.get(key, "")
+        if val_a != val_b:
+            diff[key] = {"from": val_a, "to": val_b}
+
+    return {
+        "revision_a": {"snapshot_id": snapshot_id_a, "revision": rev_a["revision"], "title": rev_a["title"]},
+        "revision_b": {"snapshot_id": snapshot_id_b, "revision": rev_b["revision"], "title": rev_b["title"]},
+        "fields_diff": diff,
+    }
+
+
+def restore_revision(
+    account_id: str,
+    project_id: str,
+    snapshot_id: str,
+    expected_revision: int,
+) -> int | None:
+    """Restaura uma revisão anterior como nova revisão do projeto."""
+    from .projects import save_project, ProjectConflict, get_project
+
+    revision_data = get_revision(account_id, project_id, snapshot_id)
+    if not revision_data:
+        return None
+
+    current = get_project(account_id, project_id)
+    if current is None:
+        return None
+
+    # Usa o payload da revisão como novo payload
+    payload = revision_data["payload"]
+    try:
+        next_revision = save_project(account_id, project_id, expected_revision, payload)
+        return next_revision
+    except ProjectConflict:
+        raise
+    except Exception:
+        return None
+
+
+def cleanup_old_revisions(account_id: str | None = None) -> int:
+    """Remove revisões antigas (> MAX_REVISION_AGE_DAYS). Retorna quantidade removida."""
+    cutoff = int(time.time()) - (MAX_REVISION_AGE_DAYS * 86400)
+    db = get_db()
+    if account_id:
+        cursor = db.execute(
+            "DELETE FROM project_revisions WHERE account_id = ? AND created_at < ?",
+            (account_id, cutoff),
+        )
+    else:
+        cursor = db.execute("DELETE FROM project_revisions WHERE created_at < ?", (cutoff,))
+    db.commit()
+    return cursor.rowcount
