+}
+
+.ai-analysis-controls h3 { margin: 0; font-size: var(--text-3xl); }
+.ai-analysis-controls .field-hint { margin: 0; }
+.ai-analysis-controls .button { width: auto; }
+
+.review-actions {
+  display: flex;
+  flex-wrap: wrap;
+  gap: var(--space-10);
+  margin: 0;
+}
+
+/* ==========================================================================

+   ========================================================================== */
+.delivery-control { display: grid; gap: var(--space-6); justify-items: start; }

+

+}
+
+.phase-next h3 { margin: 0; font-size: var(--text-md); }
+
+/* ==========================================================================
+   Stage AI Tools
+   ========================================================================== */
+.stage-ai-tools {
+  margin: var(--space-12) 0;
+  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
+  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
+  background: var(--color-bg-elevated);
+}
+
+.stage-ai-tools > summary {

+  align-items: center;
+  gap: var(--space-12);
+  min-height: var(--btn-height-xl);
+  padding: var(--space-12) var(--space-16);
+  color: var(--color-text);
+  cursor: pointer;
+  list-style: none;

+}
+
+.stage-ai-tools > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
+.stage-ai-tools > summary::after { content: "+"; flex: 0 0 auto; margin-left: auto; color: var(--color-text-muted); font-size: var(--text-2xl); line-height: 1; }
+.stage-ai-tools[open] > summary::after { content: "−"; }
+
+.stage-ai-title {

+  align-items: center;
+  gap: var(--space-7);
+  color: var(--color-text);
+  font-weight: var(--font-weight-medium);
+}
+
+.stage-ai-title svg { color: var(--color-accent); }
+
+.stage-ai-body { display: grid; gap: var(--space-12); padding: 0 var(--space-16) var(--space-16); }
+
+.stage-ai-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--space-12); padding-top: var(--space-2); }
+
+.stage-ai-result,
+.field-ai-result { display: grid; gap: var(--space-10); }
+
+.field-ai-result:empty { display: none; }
+
+.ai-response-card {

+  gap: var(--space-9);
+  margin-top: var(--space-10);
+  padding: var(--space-14);
+  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
+  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
+  background: var(--color-bg-control);
+}
+
+.ai-response-card p { margin: 0; font-size: var(--text-sm); line-height: 1.6; }
+
+.ai-suggestion-list,
+.ai-jev-list { display: grid; gap: var(--space-8); margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
+
+.ai-suggestion-item,
+.ai-jev-item {
+  display: grid;
+  gap: var(--space-7);
+  padding: var(--space-11) var(--space-12);
+  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
+  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
+  background: var(--color-bg-elevated);
+}
+
+.ai-suggestion-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--space-10); }
+
+.ai-validation {
+  padding: var(--space-10) var(--space-12);
+  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
+  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
+  background: var(--color-accent-soft);
+  font-size: var(--text-base);
+  line-height: 1.5;
+}
+
+.stage-ai-result:empty { display: none; }
+
+.ai-score { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--color-accent); font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold); }
+
+.ai-score-bar {
+  height: var(--progress-height);
+  overflow: hidden;
+  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
+  background: #292929;
+}
+
+.ai-score-bar span {
+  display: block;
+  height: 100%;
+  background: var(--color-accent);
+  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
+}
+
+/* ==========================================================================
+   Step Phase Tabs (Mobile)
+   ========================================================================== */
+.step-phase-tabs { display: none; }
+
+/* ==========================================================================
+   Responsive
+   ========================================================================== */
+/* Sidebar responsive breakpoints */
+@media (max-width: 1100px) {
+  .workspace { grid-template-columns: var(--sidebar-width-collapsed) minmax(0, 1fr); }
+  .step-link { grid-template-columns: 25px minmax(0, 1fr); }
+  .step-index { display: none; }
+  .step-nav-phase { padding-left: var(--space-8); }
+}
+
+@media (max-width: 900px) {
+  .workspace { grid-template-columns: var(--sidebar-width) minmax(0, 1fr); }
+  .step-link { grid-template-columns: 25px minmax(0, 1fr) 16px; }
+  .step-index { display: block; }
+  .step-nav-phase { padding-left: 0; }
+}
+
+@media (max-width: 680px) {
+  .app-heading {
+    flex-direction: column;
+    gap: var(--space-12);
+  }
+  .app-heading-actions { justify-content: flex-start; }
+  .workspace { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: var(--space-14); }
+  .step-nav {
+    display: flex;
+    gap: var(--space-5);
+    overflow-x: auto;
+    padding-bottom: var(--space-3);
+  }
+  .step-link {
+    min-width: 150px;
+    width: auto;
+    grid-template-columns: 22px minmax(0, 1fr) 14px;
+    padding: var(--space-9) var(--space-8);
+  }
+  .step-nav-phase,
+  .step-link.is-other-phase { display: none; }
+  .step-card { padding: var(--space-21) var(--space-18); }
+  .step-phase-tabs {
+    display: flex;
+    gap: var(--space-4);
+    padding: var(--space-3);
+    margin-bottom: var(--space-10);
+    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
+    border-radius: var(--radius-card);
+  }
+  .step-phase-tab {
+    flex: 1;
+    min-width: 0;
+    border: 0;
+    padding: var(--space-8) var(--space-6);
+    background: transparent;
+    color: var(--color-text-muted);
+    font-size: var(--text-sm);
+  }
+  .step-phase-tab[aria-pressed=true] {
+    background: var(--color-accent-soft);
+    color: var(--color-text);
+  }
+  .step-actions { gap: var(--space-8); }
+  .step-actions .button { padding: var(--space-9) var(--space-11); }
+  .form-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
+  .task-row { grid-template-columns: 22px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; }
+  .task-row-date { grid-column: 2; }
+  .task-row .text-button { grid-column: 2 / -1; justify-self: start; }
+  .progress-summary { flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-4); }
+  .stage-ai-tools > summary { padding-top: var(--space-10); }
+}
+
+/* ==========================================================================
+   Reduced Motion
+   ========================================================================== */
+@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
+  *,
+  *::before,
+  *::after {
+    scroll-behavior: auto !important;
+    transition: none !important;
+  }
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,155 @@
+/**
+ * Library Styles - Assistente Acadêmico
+ * Uses design tokens from tokens.css
+ */
+
+@import "tokens.css";
+
+/* ==========================================================================
+   Library Heading
+   ========================================================================== */
+.library-heading h1 { font-size: var(--text-7xl); }
+.library-heading .lead { font-size: var(--text-sm); margin: 0; }
+.library-heading { margin-bottom: var(--space-22); }
+
+/* ==========================================================================
+   Source Row
+   ========================================================================== */
+.source-row[hidden] { display: none !important; }
+
+.library-add {
+  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
+  background: var(--color-bg-elevated);
+  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
+  margin-bottom: var(--space-20);
+}
+
+.library-add > summary {
+  padding: var(--space-12) var(--space-16);
+  font-size: var(--text-sm);
+  cursor: pointer;
+  list-style: none;
+}
+
+.library-add > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
+
+.library-add-form {
+  display: grid;
+  gap: var(--space-14);
+  padding: 0 var(--space-16) var(--space-16);
+}
+
+.library-fields,
+.source-edit-grid {
+  display: grid;
+  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
+  gap: var(--space-14) var(--space-12);
+}
+
+.library-fields label,
+.source-edit-grid label {
+  font-size: var(--text-sm);
+  font-weight: var(--font-weight-medium);
+}
+
+.library-fields input,
+.library-fields select,
+.source-edit-grid input,
+.source-edit-grid select {
+  min-height: var(--input-height-md);
+  font-size: var(--text-md);
+  padding: var(--input-padding-y) var(--input-padding-x);
+  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
+  border-radius: var(--radius-input);
+  background: var(--color-bg-control);
+  color: var(--color-text);
+}
+
+.library-add-form .button {
+  justify-self: start;
+  font-size: var(--text-sm);
+}
+
+.library-filter {
+  max-width: 650px;
+  margin: var(--space-16) 0;
+  font-size: var(--text-base);
+}
+
+.library-filter input { font-size: var(--text-md); }
+
+.source-row {
+  padding: var(--space-16) 0;
+  border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border);
+}
+
+.source-row-head {
+  display: flex;
+  align-items: start;
+  justify-content: space-between;
+  gap: var(--space-16);
+}
+
+.source-row h3 { font-size: var(--text-3xl); margin: 0 0 var(--space-6); }
+
+.source-actions {
+  display: flex;
+  align-items: center;
+  gap: var(--space-14);
+}
+
+.source-actions form { margin: 0; }
+
+.source-actions .text-button {
+  padding: 0;
+  border: 0;
+  background: transparent;
+  color: var(--color-text-muted);
+  font-size: var(--text-base);
+  text-decoration: none;
+  cursor: pointer;
+}
+
+.source-actions .danger-text { color: var(--color-danger); }
+
+.source-reference,
+.source-no-note {
+  font-size: var(--text-base);
+  color: var(--color-text-muted);
+  line-height: 1.5;
+  margin: var(--space-6) 0;
+  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
+}
+
+.source-note { margin: var(--space-10) 0; font-size: var(--text-base); color: var(--color-text-muted); }
+.source-note summary,
+.source-editor > summary { cursor: pointer; list-style: none; }
+.source-note summary::-webkit-details-marker,
+.source-editor > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
+.source-note p { white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
+
+.source-editor { margin-top: var(--space-10); font-size: var(--text-base); }
+.source-editor > summary { color: var(--color-text-muted); }
+
+.source-editor form {
+  padding: var(--space-14);
+  margin-top: var(--space-10);
+  background: var(--color-bg-elevated);
+  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
+  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
+}
+
+.source-edit-notes { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
+
+.source-edit-actions {
+  display: flex;
+  gap: var(--space-10);
+  margin-top: var(--space-14);
+}
+
+@media (max-width: 700px) {
+  .library-fields,
+  .source-edit-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
+  .source-row-head { flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-8); }
+  .source-edit-actions { flex-wrap: wrap; }
+}

diff --git a/static/css/marketing.css b/static/css/marketing.css
@@ -0,0 +1,816 @@
+/**
+ * Marketing/Sales Page Styles - Assistente Acadêmico
+ * Uses design tokens from tokens.css
+ * Legacy --sales-* custom properties mapped to tokens for backwards compatibility
+ */
+
+@import "tokens.css";
+
+/* ==========================================================================
+   Sales Page Base
+   ========================================================================== */
+.sales-shell {
+  width: min(var(--container-wide), var(--container-full));
+  margin: 0 auto;
+  color: var(--color-text);
+}
+
+.sales-page {
+  --sales-bg: var(--color-bg);
+  --sales-paper: var(--color-bg-elevated);
+  --sales-soft: var(--color-bg-soft);
+  --sales-line: var(--color-border);
+  --sales-line-strong: var(--color-border-strong);
+  --sales-ink: var(--color-text);
+  --sales-muted: var(--color-text-muted);
+  --sales-dim: var(--color-text-dim);
+  --sales-radius: var(--radius-card);
+
+  max-width: var(--container-wide);
+  margin: 0 auto;
+  padding: 0 0 var(--space-46);
+  color: var(--color-text);
+  font-size: var(--text-md);
+  line-height: var(--leading-body);
+}
+
+.sales-page *,
+.sales-page *::before,
+.sales-page *::after {
+  box-sizing: border-box;
+}
+
+.sales-page h1,
+.sales-page h2,
+.sales-page h3,
+.sales-page p { margin-top: 0; }
+
+.sales-page h1,
+.sales-page h2,
+.sales-page h3,
+.sales-page strong { color: var(--color-text); }
+
+.sales-page h1,
+.sales-page h2,
+.sales-page h3 { letter-spacing: var(--tracking-tight); }
+
+.sales-page h2 {
+  max-width: 650px;
+  margin-bottom: var(--space-14);
+  font-size: var(--text-heading-2);
+  font-weight: var(--font-weight-medium);
+  line-height: 1.06;
+}
+
+.sales-page h3 {
+  font-size: var(--text-3xl);
+  font-weight: var(--font-weight-medium);
+  line-height: 1.2;
+}
+
+.sales-page p { max-width: 650px; }
+
+.sales-page a {
+  color: var(--color-text);
+  text-underline-offset: 4px;
+}
+
+.sales-page a:hover { color: #fff; }
+
+.sales-kicker {
+  margin-bottom: var(--space-14);
+  color: var(--color-text-muted);
+  font-size: var(--text-xs);
+  font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
+  letter-spacing: var(--tracking-wider);
+  line-height: 1.35;
+  text-transform: uppercase;
+}
+
+/* ==========================================================================
+   Hero Section
+   ========================================================================== */
+.sales-hero {
+  display: grid;
+  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.06fr) minmax(300px, 0.94fr);
+  align-items: center;
+  gap: clamp(var(--space-34), 6vw, var(--space-74));
+  min-height: 0;
+  padding: var(--space-62) 0 var(--space-46);
+}
+
+.sales-hero-copy { min-width: 0; }
+
+.sales-hero h1 {
+  max-width: 680px;
+  margin-bottom: var(--space-23);
+  font-size: var(--text-heading-1);
+  font-weight: var(--font-weight-medium);
+  letter-spacing: var(--tracking-tighter);
+  line-height: 0.99;
+}
+
+.sales-lede {
+  max-width: 580px;
+  margin-bottom: var(--space-28);
+  color: #c0c0c0;
+  font-size: var(--text-lg);
+  line-height: 1.65;
+}
+
+.sales-message {
+  margin: 0 0 var(--space-20);
+  padding: var(--space-11) var(--space-13);
+  border-left: 2px solid var(--color-border-strong);
+  background: var(--color-bg-elevated);
+  color: var(--color-text);
+  font-size: var(--text-sm);
+}
+
+.sales-hero-actions,
+.sales-window-actions,
+.sales-contact-links,
+.sales-support-card {
+  display: flex;
+  flex-wrap: wrap;
+  align-items: center;
+  gap: var(--space-10);
+}
+
+.sales-page .sales-hero-actions .button,
+.sales-page .sales-support-card .button {
+  min-height: var(--btn-height-lg);
+  padding: var(--space-10) var(--space-15);
+}
+
+.sales-hero-microcopy {
+  margin: var(--space-19) 0 0;
+  color: var(--color-text-muted);
+  font-size: var(--text-base);
+}
+
+/* ==========================================================================
+   Product Window
+   ========================================================================== */
+.sales-hero-visual { min-width: 0; }
+
+.sales-product-window {
+  overflow: hidden;
+  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
+  border-radius: var(--sales-radius);
+  background: #0d0d0d;
+  box-shadow: var(--shadow-window);
+}
+
+.sales-window-chrome {
+  display: flex;
+  align-items: center;
+  gap: var(--space-6);
+  min-height: 35px;
+  padding: 0 var(--space-13);
+  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border);
+  color: var(--color-text-dim);
+  font-size: var(--text-xs);
+}
+
+.sales-window-dot {
+  width: 6px;
+  height: 6px;
+  border: 1px solid #555;
+  border-radius: 50%;
+}
+
+.sales-window-route {
+  overflow: hidden;
+  margin-left: var(--space-8);
+  text-overflow: ellipsis;
+  white-space: nowrap;
+}
+
+.sales-window-body {
+  padding: clamp(var(--space-20), 3vw, var(--space-31));
+  font-size: var(--text-base);
+  line-height: 1.6;
+  min-height: 280px;
+}
+
+.sales-window-body * {
+  max-width: 100%;
+  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
+}
+
+.sales-window-body h1,
+.sales-window-body h2,
+.sales-window-body h3,
+.sales-window-body h4 {
+  font-size: inherit;
+  font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
+  line-height: 1.3;
+  margin: var(--space-12) 0 var(--space-8);
+}
+
+.sales-window-body p {
+  margin: var(--space-6) 0;
+  color: var(--color-text-muted);
+  line-height: 1.6;
+}
+
+.sales-window-body .mockup-tag {
+  display: inline-block;
+  padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-8);
+  border: 1px solid var(--color-border-strong);
+  border-radius: var(--radius-badge);
+  background: var(--color-bg-soft);
+  color: var(--color-text);
+  font-size: var(--text-xs);
+  font-weight: var(--font-weight-medium);
+  white-space: nowrap;
+}
+
+.sales-window-body .mockup-header {
+  display: flex;
+  align-items: center;
+  justify-content: space-between;
+  gap: var(--space-12);
+  margin-bottom: var(--space-16);
+  padding-bottom: var(--space-12);
+  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border);
+}
+
+.sales-window-body .mockup-title {
+  margin: 0;
+  font-size: var(--text-lg);
+  font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
+  white-space: nowrap;
+  overflow: hidden;
+  text-overflow: ellipsis;
+}
+
+.sales-window-body .mockup-status {
+  flex-shrink: 0;
+  padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-8);
+  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
+  border-radius: var(--radius-badge);
+  background: var(--color-bg-control);
+  color: var(--color-text-muted);
+  font-size: var(--text-xs);
+  font-weight: var(--font-weight-medium);
+}
+
+.sales-window-chrome {
+  display: flex;
+  align-items: center;
+  gap: var(--space-6);
+  min-height: 35px;
+  padding: 0 var(--space-13);
+  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border);
+  color: var(--color-text-dim);
+  font-size: var(--text-xs);
+}
+
+/* ==========================================================================
+   Journey List
+   ========================================================================== */
+.sales-journey-list {
+  display: grid;
+  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
+  gap: 0 var(--space-22);
+  margin: 0;
+  padding: 0;
+  list-style: none;
+  border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border);
+  position: relative;
+}
+
+.sales-journey-list::before {
+  content: "";
+  position: absolute;
+  top: 0;
+  bottom: 0;
+  left: calc(100% / 6);
+  width: 2px;
+  background: var(--color-border);
+  z-index: 0;
+}
+
+.sales-journey-list li {
+  min-width: 0;
+  align-items: flex-start;
+  justify-content: flex-start;
+  gap: var(--space-14);
+  min-height: 130px;
+  padding: var(--space-20) 0 var(--space-22);
+  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border);
+  position: relative;
+  z-index: 1;
+}
+
+.sales-journey-list li::before {
+  content: "";
+  position: absolute;
+  top: var(--space-20);
+  left: calc(100% / 6);
+  transform: translateX(-50%);
+  width: 12px;
+  height: 12px;
+  border: 2px solid var(--color-border);
+  border-radius: 50%;
+  background: var(--color-bg);
+  z-index: 2;
+}
+
+.sales-journey-number {
+  flex: 0 0 auto;
+  color: var(--color-text-muted);
+  font-size: var(--text-xs);
+  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
+}
+
+.sales-journey-list h3 { margin-bottom: var(--space-7); font-size: var(--text-lg); letter-spacing: -0.02em; }
+
+.sales-journey-list p { margin: 0; color: var(--color-text-muted); font-size: var(--text-base); line-height: 1.55; }
+
+/* ==========================================================================
+   Decision Strip
+   ========================================================================== */
+.sales-decision-strip {
+  display: flex;
+  flex-wrap: wrap;
+  align-items: center;
+  gap: var(--space-9);
+  margin-top: var(--space-25);
+  color: var(--color-text-muted);
+  font-size: var(--text-sm);
+}
+
+.sales-decision-strip strong { color: var(--color-text); font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold); }
+
+/* ==========================================================================
+   Demo Section
+   ========================================================================== */
+.sales-demo-section .sales-section-heading { margin-bottom: var(--space-25); }
+
+.sales-product-window-demo { max-width: 780px; margin: 0 auto; }
+
+.sales-demo-note { max-width: 780px; margin: var(--space-15) auto 0; }
+
+/* ==========================================================================
+   Pricing
+   ========================================================================== */
+.sales-pricing {
+  margin-top: var(--space-56);
+  padding: clamp(var(--space-27), 4vw, var(--space-48));
+  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
+  border-radius: var(--sales-radius);
+  background: var(--color-bg-elevated);
+  scroll-margin-top: 25px;
+}
+
+.sales-pricing .sales-section-heading {
+  max-width: 680px;
+  margin-bottom: var(--space-33);
+}
+
+.sales-pricing .sales-section-heading > p:last-child {
+  margin-bottom: 0;
+  color: var(--color-text-muted);
+  font-size: var(--text-lg);
+}
+
+.sales-plans-list {
+  display: grid;
+  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
+  gap: var(--space-11);
+  align-items: stretch;
+}
+
+.sales-plan-card {
+  display: flex;
+  min-width: 0;
+  flex-direction: column;
+  padding: var(--space-22) var(--space-19) var(--space-19);
+  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
+  background: #0f0f0f;
+}
+
+.sales-plan-heading {
+  align-items: flex-start;
+  margin-bottom: var(--space-16);
+}
+
+.sales-plan-index {
+  margin: 0 0 var(--space-8);
+  color: var(--color-text-muted);
+  font-size: var(--text-xs);
+  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
+}
+
+.sales-plan-heading h3 { margin: 0; font-size: var(--text-6xl); }
+
+.sales-plan-description {
+  min-height: 60px;
+  margin: 0 0 var(--space-18);
+  color: var(--color-text-muted);
+  font-size: var(--text-sm);
+  line-height: 1.55;
+}
+
+.sales-price-stack {
+  display: grid;
+  gap: var(--space-3);
+  margin-bottom: var(--space-3);
+}
+
+.sales-current-price {
+  font-size: var(--text-7xl);
+  font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
+  letter-spacing: var(--tracking-tight);
+  line-height: 1.1;
+}
+
+.sales-plan-benefits {
+  display: grid;
+  gap: var(--space-9);
+  margin: 0 0 var(--space-22);
+  padding: var(--space-17) 0 0;
+  border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border);
+  list-style: none;
+}
+
+.sales-plan-benefits li {
+  display: grid;
+  gap: 1px;
+  min-width: 0;
+}
+
+.sales-plan-benefits strong { font-size: var(--text-sm); font-weight: var(--font-weight-medium); }
+.sales-plan-benefits span { color: var(--color-text-muted); font-size: var(--text-base); line-height: 1.45; }
+
+.sales-plan-card .pix-payment { margin-top: auto; padding-top: var(--space-15); border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border); }
+
+.sales-pricing .pix-payment > summary,
+.sales-pricing .pix-code > summary {
+  color: var(--color-text);
+  cursor: pointer;
+  font-size: var(--text-base);
+  line-height: 1.45;
+  text-decoration: underline;
+  text-underline-offset: 4px;
+}
+
+.sales-pricing .pix-payment-body {
+  display: flex;
+  min-width: 0;
+  flex-direction: column;
+  align-items: flex-start;
+  gap: var(--space-10);
+  margin-top: var(--space-16);
+}
+
+.sales-pricing .pix-qr {
+  display: block;
+  width: min(168px, 100%);
+  height: auto;
+  padding: var(--space-7);
+  border: 1px solid #e4e4e4;
+  background: #fff;
+}
+
+.sales-pricing .pix-payment .button { padding: var(--space-8) var(--space-10); font-size: var(--text-base); }
+
+.sales-pricing .pix-payment [data-pix-status] { min-height: 1.25em; color: var(--color-text-muted); font-size: var(--text-xs); }
+
+.sales-pricing .pix-code { min-width: 0; max-width: 100%; }
+
+.sales-pricing .pix-payload {
+  display: block;
+  max-width: 100%;
+  margin-top: var(--space-9);
+  padding: var(--space-9);
+  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
+  color: var(--color-text-muted);
+  font-size: var(--text-xs);
+  line-height: 1.55;
+  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
+  white-space: pre-wrap;
+}
+
+/* ==========================================================================
+   Cost Chart
+   ========================================================================== */
+.sales-cost-chart {
+  max-width: 790px;
+  margin: var(--space-41) 0 0;
+  padding-top: var(--space-24);
+  border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border);
+}
+
+.sales-chart-header { align-items: baseline; margin-bottom: var(--space-20); }
+
+.sales-chart-header .sales-kicker { margin-bottom: var(--space-5); }
+
+.sales-chart-header h3 { margin: 0; font-size: var(--text-4xl); }
+
+.sales-chart-header > span { color: var(--color-text-muted); font-size: var(--text-xs); }
+
+.sales-chart-list { display: grid; gap: var(--space-13); margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
+
+.sales-chart-row {
+  display: grid;
+  grid-template-columns: minmax(70px, 0.75fr) minmax(0, 2fr) minmax(49px, auto);
+  align-items: center;
+  gap: var(--space-10);
+  min-width: 0;
+}
+
+.sales-chart-label { color: #d7d7d7; font-size: var(--text-base); }
+
+.sales-chart-track { display: block; min-width: 0; height: var(--progress-height-lg); background: #252525; border-radius: var(--radius-full); }
+
+.sales-chart-bar { display: block; width: var(--bar-width); height: 100%; background: var(--color-accent); border-radius: var(--radius-full); }
+
+.sales-chart-value { color: var(--color-text); font-size: var(--text-base); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: var(--font-weight-medium); text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; }
+
+.sales-chart-axis { margin: var(--space-8) 58px 0 calc(0.75 * 100% / 3.75 + var(--space-10)); color: var(--color-text-muted); font-size: var(--text-xs); }
+
+.sales-cost-chart figcaption { margin-top: var(--space-13); color: var(--color-text-muted); font-size: var(--text-xs); line-height: 1.5; }
+
+/* ==========================================================================
+   Pricing Notes
+   ========================================================================== */
+.sales-pricing-notes {
+  display: grid;
+  align-items: start;
+  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.2fr) minmax(0, 0.8fr);
+  margin-top: var(--space-34);
+  padding-top: var(--space-21);
+  border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border);
+}
+
+.sales-pricing-notes p { margin: 0; color: var(--color-text-muted); font-size: var(--text-base); line-height: 1.6; }
+.sales-pricing-notes p:first-child { color: #d5d5d5; }
+
+.sales-pricing-notes .sales-contact-links { grid-column: 1 / -1; margin-top: var(--space-15); }
+
+.sales-contact-links a { color: var(--color-text); font-size: var(--text-base); }
+
+.sales-pricing-notes .sales-fine-print { grid-column: 1 / -1; margin-top: var(--space-16); color: var(--color-text-dim); font-size: var(--text-xs); }
+
+/* ==========================================================================
+   Empty State
+   ========================================================================== */
+.sales-empty-state { margin: 0; padding: var(--space-18); border: 1px dashed var(--color-border-strong); color: var(--color-text-muted); }
+
+/* ==========================================================================
+   Login Section
+   ========================================================================== */
+.sales-login-section {
+  display: grid;
+  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(300px, 0.84fr);
+  gap: clamp(var(--space-30), 8vw, var(--space-85));
+  align-items: start;
+}
+
+.sales-login-panel {
+  min-width: 0;
+  padding: var(--space-21);
+  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
+  background: var(--color-bg-elevated);
+}
+
+.sales-login-panel .account-projects,
+.sales-login-panel .google-login-panel { margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; }
+
+/* ==========================================================================
+   Support Section
+   ========================================================================== */
+.sales-support-section { align-items: end; padding-top: var(--space-74); border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border); }
+
+.sales-support-section > div:first-child { max-width: 640px; }
+
+.sales-support-card {
+  min-width: min(100%, 255px);
+  flex-direction: column;
+  align-items: flex-start;
+  padding: var(--space-18);
+  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
+  background: var(--color-bg-elevated);
+}
+
+.sales-support-card > span { margin-bottom: var(--space-2); color: var(--color-text-muted); font-size: var(--text-base); }
+
+.sales-support-card .sales-inline-link { margin-top: var(--space-2); }
+
+/* ==========================================================================
+   FAQ Section
+   ========================================================================== */
+.sales-faq-section { max-width: 830px; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; }
+
+.sales-faq-list { border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border); }
+
+.sales-faq-list details { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border); }
+
+.sales-faq-list summary {
+  display: flex;
+  align-items: baseline;
+  justify-content: space-between;
+  gap: var(--space-15);
+  padding: var(--space-20) 0;
+  color: var(--color-text);
+  cursor: pointer;
+  font-size: var(--text-md);
+  font-weight: var(--font-weight-medium);
+  list-style: none;
+}
+
+.sales-faq-list summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
+.sales-faq-list summary::after { flex: 0 0 auto; color: var(--color-text-muted); content: "+"; font-size: var(--text-2xl); font-weight: var(--font-weight-normal); }
+.sales-faq-list details[open] summary::after { content: "−"; }
+
+.sales-faq-list details p {
+  max-width: 700px;
+  margin: 0 var(--space-28) var(--space-20) 0;
+  color: var(--color-text-muted);
+  font-size: var(--text-base);
+  line-height: 1.6;
+}
+
+/* ==========================================================================
+   Footer
+   ========================================================================== */
+.sales-footer {
+  align-items: flex-start;
+  margin-top: var(--space-80);
+  padding-top: var(--space-32);
+  border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border);
+}
+
+.sales-footer > div { min-width: 0; }
+
+.sales-footer strong {
+  font-size: var(--text-md);
+  font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
+  margin-bottom: var(--space-8);
+  display: block;
+}
+
+.sales-footer p {
+  max-width: 330px;
+  margin: var(--space-10) 0 var(--space-16);
+  color: var(--color-text-muted);
+  font-size: var(--text-base);
+  line-height: 1.7;
+}
+
+.sales-footer nav {
+  display: flex;
+  flex-wrap: wrap;
+  justify-content: flex-end;
+  gap: var(--space-12) var(--space-20);
+  max-width: 460px;
+}
+
+.sales-footer nav a:not(.button) {
+  color: var(--color-text-muted);
+  font-size: var(--text-base);
+  line-height: 1.7;
+}
+.sales-footer nav .button {
+  padding: var(--space-10) var(--space-14);
+  font-size: var(--text-base);
+}
+
+/* ==========================================================================
+   Responsive
+   ========================================================================== */
+@media (max-width: 1000px) {
+  .sales-plans-list {
+    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
+    gap: var(--space-12);
+  }
+}
+
+@media (max-width: 900px) {
+  .sales-hero { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(270px, 0.87fr); gap: var(--space-32); }
+  .sales-plans-list { gap: var(--space-8); }
+  .sales-plan-card { padding-left: var(--space-15); padding-right: var(--space-15); }
+}
+
+@media (max-width: 760px) {
+  .sales-page { padding-bottom: var(--space-30); }
+  .sales-hero { display: block; min-height: 0; padding: var(--space-48) 0 var(--space-38); }
+  .sales-hero h1 { max-width: 600px; font-size: clamp(var(--text-heading-1), 10vw, 48px); }
+  .sales-hero-visual { max-width: 600px; margin-top: var(--space-36); }
+  .sales-highlight-rail,
+  .sales-product-section,
+  .sales-login-section,
+  .sales-support-section { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
+  .sales-highlight-rail > div { padding: var(--space-15) 0; }
+  .sales-highlight-rail > div + div { padding-left: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-left: 0; }
+  .sales-section, .sales-product-section { padding-top: var(--space-53); }
+  .sales-resource-rail, .sales-journey-list { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
+  .sales-product-section { display: grid; gap: var(--space-30); }
+  .sales-plans-list { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: var(--space-12); }
+  .sales-plan-card { padding: var(--space-21) var(--space-18); }
+  .sales-plan-description { min-height: 0; }
+  .sales-pricing { margin-top: var(--space-53); padding: var(--space-23) var(--space-18); }
+  .sales-pricing-notes { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
+  .sales-support-section { display: grid; gap: var(--space-27); }
+  .sales-footer { display: grid; gap: var(--space-25); }
+  .sales-footer nav { justify-content: flex-start; }
+}
+
+@media (max-width: 480px) {
+  .sales-page h2 { font-size: var(--text-7xl); }
+  .sales-hero-actions .button { flex: 1 1 100%; text-align: center; }
+  .sales-model-fields { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
+  .sales-resource-rail, .sales-journey-list { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
+  .sales-resource-rail article { padding-right: 0; padding-bottom: var(--space-21); }
+  .sales-resource-rail article + article { padding-top: var(--space-21); padding-left: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-left: 0; }
+  .sales-journey-list li { min-height: 0; }
+  .sales-chart-header { display: block; }
+  .sales-chart-header > span { display: block; margin-top: var(--space-5); }
+  .sales-chart-row { grid-template-columns: minmax(63px, 0.75fr) minmax(0, 2fr) minmax(48px, auto); gap: var(--space-7); }
+  .sales-chart-label, .sales-chart-value { font-size: var(--text-xs); }
+  .sales-chart-axis { margin-right: 55px; margin-left: 69px; }
+  .sales-footer nav { gap: var(--space-11) var(--space-14); }
+}
+
+@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
+  .sales-page *,
+  .sales-page *::before,
+  .sales-page *::after {
+    scroll-behavior: auto !important;
+    transition: none !important;
+  }
+}
+
+/* ==========================================================================
+   Pricing Reuse (Account Comparator)
+   ========================================================================== */
+.sales-pricing {
+  --sales-paper: var(--color-bg-elevated);
+  --sales-soft: var(--color-bg-soft);
+  --sales-line: var(--color-border);
+  --sales-line-strong: var(--color-border-strong);
+  --sales-ink: var(--color-text);
+  --sales-muted: var(--color-text-muted);
+  --sales-dim: var(--color-text-muted);
+  --sales-radius: var(--radius-card);
+  color: var(--color-text);
+  font-size: var(--text-sm);
+  line-height: var(--leading-body);
+}
+
+.sales-pricing h2 { letter-spacing: var(--tracking-tight); line-height: 1.1; }
+
+.sales-preview-question {
+  margin: 0 0 var(--space-22);
+  padding: 0 0 var(--space-20);
+  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border);
+  color: #d5d5d5;
+  font-size: var(--text-sm);
+  line-height: 1.65;
+}
+
+.sales-preview-question small {
+  display: block;
+  margin-bottom: var(--space-7);
+  color: var(--color-text-muted);
+  font-size: var(--text-xs);
+  letter-spacing: var(--tracking-wide);
+  text-transform: uppercase;
+}
+
+.sales-chart-row,
+.sales-chart-axis {
+  display: grid;
+  grid-template-columns: 94px minmax(0, 1fr) 66px;
+  column-gap: var(--space-10);
+}
+
+.sales-chart-axis { margin: var(--space-8) 0 0; }
+
+.sales-axis-ticks { grid-column: 2; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; }
+
+@media (max-width: 480px) {
+  .sales-chart-row, .sales-chart-axis { grid-template-columns: 80px minmax(0, 1fr) 60px; column-gap: var(--space-7); }
+  .sales-chart-axis { margin: var(--space-8) 0 0; }
+}
+
+.sales-page a.button-primary,
+.sales-page a.button-primary:hover { color: var(--color-bg); }
+
+.sales-flows-rail { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
+
+.sales-demo-more {
+  display: flex;
+  flex-wrap: wrap;
+  align-items: center;
+  justify-content: center;
+  gap: var(--space-10);
+  max-width: 780px;
+  margin: var(--space-15) auto 0;
+}
+
+@media (max-width: 680px) { .sales-flows-rail { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

diff --git a/static/css/profile.css b/static/css/profile.css
@@ -0,0 +1,120 @@
+/**
+ * Profile/Account Settings Styles - Assistente Acadêmico
+ * Uses design tokens from tokens.css
+ */
+
+@import "tokens.css";
+
+/* ==========================================================================
+   Profile Heading
+   ========================================================================== */
+.profile-heading h1 { font-size: var(--text-7xl); }
+.profile-heading .lead { font-size: var(--text-sm); margin: 0; }
+.profile-heading { margin-bottom: var(--space-22); }
+
+/* ==========================================================================
+   Profile Shell & Tabs
+   ========================================================================== */
+.profile-shell { max-width: var(--container-form); }
+
+.profile-tabs {
+  display: flex;
+  gap: var(--space-6);
+  margin: 0 0 var(--space-12);
+}
+
+.profile-tabs button {
+  font-size: var(--text-sm);
+  background: transparent;
+  color: var(--color-text-muted);
+  border: 1px solid transparent;
+  border-radius: var(--radius-button);
+  padding: var(--space-8) var(--space-12);
+  cursor: pointer;
+  transition:
+    background-color var(--transition-bg),
+    border-color var(--transition-border),
+    color var(--transition-color);
+}
+
+.profile-tabs button:hover {
+  background: var(--color-bg-control);
+  color: var(--color-text);
+}
+
+.profile-tabs button[aria-current=page] {
+  background: var(--color-accent-soft);
+  color: var(--color-text);
+  border-color: var(--color-border);
+}
+
+/* ==========================================================================
+   Profile Card
+   ========================================================================== */
+.profile-card {
+  display: grid;
+  gap: var(--space-14);
+  padding: var(--space-22);
+  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
+  border-radius: var(--radius-card);
+  background: var(--color-bg-elevated);
+}
+
+.profile-card[hidden] { display: none !important; }
+
+.profile-card h2 { margin: 0; font-size: var(--text-4xl); font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold); }
+
+.profile-fields {
+  display: grid;
+  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
+  gap: var(--space-14) var(--space-12);
+}
+
+.profile-fields .full-width { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
+
+.profile-card label { font-size: var(--text-sm); font-weight: var(--font-weight-medium); }
+
+.profile-card .check-row { font-weight: var(--font-weight-normal); line-height: 1.6; }
+
+.profile-card input:not([type=checkbox]) {
+  min-height: var(--input-height-md);
+  font-size: var(--text-md);
+  padding: var(--input-padding-y) var(--input-padding-x);
+  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
+  border-radius: var(--radius-input);
+  background: var(--color-bg-control);
+  color: var(--color-text);
+}
+
+.profile-card .field-help { margin: 0; font-size: var(--text-base); line-height: 1.5; }
+
+.profile-card > .button {
+  justify-self: start;
+  font-size: var(--text-sm);
+  margin-top: var(--space-4);
+}
+
+/* ==========================================================================
+   Contact Settings
+   ========================================================================== */
+.contact-settings {
+  display: grid;
+  gap: var(--space-12);
+  padding-top: var(--space-16);
+  border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border);
+}
+
+.contact-settings input[type=tel] { max-width: 300px; }
+
+.optional-label {
+  font-size: var(--text-xs);
+  font-weight: var(--font-weight-normal);
+  color: var(--color-text-muted);
+  margin-left: var(--space-8);
+}
+
+@media (max-width: 600px) {
+  .profile-fields { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
+  .profile-card { padding: var(--space-18); }
+  .profile-card > .button { width: 100%; }
+}

diff --git a/static/css/tokens.css b/static/css/tokens.css
@@ -0,0 +1,361 @@
+/**
+ * Design Tokens - Assistente Acadêmico
+ * Centralized design system tokens for colors, spacing, typography, borders, shadows, transitions
+ * All components should reference these tokens instead of hardcoded values
+ */
+
+/* ==========================================================================
+   COLOR PALETTE - Core Semantic Colors
+   ========================================================================== */
+:root {
+  /* Base Colors (Dark mode default) */
+  --color-bg: #090909;
+  --color-bg-elevated: #121212;      /* paper/card backgrounds */
+  --color-bg-soft: #1c1c1c;          /* soft/secondary backgrounds */
+  --color-bg-control: #101010;       /* input/control backgrounds */
+  --color-bg-control-hover: #272727; /* input/control hover */
+
+  /* Border Colors */
+  --color-border: #303030;           /* default borders */
+  --color-border-strong: #4a4a4a;    /* emphasized borders */
+  --color-border-hover: #666666;     /* hover state borders */
+  --color-border-focus: #cfcfcf;     /* focus ring color */
+
+  /* Text Colors - Improved contrast for dark mode */
+  --color-text: #f2f2f2;             /* primary text (ink) */
+  --color-text-muted: #c0c0c0;       /* secondary/muted text - improved from #a0a0a0 */
+  --color-text-dim: #909090;         /* tertiary/disabled text - improved from #737373 */
+
+  /* Accent Colors */
+  --color-accent: #ededed;           /* primary accent (light) */
+  --color-accent-soft: #262626;      /* accent background */
+  --color-accent-hover: #d6d6d6;     /* accent hover */
+
+  /* Semantic Status Colors */
+  --color-success: #b6d6b6;
+  --color-success-border: #456345;
+  --color-success-bg: #1a2e1a;
+  --color-warning: #f5d58a;
+  --color-warning-border: #8b733b;
+  --color-warning-bg: #3d331a;
+  --color-danger: #f08a8a;
+  --color-danger-border: #713b3b;
+  --color-danger-bg: #3d1a1a;
+  --color-info: #a0c8f0;
+  --color-info-border: #3b5b7a;
+  --color-info-bg: #1a2a3d;
+
+  /* Legacy Marketing/Sales Colors (kept for compatibility) */
+  --sales-bg: var(--color-bg);
+  --sales-paper: var(--color-bg-elevated);
+  --sales-soft: var(--color-bg-soft);
+  --sales-line: var(--color-border);
+  --sales-line-strong: var(--color-border-strong);
+  --sales-ink: var(--color-text);
+  --sales-muted: var(--color-text-muted);
+  --sales-dim: var(--color-text-dim);
+}
+
+/* ==========================================================================
+   SPACING SCALE - 4px base unit (filled gaps with odd values)
+   ========================================================================== */
+:root {
+  --space-0: 0;
+  --space-1: 2px;
+  --space-2: 4px;
+  --space-3: 6px;
+  --space-4: 8px;
+  --space-5: 10px;
+  --space-6: 12px;
+  --space-7: 14px;
+  --space-8: 16px;
+  --space-9: 18px;
+  --space-10: 20px;
+  --space-11: 22px;
+  --space-12: 24px;
+  --space-13: 26px;
+  --space-14: 28px;
+  --space-15: 30px;
+  --space-16: 32px;
+  --space-17: 34px;
+  --space-18: 36px;
+  --space-19: 38px;
+  --space-20: 40px;
+  --space-21: 42px;
+  --space-22: 44px;
+  --space-23: 46px;
+  --space-24: 48px;
+  --space-25: 50px;
+  --space-26: 52px;
+  --space-27: 54px;
+  --space-28: 56px;
+  --space-29: 58px;
+  --space-30: 60px;
+  --space-32: 64px;
+  --space-36: 72px;
+  --space-40: 80px;
+  --space-48: 96px;
+  --space-56: 112px;
+  --space-64: 128px;
+}
+
+/* ==========================================================================
+   TYPOGRAPHY SCALE - Increased base sizes + Fluid type for body
+   ========================================================================== */
+:root {
+  /* Font Families */
+  --font-sans: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
+  --font-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace;
+
+  /* Font Sizes - Increased for better readability */
+  --text-xs: 12px;       /* 0.75rem - labels, captions */
+  --text-sm: 13px;       /* 0.8125rem - small labels */
+  --text-base: 14px;     /* 0.875rem - body small */
+  --text-md: 15px;       /* 0.9375rem - body default (was 13px) */
+  --text-lg: 16px;       /* 1rem - body large */
+  --text-xl: 17px;       /* 1.0625rem */
+  --text-2xl: 18px;      /* 1.125rem */
+  --text-3xl: 20px;      /* 1.25rem */
+  --text-4xl: 21px;      /* 1.3125rem */
+  --text-5xl: 24px;      /* 1.5rem */
+  --text-6xl: 26px;      /* 1.625rem */
+  --text-7xl: 28px;      /* 1.75rem */
+  --text-8xl: 32px;      /* 2rem */
+  --text-9xl: 36px;      /* 2.25rem */
+  --text-10xl: 40px;     /* 2.5rem */
+  --text-11xl: 44px;     /* 2.75rem */
+
+  /* Fluid Type Scale (clamp) - Headings */
+  --text-heading-1: clamp(36px, 5vw, 72px);    /* Hero */
+  --text-heading-2: clamp(30px, 3.5vw, 48px);  /* Section */
+  --text-heading-3: clamp(24px, 2.5vw, 34px);  /* Subsection */
+  --text-heading-4: clamp(18px, 2vw, 26px);    /* Card title */
+
+  /* Fluid Type Scale (clamp) - Body text (NEW) */
+  --text-body-sm: clamp(13px, 0.9vw, 15px);    /* Small body */
+  --text-body: clamp(15px, 1vw, 17px);         /* Default body */
+  --text-body-lg: clamp(16px, 1.1vw, 18px);    /* Large body */
+
+  /* Font Weights */
+  --font-weight-normal: 400;
+  --font-weight-medium: 500;
+  --font-weight-semibold: 560;
+  --font-weight-bold: 600;
+  --font-weight-extrabold: 650;
+  --font-weight-black: 700;
+
+  /* Line Heights */
+  --leading-tight: 1.06;
+  --leading-snug: 1.15;
+  --leading-normal: 1.5;
+  --leading-relaxed: 1.55;
+  --leading-loose: 1.6;
+  --leading-body: 1.58;
+  --leading-code: 1.55;
+
+  /* Letter Spacing */
+  --tracking-tighter: -0.065em;
+  --tracking-tight: -0.045em;
+  --tracking-normal: 0;
+  --tracking-wide: 0.06em;
+  --tracking-wider: 0.08em;
+  --tracking-widest: 0.12em;
+  --tracking-caption: 0.13em;
+}
+
+/* ==========================================================================
+   BORDER RADIUS
+   ========================================================================== */
+:root {
+  --radius-none: 0;
+  --radius-xs: 3px;
+  --radius-sm: 4px;
+  --radius-md: 5px;
+  --radius-lg: 6px;
+  --radius-xl: 7px;
+  --radius-2xl: 8px;
+  --radius-3xl: 12px;
+  --radius-full: 9999px;
+
+  /* Semantic Radius */
+  --radius-button: var(--radius-md);
+  --radius-input: var(--radius-md);
+  --radius-card: var(--radius-2xl);
+  --radius-badge: var(--radius-full);
+  --radius-modal: var(--radius-2xl);
+}
+
+/* ==========================================================================
+   SHADOWS
+   ========================================================================== */
+:root {
+  --shadow-xs: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
+  --shadow-sm: 0 2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
+  --shadow-md: 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
+  --shadow-lg: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
+  --shadow-xl: 0 22px 70px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28);
+  --shadow-focus: 0 0 0 3px var(--color-border-focus);
+
+  /* Semantic Shadows */
+  --shadow-card: var(--shadow-md);
+  --shadow-modal: var(--shadow-xl);
+  --shadow-dropdown: var(--shadow-lg);
+  --shadow-window: var(--shadow-xl);
+}
+
+/* ==========================================================================
+   TRANSITIONS
+   ========================================================================== */
+:root {
+  --transition-fast: 80ms ease;
+  --transition-base: 150ms ease;
+  --transition-slow: 200ms ease;
+  --transition-slower: 300ms ease;
+
+  /* Semantic Transitions */
+  --transition-color: var(--transition-base);
+  --transition-bg: var(--transition-base);
+  --transition-border: var(--transition-base);
+  --transition-shadow: var(--transition-base);
+  --transition-transform: var(--transition-fast);
+  --transition-opacity: var(--transition-fast);
+  --transition-all: var(--transition-base);
+}
+
+/* ==========================================================================
+   Z-INDEX SCALE - Fixed: dropdown above modal
+   ========================================================================== */
+:root {
+  --z-base: 1;
+  --z-dropdown: 55;          /* Increased from 10 - above modal */
+  --z-sticky: 20;
+  --z-topbar: 30;
+  --z-modal-backdrop: 40;
+  --z-modal: 50;
+  --z-popover: 60;
+  --z-tooltip: 70;
+  --z-toast: 80;
+}
+
+/* ==========================================================================
+   CONTAINER WIDTHS - Semantic containers
+   ========================================================================== */
+:root {
+  /* Legacy (kept for compatibility) */
+  --container-sm: 640px;
+  --container-md: 760px;
+  --container-lg: 900px;
+  --container-xl: 1000px;
+  --container-2xl: 1100px;
+  --container-full: 92vw;
+
+  /* Semantic containers (NEW) */
+  --container-content: 760px;    /* texto corrido, artigos */
+  --container-form: 900px;       /* formulários, editor */
+  --container-wide: 1100px;      /* dashboard, listagens */
+}
+
+/* ==========================================================================
+   BREAKPOINTS (for reference in media queries)
+   ========================================================================== */
+:root {
+  --bp-xs: 480px;
+  --bp-sm: 640px;
+  --bp-md: 760px;
+  --bp-lg: 900px;
+  --bp-xl: 960px;
+  --bp-2xl: 1100px;
+}
+
+/* ==========================================================================
+   COMPONENT-SPECIFIC TOKENS (derived from base tokens)
+   ========================================================================== */
+:root {
+  /* Button */
+  --btn-height-sm: 36px;
+  --btn-height-md: 40px;
+  --btn-height-lg: 44px;
+  --btn-height-xl: 48px;
+  --btn-padding-x-sm: 12px;
+  --btn-padding-x-md: 16px;
+  --btn-padding-x-lg: 20px;
+  --btn-font-size: var(--text-sm);
+
+  /* Input */
+  --input-height-sm: 40px;
+  --input-height-md: 44px;
+  --input-height-lg: 48px;
+  --input-padding-x: 14px;
+  --input-padding-y: 12px;
+
+  /* Card */
+  --card-padding: var(--space-14);
+  --card-padding-sm: var(--space-10);
+  --card-gap: var(--space-12);
+
+  /* Progress */
+  --progress-height: 6px;
+  --progress-height-lg: 14px;
+
+  /* Topbar/Navigation */
+  --topbar-height: 72px;
+  --topbar-height-mobile: auto;
+
+  /* Sidebar (NEW) */
+  --sidebar-width: 220px;
+  --sidebar-width-collapsed: 64px;
+
+  /* Focus Ring - Improved visibility */
+  --focus-ring-width: 3px;
+  --focus-ring-offset: 4px;
+}
+
+/* ==========================================================================
+   REDUCED MOTION
+   ========================================================================== */
+@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
+  :root {
+    --transition-fast: 0ms;
+    --transition-base: 0ms;
+    --transition-slow: 0ms;
+    --transition-slower: 0ms;
+    --transition-color: 0ms;
+    --transition-bg: 0ms;
+    --transition-border: 0ms;
+    --transition-shadow: 0ms;
+    --transition-transform: 0ms;
+    --transition-opacity: 0ms;
+    --transition-all: 0ms;
+  }
+}
+
+/* ==========================================================================
+   HIGH CONTRAST MODE SUPPORT
+   ========================================================================== */
+@media (prefers-contrast: more) {
+  :root {
+    --color-border: #666666;
+    --color-border-strong: #ffffff;
+    --color-text-muted: #e0e0e0;
+    --color-text-dim: #b0b0b0;
+    --color-accent: #ffffff;
+    --color-accent-soft: #444444;
+  }
+}
+
+/* ==========================================================================
+   PRINT STYLES
+   ========================================================================== */
+@media print {
+  :root {
+    --color-bg: #ffffff;
+    --color-bg-elevated: #ffffff;
+    --color-bg-soft: #f5f5f5;
+    --color-bg-control: #ffffff;
+    --color-text: #000000;
+    --color-text-muted: #333333;
+    --color-text-dim: #666666;
+    --color-border: #cccccc;
+    --color-accent: #000000;
+  }
+}

diff --git a/static/js/account.js b/static/js/account.js
@@ -0,0 +1,318 @@
+// Account tabs and sub-tabs functionality
+// Handles: Meus Projetos, Minha Biblioteca, Minha Conta, Administração
+
+document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
+  initAccountTabs();
+  initAccountSubtabs();
+  initSharingPreferences();
+  initDeletion();
+  initGrants();
+});
+
+// ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+// Main Account Tabs (Meus Projetos, Minha Biblioteca, Minha Conta, Administração)
+// ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+function initAccountTabs() {
+  const tabButtons = document.querySelectorAll('.account-tabs [role="tab"]');
+  const tabPanels = document.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel[role="tabpanel"]');
+
+  tabButtons.forEach(btn => {
+    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
+      const tabId = btn.dataset.tab;
+      activateTab(tabId, tabButtons, tabPanels);
+    });
+  });
+
+  // Activate first tab by default
+  if (tabButtons[0]) {
+    activateTab(tabButtons[0].dataset.tab, tabButtons, tabPanels);
+  }
+}
+
+function activateTab(tabId, tabButtons, tabPanels) {
+  tabButtons.forEach(btn => {
+    const isActive = btn.dataset.tab === tabId;
+    btn.setAttribute('aria-selected', isActive);
+    btn.classList.toggle('is-active', isActive);
+  });
+
+  tabPanels.forEach(panel => {
+    const isActive = panel.id === `tab-${tabId}`;
+    panel.hidden = !isActive;
+    panel.setAttribute('aria-hidden', !isActive);
+  });
+}
+
+// ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+// Account Sub-tabs (Perfil, Compartilhamento, Créditos, Excluir conta)
+// ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+function initAccountSubtabs() {
+  const tabButtons = document.querySelectorAll('.account-subtabs [role="tab"]');
+  const tabPanels = document.querySelectorAll('.subtab-panel[role="tabpanel"]');
+
+  tabButtons.forEach(btn => {
+    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
+      const tabId = btn.dataset.subtab;
+      activateSubtab(tabId, tabButtons, tabPanels);
+    });
+  });
+
+  // Activate first subtab by default
+  if (tabButtons[0]) {
+    activateSubtab(tabButtons[0].dataset.subtab, tabButtons, tabPanels);
+  }
+}
+
+function activateSubtab(tabId, tabButtons, tabPanels) {
+  tabButtons.forEach(btn => {
+    const isActive = btn.dataset.subtab === tabId;
+    btn.setAttribute('aria-selected', isActive);
+    btn.classList.toggle('is-active', isActive);
+  });
+
+  tabPanels.forEach(panel => {
+    const isActive = panel.id === `subtab-${tabId}`;
+    panel.hidden = !isActive;
+    panel.setAttribute('aria-hidden', !isActive);
+  });
+}
+
+// ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+// Sharing Preferences
+// ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+async function initSharingPreferences() {
+  const form = document.getElementById('sharing-prefs-form');
+  const statusEl = document.getElementById('sharing-prefs-status');
+  const allowView = document.getElementById('allow_admin_view');
+  const allowComments = document.getElementById('allow_admin_comments');
+
+  if (!form) return;
+
+  // Load current preferences
+  await loadSharingPreferences();
+
+  // Disable comments checkbox if view is not checked
+  allowView?.addEventListener('change', () => {
+    if (allowComments) {
+      allowComments.disabled = !allowView.checked;
+      if (!allowView.checked) {
+        allowComments.checked = false;
+      }
+    }
+  });
+
+  form.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
+    e.preventDefault();
+    const formData = new FormData(form);
+    const payload = {
+      allow_admin_view: formData.get('allow_admin_view') === 'on',
+      allow_admin_comments: formData.get('allow_admin_comments') === 'on',
+      inherit_account_default: formData.get('inherit_account_default') === 'on'
+    };
+
+    try {
+      const res = await fetch('/account/sharing', {
+        method: 'POST',
+        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRF-Token': formData.get('csrf_token') },
+        body: JSON.stringify(payload)
+      });
+      const data = await res.json();
+      if (data.ok) {
+        showStatus(statusEl, 'Preferências salvas com sucesso.', 'success');
+        // Update UI to reflect saved values
+        allowView.checked = data.preferences.allow_admin_view;
+        allowComments.checked = data.preferences.allow_admin_comments;
+        allowComments.disabled = !data.preferences.allow_admin_view;
+        document.getElementById('inherit_account_default').checked = data.preferences.inherit_default;
+      } else {
+        showStatus(statusEl, data.message || 'Erro ao salvar preferências.', 'error');
+      }
+    } catch (err) {
+      showStatus(statusEl, 'Erro de conexão.', 'error');
+    }
+  });
+}
+
+async function loadSharingPreferences() {
+  try {
+    const res = await fetch('/account/sharing');
+    const data = await res.json();
+    if (data.ok) {
+      const prefs = data.preferences;
+      document.getElementById('allow_admin_view').checked = prefs.allow_admin_view;
+      document.getElementById('allow_admin_comments').checked = prefs.allow_admin_comments;
+      document.getElementById('allow_admin_comments').disabled = !prefs.allow_admin_view;
+      document.getElementById('inherit_account_default').checked = prefs.inherit_default;
+    }
+  } catch (err) {
+    console.error('Failed to load sharing preferences:', err);
+  }
+}
+
+// ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+// Self Deletion
+// ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+async function initDeletion() {
+  const statusEl = document.getElementById('deletion-status');
+  const actionsEl = document.getElementById('deletion-actions');
+  const btnRequest = document.getElementById('btn-request-deletion');
+  const btnCancel = document.getElementById('btn-cancel-deletion');
+  const btnConfirm = document.getElementById('btn-confirm-deletion');
+
+  if (!statusEl) return;
+
+  // Check for pending deletion request
+  await checkDeletionStatus();
+
+  // Forms use native submission, just handle UI state
+  const formRequest = document.getElementById('form-request-deletion');
+  const formCancel = document.getElementById('form-cancel-deletion');
+  const formConfirm = document.getElementById('form-confirm-deletion');
+
+  if (formRequest) {
+    formRequest.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
+      e.preventDefault();
+      try {
+        const res = await fetch('/account/deletion/request', {
+          method: 'POST',
+          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRF-Token': new FormData(formRequest).get('csrf_token') }
+        });
+        const data = await res.json();
+        if (data.ok) {
+          updateDeletionUI('pending');
+        } else {
+          showStatus(statusEl, data.message || 'Erro ao solicitar exclusão.', 'error');
+        }
+      } catch (err) {
+        showStatus(statusEl, 'Erro de conexão.', 'error');
+      }
+    });
+  }
+
+  if (formCancel) {
+    formCancel.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
+      e.preventDefault();
+      try {
+        const res = await fetch('/account/deletion/cancel', {
+          method: 'POST',
+          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRF-Token': new FormData(formCancel).get('csrf_token') }
+        });
+        const data = await res.json();
+        if (data.ok) {
+          updateDeletionUI('none');
+        } else {
+          showStatus(statusEl, data.message || 'Erro ao cancelar.', 'error');
+        }
+      } catch (err) {
+        showStatus(statusEl, 'Erro de conexão.', 'error');
+      }
+    });
+  }
+
+  if (formConfirm) {
+    formConfirm.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
+      // Let the native confirm dialog handle confirmation
+      // If user confirms, form submits normally
+    });
+  }
+}
+
+async function checkDeletionStatus() {
+  try {
+    const res = await fetch('/account/sharing'); // Reusing endpoint that returns account info including deletion_request_pending
+    const data = await res.json();
+    if (data.ok && data.account) {
+      const account = data.account;
+      if (account.deletion_request_pending) {
+        updateDeletionUI('pending');
+      } else {
+        updateDeletionUI('none');
+      }
+    }
+  } catch (err) {
+    console.error('Failed to check deletion status:', err);
+  }
+}
+
+function updateDeletionUI(state) {
+  const statusEl = document.getElementById('deletion-status');
+  const btnRequest = document.getElementById('btn-request-deletion');
+  const btnCancel = document.getElementById('btn-cancel-deletion');
+  const btnConfirm = document.getElementById('btn-confirm-deletion');
+  const formRequest = document.getElementById('form-request-deletion');
+  const formCancel = document.getElementById('form-cancel-deletion');
+  const formConfirm = document.getElementById('form-confirm-deletion');
+
+  if (state === 'pending') {
+    statusEl.textContent = '⚠️ Solicitação de exclusão pendente. Você pode cancelar ou confirmar a exclusão definitiva.';
+    statusEl.className = 'deletion-status warning';
+    if (formRequest) formRequest.style.display = 'none';
+    if (formCancel) formCancel.style.display = 'inline';
+    if (formConfirm) formConfirm.style.display = 'inline';
+  } else {
+    statusEl.textContent = 'Nenhuma solicitação de exclusão pendente.';
+    statusEl.className = 'deletion-status';
+    if (formRequest) formRequest.style.display = 'inline';
+    if (formCancel) formCancel.style.display = 'none';
+    if (formConfirm) formConfirm.style.display = 'none';
+  }
+}
+
+// ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+// Grants (Créditos)
+// ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+async function initGrants() {
+  const listEl = document.getElementById('grants-list');
+  if (!listEl) return;
+
+  try {
+    const res = await fetch('/account/grants');
+    const data = await res.json();
+    if (data.ok && data.grants) {
+      renderGrants(data.grants, listEl);
+    } else {
+      listEl.innerHTML = '<p class="field-hint">Nenhum grant encontrado.</p>';
+    }
+  } catch (err) {
+    listEl.innerHTML = '<p class="field-hint error">Erro ao carregar grants.</p>';
+  }
+}
+
+function renderGrants(grants, container) {
+  if (!grants.length) {
+    container.innerHTML = '<p class="field-hint">Nenhum crédito concedido ainda.</p>';
+    return;
+  }
+
+  container.innerHTML = grants.map(g => `
+    <div class="grant-card">
+      <div class="grant-header">
+        <strong>${g.plan_code === 'livre' ? 'Sem plano' : g.plan_code}</strong>
+        <span class="grant-date">Concedido em ${new Date(g.created_at * 1000).toLocaleDateString('pt-BR')}</span>
+      </div>
+      <div class="grant-credits">
+        <span class="credit ${g.project_remaining > 0 ? 'has-credit' : ''}">Projetos: ${g.project_remaining}/${g.project_credits}</span>
+        <span class="credit ${g.ai_analysis_remaining > 0 ? 'has-credit' : ''}">Análise IA: ${g.ai_analysis_remaining}/${g.ai_analysis_credits}</span>
+        <span class="credit ${g.deepseek_explanation_remaining > 0 ? 'has-credit' : ''}">Explicação DeepSeek: ${g.deepseek_explanation_remaining}/${g.deepseek_explanation_credits}</span>
+      </div>
+      ${g.expires_at ? `<p class="grant-expiry">Expira em ${new Date(g.expires_at * 1000).toLocaleDateString('pt-BR')}</p>` : ''}
+    </div>
+  `).join('');
+}
+
+// ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+// Utility
+// ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+function showStatus(el, message, type) {
+  if (!el) return;
+  el.textContent = message;
+  el.className = type === 'success' ? 'notice success' : 'notice error';
+  el.hidden = false;
+  setTimeout(() => { el.hidden = true; }, 5000);
+}
+\ No newline at end of file
diff --git a/static/js/admin.js b/static/js/admin.js
@@ -0,0 +1,304 @@
+// Admin Dashboard JavaScript
+// Handles: Health Check, Uso Global, Limites de Conta
+
+document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
+  initAdminTabs();
+  initHealthTab();
+  initUsageTab();
+  initLimitsTab();
+});
+
+// ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+// Admin Tabs
+// ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+function initAdminTabs() {
+  const tabButtons = document.querySelectorAll('.admin-tabs [role="tab"]');
+  const tabPanels = document.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel[role="tabpanel"]');
+
+  tabButtons.forEach(btn => {
+    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
+      const tabId = btn.dataset.tab;
+      activateTab(tabId, tabButtons, tabPanels);
+    });
+  });
+
+  if (tabButtons[0]) {
+    activateTab(tabButtons[0].dataset.tab, tabButtons, tabPanels);
+  }
+}
+
+function activateTab(tabId, tabButtons, tabPanels) {
+  tabButtons.forEach(btn => {
+    const isActive = btn.dataset.tab === tabId;
+    btn.setAttribute('aria-selected', isActive);
+    btn.classList.toggle('is-active', isActive);
+  });
+
+  tabPanels.forEach(panel => {
+    const isActive = panel.id === `tab-${tabId}`;
+    panel.hidden = !isActive;
+    panel.setAttribute('aria-hidden', !isActive);
+  });
+}
+
+// ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+// Health Tab
+// ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+async function initHealthTab() {
+  const btnRefresh = document.getElementById('btn-refresh-health');
+  if (btnRefresh) {
+    btnRefresh.addEventListener('click', loadHealth);
+  }
+  await loadHealth();
+}
+
+async function loadHealth() {
+  try {
+    const res = await fetch('/admin/health');
+    const data = await res.json();
+    if (data.ok) {
+      renderHealth(data.health);
+    } else {
+      renderHealthError('Erro ao carregar health check');
+    }
+  } catch (err) {
+    renderHealthError('Erro de conexão');
+  }
+}
+
+function renderHealth(health) {
+  const dbEl = document.getElementById('health-db');
+  const sessionsEl = document.getElementById('health-sessions');
+  const diskEl = document.getElementById('health-disk');
+  const notifEl = document.getElementById('health-notifications');
+
+  if (dbEl) {
+    const db = health.database || {};
+    dbEl.innerHTML = `
+      <dl class="health-dl">
+        <dt>Integridade</dt><dd>${db.integrity || 'N/A'}</dd>
+        <dt>Tamanho</dt><dd>${formatBytes(db.size_bytes || 0)}</dd>
+        <dt>Notificações</dt><dd>${Object.entries(db.notifications || {}).map(([k,v]) => `${k}: ${v}`).join(', ') || 'Nenhuma'}</dd>
+      </dl>
+    `;
+  }
+
+  if (sessionsEl) {
+    sessionsEl.innerHTML = `
+      <p class="health-metric">${health.active_sessions_24h || 0} sessões ativas nas últimas 24h</p>
+    `;
+  }
+
+  if (diskEl) {
+    const disk = health.disk || {};
+    diskEl.innerHTML = `
+      <dl class="health-dl">
+        <dt>Total</dt><dd>${formatBytes(disk.total_bytes || 0)}</dd>
+        <dt>Livre</dt><dd>${formatBytes(disk.free_bytes || 0)}</dd>
+        <dt>Usado</dt><dd>${disk.used_percent || 0}%</dd>
+      </dl>
+    `;
+  }
+
+  if (notifEl) {
+    const stats = health.notifications || {};
+    notifEl.innerHTML = `
+      <dl class="health-dl">
+        ${Object.entries(stats).map(([k,v]) => `<dt>${k}</dt><dd>${v}</dd>`).join('') || '<dt>Sem dados</dt><dd>-</dd>'}
+      </dl>
+    `;
+  }
+}
+
+function renderHealthError(msg) {
+  ['health-db', 'health-sessions', 'health-disk', 'health-notifications'].forEach(id => {
+    const el = document.getElementById(id);
+    if (el) el.innerHTML = `<p class="field-hint error">${msg}</p>`;
+  });
+}
+
+// ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+// Usage Tab
+// ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+async function initUsageTab() {
+  const btnRefresh = document.getElementById('btn-refresh-usage');
+  if (btnRefresh) {
+    btnRefresh.addEventListener('click', loadUsage);
+  }
+  await loadUsage();
+}
+
+async function loadUsage() {
+  try {
+    const res = await fetch('/admin/usage');
+    const data = await res.json();
+    if (data.ok) {
+      renderUsage(data.usage);
+    } else {
+      renderUsageError('Erro ao carregar uso global');
+    }
+  } catch (err) {
+    renderUsageError('Erro de conexão');
+  }
+}
+
+function renderUsage(usage) {
+  const reservationsEl = document.getElementById('usage-reservations');
+  const providersEl = document.getElementById('usage-providers');
+  const deepseekEl = document.getElementById('usage-deepseek');
+
+  if (reservationsEl) {
+    const r = usage.reservations || {};
+    reservationsEl.innerHTML = `
+      <dl class="health-dl">
+        <dt>Total</dt><dd>${r.total_reservations || 0}</dd>
+        <dt>Completas</dt><dd>${r.completed || 0}</dd>
+        <dt>Reembolsadas</dt><dd>${r.refunded || 0}</dd>
+        <dt>Reservadas</dt><dd>${r.reserved || 0}</dd>
+      </dl>
+    `;
+  }
+
+  if (providersEl) {
+    const providers = usage.by_provider || [];
+    if (providers.length) {
+      providersEl.innerHTML = `
+        <table class="admin-table">
+          <thead><tr><th>Provedor</th><th>Operação</th><th>Chamadas</th><th>Tokens In</th><th>Tokens Out</th></tr></thead>
+          <tbody>
+            ${providers.map(p => `
+              <tr>
+                <td>${p.provider}</td>
+                <td>${p.operation}</td>
+                <td>${p.calls}</td>
+                <td>${p.total_input_tokens || 0}</td>
+                <td>${p.total_output_tokens || 0}</td>
+              </tr>
+            `).join('')}
+          </tbody>
+        </table>
+      `;
+    } else {
+      providersEl.innerHTML = '<p class="field-hint">Nenhum dado de uso por provedor.</p>';
+    }
+  }
+
+  if (deepseekEl) {
+    const d = usage.deepseek || {};
+    deepseekEl.innerHTML = `
+      <dl class="health-dl">
+        <dt>Chamadas</dt><dd>${d.calls || 0}</dd>
+        <dt>Tokens Entrada</dt><dd>${d.total_input_tokens || 0}</dd>
+        <dt>Tokens Saída</dt><dd>${d.total_output_tokens || 0}</dd>
+        <dt>Custo Estimado (USD)</dt><dd>$${(d.total_cost || 0).toFixed(4)}</dd>
+      </dl>
+    `;
+  }
+}
+
+function renderUsageError(msg) {
+  ['usage-reservations', 'usage-providers', 'usage-deepseek'].forEach(id => {
+    const el = document.getElementById(id);
+    if (el) el.innerHTML = `<p class="field-hint error">${msg}</p>`;
+  });
+}
+
+// ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+// Limits Tab
+// ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+async function initLimitsTab() {
+  const searchForm = document.getElementById('limits-search-form');
+  const editForm = document.getElementById('limits-edit-form');
+  const cancelBtn = document.getElementById('btn-cancel-limits');
+  const statusEl = document.getElementById('limits-status');
+
+  if (searchForm) {
+    searchForm.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
+      e.preventDefault();
+      const email = document.getElementById('limits-account-email').value.trim();
+      await loadAccountLimits(email);
+    });
+  }
+
+  if (editForm) {
+    editForm.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
+      e.preventDefault();
+      const accountId = document.getElementById('limits-account-id').value;
+      const payload = {
+        ai_analysis_limit: parseInt(document.getElementById('limits-ai-analysis').value, 10),
+        deepseek_explanation_limit: parseInt(document.getElementById('limits-deepseek-explanation').value, 10),
+        is_admin: document.getElementById('limits-is-admin').checked
+      };
+      await saveAccountLimits(accountId, payload);
+    });
+  }
+
+  if (cancelBtn) {
+    cancelBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
+      document.getElementById('limits-edit-form').hidden = true;
+      document.getElementById('limits-search-form').hidden = false;
+      statusEl.hidden = true;
+    });
+  }
+}
+
+async function loadAccountLimits(email) {
+  const statusEl = document.getElementById('limits-status');
+  const searchForm = document.getElementById('limits-search-form');
+  const editForm = document.getElementById('limits-edit-form');
+
+  try {
+    // Search account by email
+    const res = await fetch(`/admin/accounts`);
+    const html = await res.text();
+    // Parse accounts from the page - simpler approach: use a search endpoint if available
+    // For now, we'll need an API endpoint. Let's check if we can get account by email
+    // Actually, we need to add an endpoint for this. For now, let's use a workaround.
+    showStatus(statusEl, 'Funcionalidade de busca por email precisa de endpoint adicional.', 'error');
+  } catch (err) {
+    showStatus(statusEl, 'Erro de conexão.', 'error');
+  }
+}
+
+async function saveAccountLimits(accountId, payload) {
+  const statusEl = document.getElementById('limits-status');
+  try {
+    const res = await fetch(`/admin/accounts/${accountId}/limits`, {
+      method: 'POST',
+      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+      body: JSON.stringify(payload)
+    });
+    const data = await res.json();
+    if (data.ok) {
+      showStatus(statusEl, 'Limites atualizados com sucesso.', 'success');
+    } else {
+      showStatus(statusEl, data.message || 'Erro ao salvar limites.', 'error');
+    }
+  } catch (err) {
+    showStatus(statusEl, 'Erro de conexão.', 'error');
+  }
+}
+
+// ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+// Utility
+// ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+function formatBytes(bytes) {
+  if (bytes === 0) return '0 B';
+  const k = 1024;
+  const sizes = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB'];
+  const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k));
+  return parseFloat((bytes / Math.pow(k, i)).toFixed(2)) + ' ' + sizes[i];
+}
+
+function showStatus(el, message, type) {
+  if (!el) return;
+  el.textContent = message;
+  el.className = type === 'success' ? 'notice success' : 'notice error';
+  el.hidden = false;
+  setTimeout(() => { el.hidden = true; }, 5000);
+}
