+const healthBadge = document.querySelector(".environment-badge");
+
+if (healthBadge) {
+  healthBadge.title = "Ambiente privado da nova aplicação";
+}
+
+function normalizeLegacyPublicHash() {
+  if (!window.location || window.location.pathname !== "/") return;
+  const hash = window.location.hash || "";
+  const legacyPrefix = "#" + "/site";
+  if (!hash.startsWith(legacyPrefix)) return;
+
+  const section = hash.slice(legacyPrefix.length).replace(/^\/+/, "");
+  const allowedSections = new Set(["como-funciona", "recursos", "demonstracao", "precos", "suporte"]);
+  const nextHash = allowedSections.has(section) ? `#${section}` : "";
+  if (window.history && typeof window.history.replaceState === "function") {
+    window.history.replaceState(null, "", nextHash || window.location.pathname);
+  } else {
+    window.location.hash = nextHash;
+  }
+}
+
+function appendText(parent, tagName, text, className = "") {
+  const element = document.createElement(tagName);
+  if (className) element.className = className;
+  element.textContent = text;
+  parent.appendChild(element);
+  return element;
+}
+
+function readPublicDemoModels() {
+  const dataNode = document.querySelector("#public-demo-data");
+  if (!dataNode) return [];
+  try {
+    const models = JSON.parse(dataNode.textContent || "[]");
+    return Array.isArray(models) ? models : [];
+  } catch (_error) {
+    return [];
+  }
+}
+
+function closePublicDemo(dialog) {
+  if (!dialog) return;
+  if (typeof dialog.close === "function") {
+    dialog.close();
+  } else {
+    dialog.removeAttribute("open");
+    dialog.hidden = true;
+  }
+}
+
+function escapeHtml(value) {
+  return String(value ?? "")
+    .replaceAll("&", "&amp;")
+    .replaceAll("<", "&lt;")
+    .replaceAll(">", "&gt;")
+    .replaceAll('"', "&quot;")
+    .replaceAll("'", "&#039;");
+}
+
+function publicModelValue(value) {
+  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.join("\n");
+  if (value && typeof value === "object") return JSON.stringify(value, null, 2);
+  return String(value ?? "");
+}
+
+function renderPublicModelField(field) {
+  const value = publicModelValue(field.value);
+  const label = `${field.label || "Campo"}${field.required ? " *" : ""}`;
+  if (field.type === "select") {
+    const selected = String(field.value ?? "");
+    const options = (field.options || []).map(([option, text]) =>
+      `<option value="${escapeHtml(option)}" ${String(option) === selected ? "selected" : ""}>${escapeHtml(text)}</option>`
+    ).join("");
+    return `<label class="public-model-field"><span>${escapeHtml(label)}</span><select disabled>${options || `<option>${escapeHtml(value || "Não preenchido neste modelo.")}</option>`}</select></label>`;
+  }
+  return `<label class="public-model-field"><span>${escapeHtml(label)}</span><textarea readonly rows="${field.size === "large" ? 7 : 3}">${escapeHtml(value || "Não preenchido neste modelo.")}</textarea></label>`;
+}
+
+function renderPublicModelSpecial(stage, model) {
+  if (stage.custom === "criteria") {
+    return `<section class="public-model-special"><h3>Critérios e valores</h3><textarea readonly rows="8">${escapeHtml(stage.criteria_text || "Não preenchido neste modelo.")}</textarea></section>`;
+  }
+  if (stage.custom === "sources") {
+    const sources = model.workflow?.sources || [];
+    return `<section class="public-model-special"><h3>Fontes registradas</h3><ol class="public-model-sources">${sources.map((source) => `<li><strong>${escapeHtml(source.category || "Fonte")}</strong><span>${escapeHtml(source.reference || "")}</span></li>`).join("")}</ol></section>`;
+  }
+  if (stage.custom === "development") {
+    return `<section class="public-model-special"><h3>Desenvolvimento preenchido</h3>${(stage.development_sections || []).map((section) => `<div class="public-model-development"><h4>${escapeHtml(section.title || "Tópico")}</h4><textarea readonly rows="8">${escapeHtml(section.content || "")}</textarea></div>`).join("")}</section>`;
+  }
+  return "";
+}
+
+function renderPublicModelSections(stage) {
+  return (stage.demo_sections || []).map((section) => `
+    <section class="public-model-filled-section">
+      <h4>${escapeHtml(section.title || "Seção preenchida")}</h4>
+      ${(section.paragraphs || []).map((paragraph) => `<p>${escapeHtml(paragraph)}</p>`).join("")}
+    </section>`).join("");
+}
+
+function renderPublicModelWorkflow(body, model, requestedStep = 0) {
+  const stages = Array.isArray(model.stages) ? model.stages : [];
+  if (!stages.length) {
+    body.innerHTML = `<p class="sales-lede">Este modelo preenchido ainda não possui etapas disponíveis.</p>`;
+    return;
+  }
+  const step = Math.max(0, Math.min(Number(requestedStep) || 0, stages.length - 1));
+  const stage = stages[step];
+  body.innerHTML = `
+    <div class="public-model-workflow">
+      <p class="public-model-note">Este é o mesmo roteiro de um trabalho preenchido, em modo somente leitura. Você pode percorrer as etapas sem alterar nenhum projeto.</p>
+      <nav class="public-model-step-nav" aria-label="Etapas do modelo preenchido">
+        ${stages.map((item, index) => `<button type="button" data-public-model-step="${index}" class="${index === step ? "is-current" : ""}" aria-current="${index === step ? "step" : "false"}"><span>${String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0")}</span>${escapeHtml(item.title || "Etapa")}</button>`).join("")}
+      </nav>
+      <article class="public-model-stage">
+        <p class="sales-kicker">Etapa ${String(step + 1).padStart(2, "0")} de ${String(stages.length).padStart(2, "0")}</p>
+        <h3>${escapeHtml(stage.title || "Etapa preenchida")}</h3>
+        <p class="public-model-intro">${escapeHtml(stage.intro || "Confira o conteúdo preenchido nesta etapa.")}</p>
+        ${stage.fields?.length ? `<div class="public-model-fields">${stage.fields.map(renderPublicModelField).join("")}</div>` : ""}
+        ${renderPublicModelSpecial(stage, model)}
+        ${renderPublicModelSections(stage)}
+        ${stage.custom === "review" ? `<div class="public-model-review"><strong>Revisão do modelo</strong><p>O trabalho preenchido está disponível para consulta etapa por etapa e também no botão “Ler trabalho completo”.</p></div>` : ""}
+        <div class="public-model-actions"><button type="button" class="button" data-public-model-step="${step - 1}" ${step === 0 ? "disabled" : ""}>Anterior</button><span>Modelo para consulta</span><button type="button" class="button button-primary" data-public-model-step="${step + 1}" ${step === stages.length - 1 ? "disabled" : ""}>Próxima etapa</button></div>
+      </article>
+    </div>`;
+}
+
+function renderPublicDemo(dialog, model, mode) {
+  const body = document.querySelector("#public-demo-body");
+  const title = document.querySelector("#public-demo-title");
+  if (!dialog || !body || !title || !model) return;
+
+  body.replaceChildren();
+  title.textContent = model.title || "Demonstração";
+  appendText(body, "p", model.type_label || "Modelo preenchido", "sales-kicker");
+  appendText(body, "p", `Disciplina: ${model.discipline || ""}`, "sales-window-note");
+
+  if (mode === "workflow") {
+    body.dataset.modelId = model.id;
+    renderPublicModelWorkflow(body, model);
+  } else {
+    const question = document.createElement("p");
+    question.className = "sales-preview-question";
+    appendText(question, "small", model.question_label || "Contexto");
+    question.appendChild(document.createTextNode(model.question || ""));
+    body.appendChild(question);
+
+    for (const section of model.sections || []) {
+      const article = document.createElement("section");
+      appendText(article, "h3", section.title || "Seção");
+      for (const paragraph of section.paragraphs || []) {
+        appendText(article, "p", paragraph);
+      }
+      body.appendChild(article);
+    }
+  }
+
+  dialog.hidden = false;
+  if (typeof dialog.showModal === "function" && !dialog.open) {
+    dialog.showModal();
+  } else {
+    dialog.setAttribute("open", "");
+  }
+}
+
+function bindPublicDemos() {
+  const dialog = document.querySelector("#public-demo-dialog");
+  const models = readPublicDemoModels();
+  if (!dialog || !models.length) return;
+  const byId = new Map(models.map((model) => [model.id, model]));
+
+  document.querySelectorAll("[data-model-workflow]").forEach((button) => {
+    button.addEventListener("click", () => renderPublicDemo(dialog, byId.get(button.dataset.modelWorkflow), "workflow"));
+  });
+  document.querySelectorAll("[data-model-document]").forEach((button) => {
+    button.addEventListener("click", () => renderPublicDemo(dialog, byId.get(button.dataset.modelDocument), "document"));
+  });
+  document.querySelectorAll("[data-demo-close]").forEach((button) => {
+    button.addEventListener("click", () => closePublicDemo(dialog));
+  });
+  const demoBody = document.querySelector("#public-demo-body");
+  demoBody?.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
+    const button = event.target.closest("[data-public-model-step]");
+    if (!button || button.disabled) return;
+    const model = byId.get(demoBody.dataset.modelId);
+    if (model) renderPublicModelWorkflow(demoBody, model, Number(button.dataset.publicModelStep));
+  });
+  dialog.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
+    if (event.target === dialog) closePublicDemo(dialog);
+  });
+  dialog.addEventListener("close", () => {
+    const body = document.querySelector("#public-demo-body");
+    if (body) body.replaceChildren();
+  });
+}
+
+function setCopyStatus(button, message) {
+  const payment = button.closest(".pix-payment");
+  const status = payment && payment.querySelector("[data-pix-status]");
+  if (status) status.textContent = message;
+}
+
+function fallbackCopy(text) {
+  const textarea = document.createElement("textarea");
+  textarea.value = text;
+  textarea.setAttribute("readonly", "");
+  textarea.style.position = "fixed";
+  textarea.style.opacity = "0";
+  document.body.appendChild(textarea);
+  textarea.select();
+  let copied = false;
+  try {
+    copied = Boolean(document.execCommand("copy"));
+  } catch (_error) {
+    copied = false;
+  }
+  textarea.remove();
+  return copied;
+}
+
+function bindPixCopy() {
+  document.querySelectorAll("[data-pix-copy]").forEach((button) => {
+    button.addEventListener("click", async () => {
+      const payment = button.closest(".pix-payment");
+      const payload = payment && payment.querySelector(".pix-payload");
+      const text = payload ? payload.textContent.trim() : "";
+      if (!text) {
+        setCopyStatus(button, "Código Pix indisponível.");
+        return;
+      }
+
+      let copied = false;
+      if (navigator.clipboard && typeof navigator.clipboard.writeText === "function") {
+        try {
+          await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
+          copied = true;
+        } catch (_error) {
+          copied = false;
+        }
+      }
+      if (!copied) copied = fallbackCopy(text);
+      setCopyStatus(button, copied ? "Código Pix copiado." : "Não foi possível copiar. Selecione o código completo.");
+    });
+  });
+}
+
+normalizeLegacyPublicHash();
+bindPublicDemos();
+bindPixCopy();
diff --git a/static/js/autosave.js b/static/js/autosave.js
@@ -0,0 +1,175 @@
+/**
+ * Autosave Module - Assistente Acadêmico
+ * Handles form change detection, debounced saving, conflict resolution
+ */
+export function createAutosave({ form, collectPayload, saveUrl, onStateChange }) {
+  if (!form) return { flush: () => Promise.resolve(false) };
+
+  const saveState = form.querySelector("[data-save-state]");
+  const reloadButton = form.querySelector("[data-reload-editor]");
+  let timer = null;
+  let saveInFlight = false;
+  let saveQueued = false;
+  let changeSequence = 0;
+  let savedSequence = 0;
+  let lastSaveSucceeded = true;
+  let hasConflict = false;
+
+  function setSaveState(message) {
+    if (saveState) saveState.textContent = message;
+    onStateChange?.({ message, hasConflict, saving: saveInFlight });
+  }
+
+  function isAiControl(target) {
+    return Boolean(target?.closest?.("[data-ai-field], [data-ai-instruction]"));
+  }
+
+  function queueSave(delay = 700) {
+    if (!form || hasConflict) return;
+    window.clearTimeout(timer);
+    setSaveState("Alteração pendente…");
+    timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
+      timer = null;
+      void save();
+    }, delay);
+  }
+
+  function markDirty(event) {
+    if (isAiControl(event?.target)) return;
+    if (event?.target?.matches?.("[data-project-source]")) {
+      form.querySelectorAll("[data-project-source]").forEach((input) => {
+        if (input.value === event.target.value) input.checked = event.target.checked;
+      });
+    }
+    changeSequence += 1;
+    if (hasConflict) {
+      setSaveState("Conflito: recarregue a versão do servidor antes de salvar.");
+      return;
+    }
+    queueSave();
+  }
+
+  async function readJson(response) {
+    const text = await response.text();
+    if (!text) return {};
+    try {
+      return JSON.parse(text);
+    } catch {
+      return {};
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function save() {
+    if (!form || hasConflict) return;
+    window.clearTimeout(timer);
+    timer = null;
+    if (saveInFlight) {
+      saveQueued = true;
+      setSaveState("Salvando…");
+      return;
+    }
+
+    const requestSequence = changeSequence;
+    const csrf = form.querySelector("[name=csrf_token]")?.value;
+    if (!csrf) {
+      setSaveState("Não foi possível salvar: sessão sem proteção CSRF.");
+      return;
+    }
+
+    saveInFlight = true;
+    saveQueued = false;
+    setSaveState("Salvando…");
+    let followUpDelay = null;
+
+    try {
+      const response = await fetch(saveUrl, {
+        method: "POST",
+        credentials: "same-origin",
+        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-CSRF-Token": csrf },
+        body: JSON.stringify({ revision: Number(form.dataset.revision), payload: collectPayload() }),
+      });
+      const result = await readJson(response);
+
+      if (!response.ok) {
+        const error = new Error(result.error || "save_failed");
+        error.code = result.error;
+        error.status = response.status;
+        error.revision = result.revision;
+        throw error;
+      }
+      if (result.revision === undefined || result.revision === null) {
+        const error = new Error("save_failed");
+        error.code = "save_failed";
+        throw error;
+      }
+
+      savedSequence = requestSequence;
+      lastSaveSucceeded = true;
+      form.dataset.revision = String(result.revision);
+      if (reloadButton) reloadButton.hidden = true;
+
+      if (requestSequence < changeSequence) {
+        setSaveState("Salvo; salvando alterações recentes…");
+        followUpDelay = 0;
+      } else {
+        setSaveState("Salvo agora");
+      }
+    } catch (error) {
+      lastSaveSucceeded = false;
+      if (error.code === "project_conflict" || error.status === 409) {
+        hasConflict = true;
+        window.clearTimeout(timer);
+        timer = null;
+        saveQueued = false;
+        if (reloadButton) reloadButton.hidden = false;
+        const revision = error.revision === undefined ? "mais recente" : `revisão ${error.revision}`;
+        setSaveState(`Conflito: o servidor tem a ${revision}. Recarregue antes de continuar.`);
+      } else {
+        if (requestSequence < changeSequence) followUpDelay = 700;
+        setSaveState(requestSequence < changeSequence
+          ? "Não foi possível salvar; suas alterações continuam pendentes."
+          : "Não foi possível salvar.");
+      }
+    } finally {
+      saveInFlight = false;
+      if ((saveQueued || followUpDelay !== null) && !hasConflict) {
+        saveQueued = false;
+        if (followUpDelay !== null) queueSave(followUpDelay);
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function flushSave() {
+    window.clearTimeout(timer);
+    timer = null;
+    while (saveInFlight) await new Promise((resolve) => window.setTimeout(resolve, 30));
+    if (hasConflict) return false;
+    if (savedSequence < changeSequence) await save();
+    while (saveInFlight) await new Promise((resolve) => window.setTimeout(resolve, 30));
+    return !hasConflict && lastSaveSucceeded && savedSequence >= changeSequence;
+  }
+
+  // Bind events
+  form.addEventListener("input", markDirty);
+  form.addEventListener("change", markDirty);
+  form.addEventListener("submit", (event) => {
+    event.preventDefault();
+    if (hasConflict) {
+      setSaveState("Conflito: recarregue a versão do servidor antes de salvar.");
+      return;
+    }
+    window.clearTimeout(timer);
+    timer = null;
+    void save();
+  });
+  reloadButton?.addEventListener("click", () => window.location.reload());
+
+  window.addEventListener("beforeunload", (event) => {
+    if (saveInFlight || savedSequence < changeSequence || hasConflict) {
+      event.preventDefault();
+      event.returnValue = "";
+    }
+  });
+
+  return { markDirty, save, flushSave, hasConflict: () => hasConflict };
+}

+/**
+ * Duplicate Project Module - Assistente Acadêmico
+ * Handles project duplication functionality
+ */
+export function initDuplicate({ form, flushSave, readJson }) {
+  if (!form || !form.dataset.duplicateUrl) return;
+
+  form.querySelector("[data-duplicate-project]")?.addEventListener("click", async () => {
+    const button = form.querySelector("[data-duplicate-project]");
+    const saveState = form.querySelector("[data-save-state]");
+    button.disabled = true;
+    if (saveState) saveState.textContent = "Duplicando projeto…";
+    try {
+      if (!await flushSave()) throw new Error("Salve as alterações antes de duplicar.");
+      const csrf = form.querySelector("[name=csrf_token]")?.value;
+      if (!csrf) throw new Error("Sessão sem proteção CSRF.");
+      const response = await fetch(form.dataset.duplicateUrl, {
+        method: "POST",
+        credentials: "same-origin",
+        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-CSRF-Token": csrf },
+        body: JSON.stringify({ revision: Number(form.dataset.revision) })
+      });
+      const result = await readJson(response);
+      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.error || "Erro ao duplicar.");
+      if (result.project_url) {
+        if (saveState) saveState.textContent = "Projeto duplicado. Redirecionando…";
+        window.location.href = result.project_url;
+      } else {
+        throw new Error("URL do projeto não retornada.");
+      }
+    } catch (error) {
+      if (saveState) saveState.textContent = error.message;
+      button.disabled = false;
+    }
+  });
+}

diff --git a/static/js/jev-panel.js b/static/js/jev-panel.js
@@ -0,0 +1,148 @@
+/**
+ * JEV Panel Module - Assistente Acadêmico
+ * Handles JEV Section/Report/Explanation functionality
+ */
+
+let currentAbortController = null;
+
+function abortCurrentRequest() {
+  if (currentAbortController) {
+    currentAbortController.abort();
+    currentAbortController = null;
+  }
+}
+
+function showLoading(target, message) {
+  if (target) {
+    target.textContent = message;
+    target.dataset.loading = "true";
+  }
+}
+
+function hideLoading(target) {
+  if (target) {
+    delete target.dataset.loading;
+  }
+}
+
+async function callJev(form, action, payload, signal) {
+  const csrf = form.querySelector("[name=csrf_token]")?.value;
+  if (!csrf) throw new Error("Sessão sem proteção CSRF.");
+  const response = await fetch(form.dataset.jevUrl, {
+    method: "POST",
+    credentials: "same-origin",
+    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-CSRF-Token": csrf },
+    body: JSON.stringify({ action, ...payload, revision: Number(form.dataset.revision) }),
+    signal
+  });
+  const result = await response.json();
+  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.error || `Erro no ${action}.`);
+  return result;
+}
+
+function escapeHtml(value) {
+  const node = document.createElement("span");
+  node.textContent = String(value ?? "");
+  return node.innerHTML;
+}
+
+function renderJevResponse(analysis) {
+  if (!analysis) return "";
+  const items = (analysis.criteria || []).map((item) => {
+    const probability = Array.isArray(item.probabilities) ? Math.max(...item.probabilities) : 0;
+    return `<li class="ai-jev-item"><div><strong>${escapeHtml(item.title || item.label || item.id)}</strong> <span class="ai-score">${escapeHtml(item.score)} / 3</span></div><div class="ai-score-bar"><span style="width:${Math.round(probability * 100)}%"></span></div>${item.observation ? `<p>${escapeHtml(item.observation)}</p>` : ""}<button type="button" class="text-button" data-jev-explain="${escapeHtml(item.id)}">Entender esta observação</button></li>`;
+  }).join("");
+  const heading = analysis.expected_points !== undefined
+    ? `<p><strong>${Number(analysis.expected_points).toFixed(2)} / ${Number(analysis.assessable_points || 3.5).toFixed(2)} pontos estimados.</strong></p>`
+    : "<p>Leitura formativa da etapa; não é nota oficial.</p>";
+  const grade = analysis.grade_range
+    ? `<p><strong>Faixa provável:</strong> nível ${escapeHtml(analysis.grade_range.score)} de 0 a 3.</p>`
+    : "";
+  return `<article class="ai-response-card"><h4>Resultado da avaliação</h4>${heading}${grade}<ul class="ai-jev-list">${items}</ul><small class="field-hint">A avaliação usa o texto enviado e deve ser conferida pelo estudante; não verifica automaticamente a correção jurídica das fontes.</small></article>`;
+}
+
+export function initJevPanel({ form, flushSave, readJson, collectPayload }) {
+  if (!form || !form.dataset.jevUrl) return;
+
+  const setSaveState = (msg) => {
+    const saveState = form.querySelector("[data-save-state]");
+    if (saveState) saveState.textContent = msg;
+  };
+
+  // JEV Section
+  form.querySelector("[data-jev-section]")?.addEventListener("click", async () => {
+    const button = form.querySelector("[data-jev-section]");
+    const resultEl = form.querySelector("[data-jev-result]");
+    const sectionSelect = form.querySelector("[data-jev-section-select]");
+    const section = sectionSelect?.value;
+    if (!section) { resultEl.textContent = "Selecione uma seção."; return; }
+    abortCurrentRequest();
+    currentAbortController = new AbortController();
+    button.disabled = true;
+    showLoading(resultEl, "Avaliando seção…");
+    try {
+      const result = await callJev(form, "section", { section, payload: collectPayload() }, currentAbortController.signal);
+      resultEl.textContent = result.answer || "Sem resposta.";
+      if (result.suggestions?.length) {
+        const list = document.createElement("ul");
+        result.suggestions.forEach(s => { const li = document.createElement("li"); li.textContent = s.text; list.append(li); });
+        resultEl.append(list);
+      }
+    } catch (error) {
+      if (error.name !== "AbortError") {
+        resultEl.textContent = error.message;
+      }
+    } finally {
+      hideLoading(resultEl);
+      button.disabled = false;
+      currentAbortController = null;
+    }
+  });
+
+  // JEV Report
+  form.querySelector("[data-jev-report]")?.addEventListener("click", async () => {
+    const button = form.querySelector("[data-jev-report]");
+    const resultEl = form.querySelector("[data-jev-result]");
+    abortCurrentRequest();
+    currentAbortController = new AbortController();
+    button.disabled = true;
+    showLoading(resultEl, "Gerando relatório JEV completo…");
+    try {
+      const result = await callJev(form, "report", { payload: collectPayload() }, currentAbortController.signal);
+      resultEl.innerHTML = renderJevResponse(result.analysis);
+    } catch (error) {
+      if (error.name !== "AbortError") {
+        resultEl.textContent = error.message;
+      }
+    } finally {
+      hideLoading(resultEl);
+      button.disabled = false;
+      currentAbortController = null;
+    }
+  });
+
+  // JEV Explanation
+  form.querySelector("[data-jev-explanation]")?.addEventListener("click", async () => {
+    const button = form.querySelector("[data-jev-explanation]");
+    const resultEl = form.querySelector("[data-jev-result]");
+    const criterionSelect = form.querySelector("[data-jev-criterion-select]");
+    const criterion = criterionSelect?.value;
+    if (!criterion) { resultEl.textContent = "Selecione um critério."; return; }
+    abortCurrentRequest();
+    currentAbortController = new AbortController();
+    button.disabled = true;
+    showLoading(resultEl, "Gerando explicação DeepSeek…");
+    try {
+      const result = await callJev(form, "explanation", { criterion, payload: collectPayload() }, currentAbortController.signal);
+      resultEl.textContent = result.answer || "Sem resposta.";
+    } catch (error) {
+      if (error.name !== "AbortError") {
+        resultEl.textContent = error.message;
+      }
+    } finally {
+      hideLoading(resultEl);
+      button.disabled = false;
+      currentAbortController = null;
+    }
+  });
+}

+/**
+ * PDF Export Module - Assistente Acadêmico
+ * Handles Quarto PDF export functionality
+ */
+export function initPdfExport({ form, flushSave, readJson }) {
+  if (!form || !form.dataset.exportQuartoUrl) return;
+
+  form.querySelectorAll("[data-export-quarto]").forEach((button) => {
+    button.addEventListener("click", async () => {
+      button.disabled = true;
+      const saveState = form.querySelector("[data-save-state]");
+      if (saveState) saveState.textContent = "Gerando PDF via Quarto…";
+      try {
+        if (!await flushSave()) throw new Error("Salve as alterações antes de exportar.");
+        const csrf = form.querySelector("[name=csrf_token]")?.value;
+        if (!csrf) throw new Error("Sessão sem proteção CSRF.");
+        const response = await fetch(form.dataset.exportQuartoUrl, {
+          method: "POST",
+          credentials: "same-origin",
+          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-CSRF-Token": csrf },
+          body: JSON.stringify({ revision: Number(form.dataset.revision) })
+        });
+        const result = await readJson(response);
+        if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.error || "Erro ao gerar PDF.");
+        if (result.download_url) {
+          window.open(result.download_url, "_blank");
+          if (saveState) saveState.textContent = "PDF gerado com sucesso.";
+        } else {
+          throw new Error("URL de download não retornada.");
+        }
+      } catch (error) {
+        if (saveState) saveState.textContent = error.message;
+      } finally {
+        button.disabled = false;
+      }
+    });
+  });
+}

+const settings = document.querySelector('[data-profile-settings]');

+window.addEventListener('hashchange', panelFromHash);
+panelFromHash();
diff --git a/static/js/project-ai.js b/static/js/project-ai.js
@@ -0,0 +1,250 @@
+// Assistência contextual do editor. O módulo recebe as operações do autosave para não duplicar estado.
+export function initEditorAi({ form, readJson, markDirty, flushSave, stages, showStep, createInlineSource, appendProjectSource }) {
+  // Recuperação do fluxo de IA do editor legado: ações ficam dentro da etapa,
+  // e nenhuma sugestão é aplicada sem confirmação explícita.
+  const richAiResults = new Map();
+  let currentAbortController = null;
+
+  function escapeAi(value) {
+    const node = document.createElement("span");
+    node.textContent = String(value ?? "");
+    return node.innerHTML;
+  }
+
+  function showLoading(target, message) {
+    if (target) {
+      target.textContent = message;
+      target.dataset.loading = "true";
+    }
+  }
+
+  function hideLoading(target) {
+    if (target) {
+      delete target.dataset.loading;
+    }
+  }
+
+  function abortCurrentRequest() {
+    if (currentAbortController) {
+      currentAbortController.abort();
+      currentAbortController = null;
+    }
+  }
+
+  // Clean up on page unload
+  window.addEventListener("beforeunload", abortCurrentRequest);
+
+  function aiContextFields(stageId = "") {
+    const stage = form?.querySelector(`[data-stage="${CSS.escape(stageId)}"]`);
+    return [...(stage?.querySelectorAll("[data-case-field]") || [])].map((field) => field.dataset.caseField);
+  }
+
+  function applyRichField(fieldId, value) {
+    if (!fieldId || !String(value).trim()) return false;
+    const direct = form.querySelector(`[data-case-field="${CSS.escape(fieldId)}"]`);
+    if (direct) {
+      direct.value = value;
+      direct.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
+      return true;
+    }
+    const parts = String(fieldId).split(":");
+    if (parts[0] === "criterion" && parts.length === 3) {
+      const card = [...form.querySelectorAll("[data-criterion]")].find((item) => item.dataset.criterionId === parts[1]);
+      const field = card?.querySelector(`[data-criterion-field="${CSS.escape(parts[2])}"]`);
+      if (field) {
+        field.value = value;
+        field.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
+        return true;
+      }
+    }
+    return false;
+  }
+
+  function renderRichResponse(response, key) {
+    const suggestions = (response?.suggestions || []).filter((item) => !item.declined);
+    const suggestionHtml = suggestions.length ? `<div><strong>Possíveis ajustes</strong><ul class="ai-suggestion-list">${suggestions.map((item, index) => `<li class="ai-suggestion-item"><span>${escapeAi(item.text)}</span><small class="field-hint">Campo: ${escapeAi(item.field_id || "confira manualmente")}</small><div class="ai-suggestion-actions"><button type="button" class="text-button" data-rich-ai-apply="${escapeAi(key)}" data-rich-ai-index="${index}">Aplicar</button><button type="button" class="text-button" data-rich-ai-edit="${escapeAi(key)}" data-rich-ai-index="${index}">Editar e aplicar</button><button type="button" class="text-button" data-rich-ai-decline="${escapeAi(key)}" data-rich-ai-index="${index}">Ignorar</button></div></li>`).join("")}</ul></div>` : "";
+    const rewriteHtml = response?.rewrite ? `<div class="ai-suggestion-item"><strong>Revisão opcional do campo</strong><p>${escapeAi(response.rewrite)}</p><button type="button" class="text-button" data-rich-ai-rewrite="${escapeAi(key)}">Substituir campo</button></div>` : "";
+    const validation = response?.validation;
+    const validationHtml = validation ? `<div class="ai-validation"><strong>Avaliação estruturada: ${escapeAi(validation.status || "não avaliado")}</strong>${(validation.observations || []).length ? `<ul>${validation.observations.map((item) => `<li>${escapeAi(item)}</li>`).join("")}</ul>` : ""}</div>` : "";
+    const checklistHtml = (response?.checklist || []).length ? `<ul class="ai-suggestion-list">${response.checklist.map((item) => `<li class="ai-suggestion-item"><strong>${escapeAi(item.id)}</strong><span>Confiança: ${Math.round(Number(item.confidence || 0) * 100)}%</span><small>${escapeAi(item.evidence || "Sem evidência textual.")}</small></li>`).join("")}</ul>` : "";
+    return `<article class="ai-response-card"><p>${escapeAi(response?.answer || "Não houve resposta textual.")}</p>${suggestionHtml}${rewriteHtml}${checklistHtml}${validationHtml}<small class="field-hint">Resposta gerada sob solicitação; confira tudo antes de usar.</small></article>`;
+  }
+
+  function renderJevResponse(analysis) {
+    if (!analysis) return "";
+    const items = (analysis.criteria || []).map((item) => {
+      const probability = Array.isArray(item.probabilities) ? Math.max(...item.probabilities) : 0;
+      return `<li class="ai-jev-item"><div><strong>${escapeAi(item.title || item.label || item.id)}</strong> <span class="ai-score">${escapeAi(item.score)} / 3</span></div><div class="ai-score-bar"><span style="width:${Math.round(probability * 100)}%"></span></div>${item.observation ? `<p>${escapeAi(item.observation)}</p>` : ""}<button type="button" class="text-button" data-jev-explain="${escapeAi(item.id)}">Entender esta observação</button></li>`;
+    }).join("");
+    const heading = analysis.expected_points !== undefined ? `<p><strong>${Number(analysis.expected_points).toFixed(2)} / ${Number(analysis.assessable_points || 3.5).toFixed(2)} pontos estimados.</strong></p>` : "<p>Leitura formativa da etapa; não é nota oficial.</p>";
+    const grade = analysis.grade_range ? `<p><strong>Faixa provável:</strong> nível ${escapeAi(analysis.grade_range.score)} de 0 a 3.</p>` : "";
+    return `<article class="ai-response-card"><h4>Resultado da avaliação</h4>${heading}${grade}<ul class="ai-jev-list">${items}</ul><small class="field-hint">A avaliação usa o texto enviado e deve ser conferida pelo estudante; não verifica automaticamente a correção jurídica das fontes.</small></article>`;
+  }
+
+  async function runRichAiAction(action, payload, target) {
+    if (!target || !form?.dataset.aiActionUrl) return;
+    abortCurrentRequest();
+    currentAbortController = new AbortController();
+    showLoading(target, "Salvando esta etapa e consultando a assistência…");
+    try {
+      if (!await flushSave()) throw new Error("Salve as alterações antes de pedir assistência.");
+      const body = { action, project_revision: Number(form.dataset.revision), context_fields: aiContextFields(payload.stage_id), ...payload };
+      const response = await fetch(form.dataset.aiActionUrl, { method: "POST", credentials: "same-origin", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-CSRF-Token": form.querySelector("[name=csrf_token]").value }, body: JSON.stringify(body), signal: currentAbortController.signal });
+      const result = await readJson(response);
+      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.message || "Não foi possível consultar a assistência.");
+      const key = `${action}:${payload.stage_id || payload.field_id || "project"}`;
+      richAiResults.set(key, result.response || result);
+      target.dataset.richAiKey = key;
+      target.innerHTML = renderRichResponse(result.response || result, key);
+    } catch (error) {
+      if (error.name !== "AbortError") {
+        target.textContent = error.message;
+      }
+    } finally {
+      hideLoading(target);
+      currentAbortController = null;
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function runJevExplanation(criterion, button) {
+    if (!form?.dataset.jevExplanationUrl || !button) return;
+    abortCurrentRequest();
+    currentAbortController = new AbortController();
+    button.disabled = true;
+    const result = document.createElement("div");
+    result.className = "ai-validation";
+    showLoading(result, "Preparando explicação…");
+    button.parentElement.append(result);
+    try {
+      if (!await flushSave()) throw new Error("Salve as alterações antes de pedir a explicação.");
+      const response = await fetch(form.dataset.jevExplanationUrl, { method: "POST", credentials: "same-origin", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-CSRF-Token": form.querySelector("[name=csrf_token]").value }, body: JSON.stringify({ criterion }), signal: currentAbortController.signal });
+      const payload = await readJson(response);
+      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(payload.message || "Não foi possível explicar esta observação.");
+      const explanation = payload.explanation || {};
+      result.innerHTML = `<strong>Explicação</strong><p>${escapeAi(explanation.interpretation || "Não houve explicação textual.")}</p>${(explanation.next_steps || []).length ? `<ul>${explanation.next_steps.map((item) => `<li>${escapeAi(item)}</li>`).join("")}</ul>` : ""}`;
+    } catch (error) {
+      if (error.name !== "AbortError") {
+        result.textContent = error.message;
+      }
+    } finally {
+      hideLoading(result);
+      button.disabled = false;
+      currentAbortController = null;
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function runJev(section, target, report = false) {
+    if (!target) return;
+    abortCurrentRequest();
+    currentAbortController = new AbortController();
+    showLoading(target, "Salvando esta etapa e calculando a avaliação…");
+    try {
+      if (!await flushSave()) throw new Error("Salve as alterações antes de pedir avaliação.");
+      const url = report ? form.dataset.jevReportUrl : form.dataset.jevSectionUrl;
+      const body = { };
+      if (!report) body.section = section;
+      const response = await fetch(url, { method: "POST", credentials: "same-origin", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-CSRF-Token": form.querySelector("[name=csrf_token]").value }, body: JSON.stringify(body), signal: currentAbortController.signal });
+      const result = await readJson(response);
+      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.message || "Não foi possível concluir a avaliação.");
+      target.innerHTML = renderJevResponse(result.analysis);
+    } catch (error) {
+      if (error.name !== "AbortError") {
+        target.textContent = error.message;
+      }
+    } finally {
+      hideLoading(target);
+      currentAbortController = null;
+    }
+  }
+
+  form?.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
+    const createSourceButton = event.target.closest("[data-create-source]");
+    if (createSourceButton) {
+      void createInlineSource(createSourceButton);
+      return;
+    }
+    const deliveryToggle = event.target.closest("[data-toggle-delivery]");
+    if (deliveryToggle) {
+      const state = deliveryToggle.closest("[data-delivery-state]");
+      if (!state) return;
+      const delivered = state.dataset.delivered === "true";
+      if (delivered) {
+        state.dataset.delivered = "false";
+        state.dataset.deliveredAt = "0";
+        state.innerHTML = `<button type="button" class="button button-primary finalize-button" data-toggle-delivery>Marcar ${state.dataset.deliveryKey === "report" ? "relatório" : "entrega"} como entregue</button>`;
+      } else {
+        state.dataset.delivered = "true";
+        state.dataset.deliveredAt = String(Date.now());
+        state.innerHTML = `<div class="notice completion-notice"><strong>${state.dataset.deliveryKey === "report" ? "Relatório" : "Entrega"} marcado como entregue.</strong><span class="delivery-edited">Você ainda pode editar o trabalho.</span><button class="text-button" type="button" data-toggle-delivery>Desfazer marcação</button></div>`;
+      }
+      markDirty();
+      return;
+    }
+    const phaseButton = event.target.closest("[data-go-phase]");
+    if (phaseButton) {
+      const target = stages.findIndex((stage) => stage.dataset.stagePhase === phaseButton.dataset.goPhase);
+      if (target >= 0) showStep(target, true);
+      return;
+    }
+    const inline = event.target.closest("[data-ai-inline]");
+    if (inline) {
+      const fieldId = inline.dataset.aiInline;
+      const target = form.querySelector(`[data-ai-field-result="${CSS.escape(fieldId)}"]`);
+      void runRichAiAction("review", { field_id: fieldId, stage_id: inline.closest("[data-stage]")?.dataset.stage || "" }, target);
+      return;
+    }
+    const stageAction = event.target.closest("[data-ai-stage-action]");
+    if (stageAction) {
+      const stageId = stageAction.dataset.aiStageId;
+      const target = form.querySelector(`[data-ai-stage-result="${CSS.escape(stageId)}"]`);
+      const checklist = [...(form.querySelector(`[data-stage="${CSS.escape(stageId)}"]`)?.querySelectorAll("[data-workflow-check]") || [])].map((input) => ({ id: input.dataset.workflowCheck, label: input.closest("label")?.textContent.trim() || input.dataset.workflowCheck }));
+      void runRichAiAction(stageAction.dataset.aiStageAction, { stage_id: stageId, checklist }, target);
+      return;
+    }
+    const jevExplain = event.target.closest("[data-jev-explain]");
+    if (jevExplain) {
+      void runJevExplanation(jevExplain.dataset.jevExplain, jevExplain);
+      return;
+    }
+    const jevButton = event.target.closest("[data-jev-section]");
+    if (jevButton) {
+      const target = jevButton.closest("[data-stage-ai]")?.querySelector("[data-ai-stage-result]");
+      void runJev(jevButton.dataset.jevSection, target);
+      return;
+    }
+    const jevReport = event.target.closest("[data-jev-report]");
+    if (jevReport) {
+      const target = jevReport.closest("[data-stage-ai]")?.querySelector("[data-ai-stage-result]");
+      void runJev("", target, true);
+      return;
+    }
+    const suggestionButton = event.target.closest("[data-rich-ai-apply], [data-rich-ai-edit], [data-rich-ai-decline]");
+    if (suggestionButton) {
+      const key = suggestionButton.dataset.richAiApply || suggestionButton.dataset.richAiEdit || suggestionButton.dataset.richAiDecline;
+      const result = richAiResults.get(key);
+      const index = Number(suggestionButton.dataset.richAiIndex);
+      const suggestion = result?.suggestions?.[index];
+      if (!suggestion) return;
+      if (suggestionButton.hasAttribute("data-rich-ai-decline")) {
+        suggestion.declined = true;
+      } else {
+        let value = suggestion.text;
+        if (suggestionButton.hasAttribute("data-rich-ai-edit")) value = window.prompt("Edite a sugestão antes de aplicar:", value);
+        if (value === null || value === undefined) return;
+        if (!applyRichField(suggestion.field_id, value)) suggestion.notice = "O campo não está visível nesta etapa; confira a sugestão manualmente.";
+        else markDirty();
+      }
+      const owner = suggestionButton.closest("[data-ai-stage-result], [data-ai-field-result]");
+      if (owner) owner.innerHTML = renderRichResponse(result, key);
+      return;
+    }
+    const rewrite = event.target.closest("[data-rich-ai-rewrite]");
+    if (rewrite) {
+      const result = richAiResults.get(rewrite.dataset.richAiRewrite);
+      const fieldId = rewrite.dataset.richAiRewrite.split(":").slice(1).join(":");
+      if (result?.rewrite && window.confirm("Substituir o campo pela revisão sugerida?")) {
+        if (applyRichField(fieldId, result.rewrite)) markDirty();
+      }
+    }
+  });
+}
diff --git a/static/js/project-editor.js b/static/js/project-editor.js
@@ -0,0 +1,357 @@
+/**
+ * Project Editor - Main Entry Point
+ * Orchestrates all editor modules: autosave, schedule, AI, JEV, PDF export, duplicate, revisions
+ */
+
+import { createAutosave } from "./autosave.js";
+import { initScheduleEditor, collectSchedule } from "./project-schedule.js";
+import { initEditorAi } from "./project-ai.js";
+import { initPdfExport } from "./pdf-export.js";
+import { initDuplicate } from "./duplicate.js";
+import { initRevisions } from "./revisions.js";
+import { initJevPanel } from "./jev-panel.js";
+
+const form = document.querySelector("[data-project-editor]");
+
+if (!form) {
+  // Editor not on this page
+} else {
+  // Initialize autosave with payload collector
+  const collectPayload = () => ({
+    version: 1,
+    fields: collectFields(form),
+    source_ids: [...new Set([...form.querySelectorAll("[data-project-source]:checked")].map((input) => input.value))],
+    criteria: collectCriteria(form),
+    schedule: collectSchedule(form),
+    deliveries: collectDeliveries(form),
+    checks: Object.fromEntries([...form.querySelectorAll("[data-workflow-check]")].map((input) => [input.dataset.workflowCheck, input.checked])),
+    development_sections: [...form.querySelectorAll("[data-development]")].map((card) => ({
+      id: card.dataset.developmentId,
+      title: card.querySelector("[data-development-title]").value,
+      body: card.querySelector("[data-development-body]").value,
+    })),
+  });
+
+  const { flushSave, save, markDirty, hasConflict } = createAutosave({
+    form,
+    collectPayload,
+    saveUrl: form.dataset.saveUrl,
+    onStateChange: (state) => { /* state changes handled by autosave */ }
+  });
+
+  async function readJson(response) {
+    const text = await response.text();
+    if (!text) return {};
+    try {
+      return JSON.parse(text);
+    } catch {
+      return {};
+    }
+  }
+
+  // Helper functions for payload collection
+  function collectFields(form) {
+    const fields = Object.fromEntries([...form.querySelectorAll("[data-case-field]")].map((element) => [element.dataset.caseField, element.value]));
+    const title = fields.title || form.querySelector("[data-project-title]")?.value || "";
+    return { ...fields, title };
+  }
+
+  function collectCriteria(form) {
+    return [...form.querySelectorAll("[data-criterion]")].map((card) => {
+      const value = (key) => card.querySelector(`[data-criterion-field="${key}"]`)?.value || "";
+      return { id: card.dataset.criterionId || crypto.randomUUID(), title: value("title"), definition: value("definition"), basis: value("basis") };
+    });
+  }
+
+  function collectDeliveries(form) {
+    return Object.fromEntries([...form.querySelectorAll("[data-delivery-state]")]
+      .filter((node) => node.dataset.delivered === "true")
+      .map((node) => [node.dataset.deliveryKey, { delivered: true, at: Number(node.dataset.deliveredAt || 0) }]));
+  }
+
+  // Criterion management
+  function addCriterionCard() {
+    const list = form.querySelector("[data-criteria-list]");
+    if (!list) return;
+    const card = document.createElement("fieldset");
+    card.className = "criterion-card";
+    card.dataset.criterion = "";
+    card.dataset.criterionId = crypto.randomUUID();
+    card.innerHTML = `<legend>Critério</legend><label>Nome<input data-criterion-field="title" maxlength="180"></label><label>Definição<textarea data-criterion-field="definition" maxlength="3000" rows="4"></textarea></label><label>Base ou fundamento<input data-criterion-field="basis" maxlength="1000"></label><button type="button" class="quiet-button danger" data-remove-criterion>Remover critério</button>`;
+    list.append(card);
+    card.querySelector("[data-criterion-field]").focus();
+    markDirty();
+  }
+
+  form.querySelector("[data-add-criterion]")?.addEventListener("click", addCriterionCard);
+  form.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
+    if (event.target.closest("[data-remove-criterion]")) {
+      event.target.closest("[data-criterion]").remove();
+      markDirty();
+    }
+  });
+
+  // Schedule editor
+  initScheduleEditor(form, () => markDirty());
+
+  // PDF Export (Quarto)
+  initPdfExport({ form, flushSave, readJson });
+
+  // Duplicate Project
+  initDuplicate({ form, flushSave, readJson });
+
+  // Revisions
+  initRevisions({ form, readJson, setSaveState: (msg) => { const saveState = form.querySelector("[data-save-state]"); if (saveState) saveState.textContent = msg; } });
+
+  // JEV Panel
+  initJevPanel({ form, flushSave, readJson, collectPayload });
+
+  // Export links (external links that need save first)
+  form.querySelectorAll("[data-export-link]").forEach((link) => link.addEventListener("click", async (event) => {
+    event.preventDefault();
+    const target = link.target === "_blank" ? window.open("about:blank", "_blank") : null;
+    if (!await flushSave()) { target?.close(); const saveState = form.querySelector("[data-save-state]"); if (saveState) saveState.textContent = "Salve as alterações antes de exportar."; return; }
+    if (target) { target.opener = null; target.location.href = link.href; } else window.location.href = link.href;
+  }));
+
+  // Paper mode switch
+  form.querySelectorAll("[data-paper-mode]").forEach((button) => button.addEventListener("click", async () => {
+    const saveState = form.querySelector("[data-save-state]");
+    button.disabled = true;
+    try {
+      if (!await flushSave()) throw new Error("Salve as alterações antes de trocar a etapa do Paper.");
+      const response = await fetch(button.dataset.modeUrl, { method: "POST", headers: {"Content-Type": "application/json", "X-CSRF-Token": form.querySelector("[name=csrf_token]").value}, body: JSON.stringify({project_type: button.dataset.paperMode, revision: Number(form.dataset.revision)}) });
+      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Não foi possível trocar o roteiro. Reabra a versão do servidor.");
+      window.location.hash = "";
+      window.location.reload();
+    } catch (error) { if (saveState) saveState.textContent = error.message; button.disabled = false; }
+  }));
+
+  // Stage navigation (keep in main as it coordinates with other modules)
+  initStageNavigation(form, flushSave, markDirty);
+
+  // Development sections
+  initDevelopmentSections(form, markDirty);
+
+  // Initialize editor AI (rich AI actions)
+  initEditorAi({ form, readJson, markDirty, flushSave, stages: [...(form.querySelectorAll("[data-stage]") || [])], showStep: window.showStep, createInlineSource: window.createInlineSource, appendProjectSource: window.appendProjectSource });
+}
+
+// ============================================================================
+// Stage Navigation (coordinated with other modules)
+// ============================================================================
+function initStageNavigation(form, flushSave, markDirty) {
+  const stages = [...(form?.querySelectorAll("[data-stage]") || [])];
+  const stepButtons = [...(form?.querySelectorAll("[data-step]") || [])];
+  let activeStep = 0;
+
+  window.showStep = function showStep(index, focus = false) {
+    if (!stages.length) return;
+    activeStep = Math.max(0, Math.min(index, stages.length - 1));
+    stages.forEach((stage, i) => { stage.hidden = i !== activeStep; });
+    const phase = stages[activeStep].dataset.stagePhase;
+    stepButtons.forEach((button, i) => {
+      button.setAttribute("aria-current", i === activeStep ? "step" : "false");
+      button.classList.toggle("is-other-phase", button.dataset.stepPhase !== phase);
+    });
+    form.querySelectorAll("[data-phase]").forEach((button) => button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", button.dataset.phase === phase ? "true" : "false"));
+    form.querySelectorAll("[data-nav-phase]").forEach((node) => node.classList.toggle("is-other-phase", node.dataset.navPhase !== phase));
+    form.querySelector("[data-previous-step]").disabled = activeStep === 0;
+    form.querySelector("[data-next-step]").textContent = activeStep === stages.length - 1 ? "Voltar à identificação" : "Continuar";
+    history.replaceState(null, "", `#stage-${stages[activeStep].dataset.stage}`);
+    updateProgress(form, stages, activeStep, stepButtons, phase);
+    if (focus) {
+      stages[activeStep].querySelector("h2").focus({ preventScroll: true });
+      form.querySelector(".workspace").scrollIntoView({ behavior: "auto", block: "start" });
+    }
+  };
+
+  function updateProgress(form, stages, activeStep, stepButtons, phase) {
+    if (!stages.length) return;
+    const phaseStages = stages.filter((stage) => stage.dataset.stagePhase === phase);
+    const required = phaseStages.flatMap((stage) => [...stage.querySelectorAll("[data-required-field]")]);
+    const done = required.filter((input) => input.value.trim()).length;
+    const percent = required.length ? Math.round(done / required.length * 100) : 0;
+    form.querySelector("[data-progress-count]").textContent = `${done}/${required.length} campos · ${percent}%`;
+    form.querySelector("[data-progress-bar]").style.width = `${percent}%`;
+    const labels = { report: "Relatório", debate: "Debate", dissertation: "Dissertação", paper_project: "Projeto de Paper", paper_final: "Paper Final" };
+    form.querySelector("[data-progress-label]").textContent = `Progresso · ${labels[phase]}`;
+    stages.forEach((stage, i) => {
+      const inputs = [...stage.querySelectorAll("[data-required-field], [data-workflow-check]")];
+      const complete = inputs.length > 0 && inputs.every((input) => input.type === "checkbox" ? input.checked : input.value.trim());
+      const status = stepButtons[i].querySelector(".step-status");
+      status.textContent = complete ? "✓" : "·";
+      status.setAttribute("aria-label", complete ? "Etapa completa" : "Etapa incompleta");
+    });
+    const title = form.querySelector('[data-case-field="title"]')?.value.trim();
+    const heading = document.querySelector("[data-editor-title]");
+    if (heading && title) heading.textContent = title;
+  }
+
+  stepButtons.forEach((button, i) => button.addEventListener("click", () => window.showStep(i, true)));
+  form?.querySelectorAll("[data-phase]").forEach((button) => button.addEventListener("click", () => window.showStep(stages.findIndex((stage) => stage.dataset.stagePhase === button.dataset.phase), true)));
+  form?.querySelector("[data-previous-step]")?.addEventListener("click", () => window.showStep(activeStep - 1, true));
+  form?.querySelector("[data-next-step]")?.addEventListener("click", () => window.showStep(activeStep === stages.length - 1 ? 0 : activeStep + 1, true));
+  const restoredStep = stages.findIndex((stage) => `#stage-${stage.dataset.stage}` === location.hash);
+  window.showStep(restoredStep >= 0 ? restoredStep : 0);
+  window.addEventListener("hashchange", () => { const index = stages.findIndex((stage) => `#stage-${stage.dataset.stage}` === location.hash); if (index >= 0) window.showStep(index); });
+}
+
+// ============================================================================
+// Development Sections
+// ============================================================================
+function initDevelopmentSections(form, markDirty) {
+  form?.querySelector("[data-add-development]")?.addEventListener("click", () => {
+    const list = form.querySelector("[data-development-list]");
+    const card = document.createElement("fieldset");
+    card.className = "development-section";
+    card.dataset.development = "";
+    card.dataset.developmentId = crypto.randomUUID();
+    card.innerHTML = '<legend>Tópico</legend><label>Título do tópico<input data-development-title maxlength="240"></label><label>Fundamentação<textarea data-development-body data-size="large" maxlength="30000"></textarea></label><button type="button" class="text-button danger" data-remove-development>Remover tópico</button>';
+    list.append(card);
+    card.querySelector("input").focus();
+    markDirty();
+  });
+  form?.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
+    const remove = event.target.closest("[data-remove-development]");
+    if (remove) { remove.closest("[data-development]").remove(); markDirty(); }
+  });
+}
+
+// ============================================================================
+// Legal Recommendations & Source Creation (keep in main for now)
+// ============================================================================
+function initLegalAndSources(form, readJson, markDirty, flushSave, createInlineSource, appendProjectSource) {
+  function legalField(id, fallback = "") {
+    return form.querySelector(`[data-case-field="${id}"]`)?.value?.trim() || fallback;
+  }
+
+  function appendProjectSource(source, checked = true) {
+    const list = form.querySelector(".source-check-list");
+    if (!list || !source?.id) return;
+    list.querySelector(".empty-state")?.remove();
+    const row = document.createElement("label");
+    row.className = "check-row";
+    row.innerHTML = `<input type="checkbox" data-project-source><span><strong></strong><small></small><small></small></span>`;
+    const input = row.querySelector("[data-project-source]");
+    input.value = source.id;
+    input.checked = checked;
+    row.querySelector("strong").textContent = source.title || "Fonte sem título";
+    row.querySelectorAll("small")[0].textContent = source.author || "";
+    row.querySelectorAll("small")[1].textContent = source.reference || "";
+    list.append(row);
+  }
+
+  window.createInlineSource = async function createInlineSource(button) {
+    const status = form.querySelector("[data-source-create-status]");
+    const value = (name) => form.querySelector(`[data-source-create-field="${name}"]`)?.value?.trim() || "";
+    const title = value("title");
+    if (!title) {
+      if (status) status.textContent = "Informe o título da fonte.";
+      form.querySelector('[data-source-create-field="title"]')?.focus();
+      return;
+    }
+    button.disabled = true;
+    if (status) status.textContent = "Adicionando…";
+    try {
+      const response = await fetch(form.dataset.sourceCreateUrl, {
+        method: "POST",
+        credentials: "same-origin",
+        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-CSRF-Token": form.querySelector("[name=csrf_token]").value },
+        body: JSON.stringify({ title, author: value("author"), kind: value("kind"), reference: value("reference"), notes: value("notes") }),
+      });
+      const result = await readJson(response);
+      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.message || "Não foi possível adicionar a fonte.");
+      appendProjectSource(result.source);
+      ["title", "author", "reference", "notes"].forEach((name) => {
+        const field = form.querySelector(`[data-source-create-field="${name}"]`);
+        if (field) field.value = "";
+      });
+      if (status) status.textContent = "Fonte adicionada.";
+      markDirty();
+    } catch (error) {
+      if (status) status.textContent = error.message;
+    } finally {
+      button.disabled = false;
+    }
+  };
+
+  function renderLegalEntry(entry, attachUrl, csrf) {
+    const card = document.createElement("article");
+    card.className = "legal-result-card";
+    const title = document.createElement("h4");
+    title.textContent = entry.title || "Fonte sem título";
+    card.append(title);
+    const meta = document.createElement("p");
+    meta.className = "legal-result-meta";
+    meta.textContent = [entry.source, entry.source_year, entry.author, entry.reference].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
+    card.append(meta);
+    const why = document.createElement("p");
+    why.textContent = entry.why || "Pista contextual para conferência.";
+    card.append(why);
+    const actions = document.createElement("div");
+    actions.className = "legal-result-actions";
+    const attach = document.createElement("button");
+    attach.type = "button";
+    attach.className = "text-button";
+    attach.textContent = "Adicionar à Minha Biblioteca";
+    attach.addEventListener("click", async () => {
+      attach.disabled = true;
+      try {
+        const response = await fetch(attachUrl, { method: "POST", credentials: "same-origin", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-CSRF-Token": csrf }, body: JSON.stringify({ source_id: entry.id }) });
+        const result = await readJson(response);
+        if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.message || "Não foi possível adicionar a fonte.");
+        appendProjectSource({ id: result.source_id, title: result.title, author: result.author, reference: result.reference });
+        markDirty();
+        attach.textContent = "Adicionada à biblioteca";
+      } catch (error) {
+        attach.disabled = false;
+        attach.textContent = error.message;
+      }
+    });
+    const discard = document.createElement("button");
+    discard.type = "button";
+    discard.className = "text-button";
+    discard.textContent = "Descartar";
+    discard.addEventListener("click", () => card.remove());
+    actions.append(attach, discard);
+    card.append(actions);
+    return card;
+  }
+
+  form?.querySelector("[data-legal-recommendations]")?.addEventListener("click", async () => {
+    const button = form.querySelector("[data-legal-recommendations]");
+    const result = form.querySelector("[data-legal-result]");
+    const problem = legalField("problem", form.dataset.legalProblem || "");
+    const instructions = legalField("assignment_prompt", form.dataset.legalInstructions || "");
+    const rawKeywords = form.querySelector("[data-legal-keywords]")?.value || form.dataset.legalKeywords || "";
+    const keywords = rawKeywords.split(/[;,\n]/).map((item) => item.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 20);
+    if (!problem) { result.textContent = "Preencha a pergunta-problema antes de pedir sugestões."; return; }
+    button.disabled = true;
+    result.textContent = "Consultando catálogo e assistência…";
+    try {
+      const response = await fetch(form.dataset.legalUrl, { method: "POST", credentials: "same-origin", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-CSRF-Token": form.querySelector("[name=csrf_token]").value }, body: JSON.stringify({ request_id: crypto.randomUUID(), project_revision: Number(form.dataset.revision), problem_question: problem, professor_instructions: instructions, keywords, catalog_source_ids: [] }) });
+      const payload = await readJson(response);
+      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(payload.message || "Não foi possível obter sugestões.");
+      result.replaceChildren();
+      const provider = document.createElement("p");
+      provider.className = "field-hint";
+      provider.textContent = "Sugestões baseadas no catálogo disponível e no contexto deste trabalho. Confira cada fonte antes de usar.";
+      result.append(provider);
+      const labels = { law: "Lei", jurisprudence: "Jurisprudência", doctrine: "Doutrina" };
+      Object.entries(labels).forEach(([key, label]) => {
+        const items = payload.recommendations?.[key] || [];
+        const heading = document.createElement("h3");
+        heading.textContent = `${label} (${items.length})`;
+        result.append(heading);
+        if (!items.length) { const empty = document.createElement("p"); empty.className = "field-hint"; empty.textContent = "Nenhuma pista encontrada neste recorte."; result.append(empty); return; }
+        items.forEach((entry) => result.append(renderLegalEntry(entry, form.dataset.legalAttachUrl, form.querySelector("[name=csrf_token]").value)));
+      });
+      (payload.warnings || []).forEach((warning) => { const note = document.createElement("p"); note.className = "field-hint"; note.textContent = warning; result.append(note); });
+    } catch (error) { result.textContent = error.message; }
+    finally { button.disabled = false; }
+  });
+}
+
+// Initialize legal and sources
+initLegalAndSources(form, readJson, markDirty, flushSave, null, null);
+\ No newline at end of file
diff --git a/static/js/project-schedule.js b/static/js/project-schedule.js
@@ -0,0 +1,155 @@
+function newTaskId() {
+  return typeof crypto?.randomUUID === "function"
+    ? crypto.randomUUID()
+    : `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9)}`;
+}
+
+function taskRows(form) {
+  return [...form.querySelectorAll("[data-task]")];
+}
+
+function projectTemplate(form) {
+  try {
+    return JSON.parse(form.dataset.scheduleTemplates || "[]");
+  } catch {
+    return [];
+  }
+}
+
+function setStatus(form, message) {
+  const target = form.querySelector("[data-schedule-status]");
+  if (target) target.textContent = message;
+}
+
+function updateMeta(form) {
+  const meta = form.querySelector("[data-schedule-meta]");
+  if (!meta) return;
+  const total = taskRows(form).length;
+  const done = taskRows(form).filter((row) => row.querySelector('[data-task-field="done"]')?.checked).length;
+  const dates = [...form.querySelectorAll("[data-schedule-field]")].filter((input) => input.value).length;
+  meta.textContent = `${done}/${total} tarefas · ${dates ? `${dates} ${dates === 1 ? "data definida" : "datas definidas"}` : "sem datas definidas"}`;
+}
+
+function removeEmptyMessage(form) {
+  form.querySelector("[data-empty-task-list]")?.remove();
+}
+
+function showEmptyMessage(form) {
+  const list = form.querySelector("[data-task-list]");
+  if (list && !taskRows(form).length && !list.querySelector("[data-empty-task-list]")) {
+    const message = document.createElement("p");
+    message.className = "field-hint";
+    message.dataset.emptyTaskList = "";
+    message.textContent = "Ainda não há tarefas. Use o roteiro sugerido ou adicione uma tarefa própria.";
+    list.append(message);
+  }
+}
+
+function input(type, value, attributes = {}) {
+  const element = document.createElement("input");
+  element.type = type;
+  if (type === "checkbox") element.checked = Boolean(value);
+  else element.value = value || "";
+  Object.entries(attributes).forEach(([key, attributeValue]) => {
+    if (attributeValue !== undefined && attributeValue !== null) element.setAttribute(key, attributeValue);
+  });
+  return element;
+}
+
+function createTaskRow(form, task, index) {
+  removeEmptyMessage(form);
+  const row = document.createElement("div");
+  row.className = "task-row";
+  row.dataset.task = "";
+  row.dataset.taskId = task.id || newTaskId();
+  row.dataset.taskTemplateKey = task.template_key || "";
+  row.dataset.taskStage = Number.isInteger(task.stage) ? String(task.stage) : "";
+
+  const doneLabel = document.createElement("label");
+  doneLabel.className = "task-row-done";
+  doneLabel.title = "Marcar tarefa como concluída";
+  doneLabel.append(input("checkbox", task.done, {
+    "data-task-field": "done",
+    "aria-label": `Concluir tarefa ${index + 1}`,
+  }));
+  const title = input("text", task.title, {
+    class: "task-row-title",
+    maxlength: "180",
+    "data-task-field": "title",
+    placeholder: "Tarefa",
+    "aria-label": `Nome da tarefa ${index + 1}`,
+  });
+  const dateLabel = document.createElement("label");
+  dateLabel.className = "task-row-date";
+  dateLabel.append(input("date", task.date, {
+    "data-task-field": "date",
+    "aria-label": `Data da tarefa ${index + 1}`,
+  }));
+  const remove = document.createElement("button");
+  remove.type = "button";
+  remove.className = "text-button danger";
+  remove.dataset.removeTask = "";
+  remove.textContent = "Remover";
+
+  row.append(doneLabel, title, dateLabel, remove);
+  form.querySelector("[data-task-list]")?.append(row);
+  return row;
+}
+
+export function collectSchedule(form) {
+  const schedule = Object.fromEntries(
+    [...form.querySelectorAll("[data-schedule-field]")].map((element) => [element.dataset.scheduleField, element.value]),
+  );
+  schedule.tasks = taskRows(form).map((task) => ({
+    id: task.dataset.taskId || newTaskId(),
+    title: task.querySelector('[data-task-field="title"]')?.value || "",
+    date: task.querySelector('[data-task-field="date"]')?.value || "",
+    done: Boolean(task.querySelector('[data-task-field="done"]')?.checked),
+    stage: task.dataset.taskStage === "" ? null : Number(task.dataset.taskStage),
+    template_key: task.dataset.taskTemplateKey || "",
+  }));
+  return schedule;
+}
+
+export function initScheduleEditor(form, onStructuralChange) {
+  if (!form) return;
+  updateMeta(form);
+  form.addEventListener("input", (event) => {
+    if (event.target.matches("[data-schedule-field], [data-task-field]")) updateMeta(form);
+  });
+  form.addEventListener("change", (event) => {
+    if (event.target.matches("[data-schedule-field], [data-task-field]")) updateMeta(form);
+  });
+  form.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
+    if (event.target.closest("[data-add-task]")) {
+      createTaskRow(form, { id: newTaskId(), title: "", date: "", done: false }, taskRows(form).length);
+      setStatus(form, "Tarefa adicionada.");
+      updateMeta(form);
+      onStructuralChange();
+      form.querySelector("[data-task]:last-of-type [data-task-field=title]")?.focus();
+      return;
+    }
+    if (event.target.closest("[data-add-suggested-tasks]")) {
+      const existingKeys = new Set(taskRows(form).map((row) => row.dataset.taskTemplateKey).filter(Boolean));
+      const existingTitles = new Set(taskRows(form).map((row) => row.querySelector('[data-task-field="title"]')?.value.trim()).filter(Boolean));
+      const template = projectTemplate(form);
+      let added = 0;
+      template.forEach(([key, title], stage) => {
+        if (existingKeys.has(key) || existingTitles.has(title)) return;
+        createTaskRow(form, { id: newTaskId(), title, date: "", done: false, stage, template_key: key }, taskRows(form).length);
+        added += 1;
+      });
+      setStatus(form, added ? `${added} tarefas do roteiro foram adicionadas.` : "O roteiro já está adicionado.");
+      updateMeta(form);
+      if (added) onStructuralChange();
+      return;
+    }
+    if (event.target.closest("[data-remove-task]")) {
+      event.target.closest("[data-task]")?.remove();
+      showEmptyMessage(form);
+      setStatus(form, "Tarefa removida.");
+      updateMeta(form);
+      onStructuralChange();
+    }
+  });
+}
diff --git a/static/js/revisions.js b/static/js/revisions.js
@@ -0,0 +1,107 @@
+/**
+ * Revisions Module - Assistente Acadêmico
+ * Handles project revisions: list, diff, restore
+ */
+
+function escapeHtml(text) {
+  return String(text ?? "")
+    .replaceAll("&", "&")
+    .replaceAll("<", "<")
+    .replaceAll(">", ">")
+    .replaceAll('"', """)
+    .replaceAll("'", "&#039;");
+}
+
+async function loadRevisions(revisionsUrl) {
+  try {
+    const res = await fetch(revisionsUrl);
+    const data = await res.json();
+    if (!data.ok) throw new Error(data.error || "Erro ao carregar revisões.");
+    return data.revisions || [];
+  } catch (err) {
+    console.error("Failed to load revisions:", err);
+    return [];
+  }
+}
+
+function renderRevisionsList(revisions, container) {
+  if (!revisions.length) {
+    container.innerHTML = '<p class="field-hint">Nenhuma revisão encontrada.</p>';
+    return;
+  }
+  container.innerHTML = revisions.map(r => `
+    <article class="revision-card" data-revision="${r.revision}">
+      <header>
+        <strong>Revisão ${r.revision}</strong>
+        <time>${new Date(r.created_at * 1000).toLocaleString("pt-BR")}</time>
+      </header>
+      <div class="revision-actions">
+        <button type="button" class="text-button" data-diff="${r.revision}">Ver diff</button>
+        <button type="button" class="text-button" data-restore="${r.revision}">Restaurar</button>
+      </div>
+    </article>
+  `).join("");
+}
+
+async function showDiff(revision, revisionsUrl, diffContainer, readJson) {
+  if (!diffContainer) return;
+  diffContainer.hidden = false;
+  diffContainer.innerHTML = '<p class="field-hint">Carregando diff…</p>';
+  try {
+    const res = await fetch(`${revisionsUrl}/${revision}/diff`);
+    const data = await res.json();
+    if (!data.ok) throw new Error(data.error || "Erro ao carregar diff.");
+    diffContainer.innerHTML = `<pre class="diff-output">${escapeHtml(data.diff)}</pre>`;
+  } catch (err) {
+    diffContainer.innerHTML = `<p class="field-hint error">${err.message}</p>`;
+  }
+}
+
+async function restoreRevision(revision, revisionsUrl, currentRevision, form, readJson, setSaveState) {
+  if (!confirm(`Tem certeza que deseja restaurar a revisão ${revision}? As alterações atuais não salvas serão perdidas.`)) return;
+  try {
+    const csrf = form.querySelector("[name=csrf_token]")?.value;
+    if (!csrf) throw new Error("Sessão sem proteção CSRF.");
+    const res = await fetch(`${revisionsUrl}/${revision}/restore`, {
+      method: "POST",
+      credentials: "same-origin",
+      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-CSRF-Token": csrf },
+      body: JSON.stringify({ revision: Number(currentRevision) })
+    });
+    const data = await readJson(res);
+    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || "Erro ao restaurar.");
+    window.location.reload();
+  } catch (err) {
+    setSaveState(err.message);
+  }
+}
+
+export function initRevisions({ form, readJson, setSaveState }) {
+  if (!form || !form.dataset.revisionsUrl) return;
+
+  const toggle = form.querySelector("[data-revisions-toggle]");
+  const panel = form.querySelector("[data-revisions-panel]");
+  const listEl = form.querySelector("[data-revisions-list]");
+  const diffEl = form.querySelector("[data-revision-diff]");
+
+  if (!toggle || !panel || !listEl) return;
+
+  toggle.addEventListener("click", async () => {
+    const isHidden = panel.hidden;
+    if (isHidden) {
+      panel.hidden = false;
+      listEl.innerHTML = '<p class="field-hint">Carregando…</p>';
+      const revisions = await loadRevisions(form.dataset.revisionsUrl);
+      renderRevisionsList(revisions, listEl);
+
+      listEl.querySelectorAll("[data-diff]").forEach(btn => {
+        btn.addEventListener("click", () => showDiff(btn.dataset.diff, form.dataset.revisionsUrl, diffEl, readJson));
+      });
+      listEl.querySelectorAll("[data-restore]").forEach(btn => {
+        btn.addEventListener("click", () => restoreRevision(btn.dataset.revision, form.dataset.revisionsUrl, form.dataset.revision, form, readJson, setSaveState));
+      });
+    } else {
+      panel.hidden = true;
+    }
+  });
+}
