+def login(client):
+    response = client.post("/auth/dev-login", data={"email": "perfil@example.test", "name": "Perfil"})
+    assert response.status_code == 302
+
+
+def csrf(client):
+    with client.session_transaction() as session:
+        return session["csrf_token"]
+
+
+def test_account_home_shows_first_login_setup(client):
+    login(client)
+    page = client.get("/account")
+    body = page.get_data(as_text=True)
+    assert "Configure sua conta" in body
+    assert "Termos de uso e privacidade" in body
+    assert "#terms" in body
+    assert "Planos e valores" in body
+    assert 'href="/planos"' in body
+    assert 'value="paper_final"' not in body
+    assert "Roteiro inicial" in body
+    assert "Case — relatório, debate e dissertação" in body
+    assert "Paper — começar pelo Projeto de Paper" in body
+    assert "Paper: Projeto de Paper → Paper Final." in body
+
+
+def test_profile_is_saved_separately_from_identity(client):
+    login(client)
+    response = client.post(
+        "/account/settings/profile",
+        data={
+            "csrf_token": csrf(client),
+            "name": "Perfil Atualizado",
+            "institution": "Universidade",
+            "course": "Direito",
+            "discipline": "Metodologia",
+            "professor": "Orientação",
+        },
+    )
+    assert response.status_code == 302
+    page = client.get("/account/settings")
+    body = page.get_data(as_text=True)
+    assert "Perfil Atualizado" in body
+    assert "Universidade" in body
+
+
+def test_terms_and_ai_consent_are_separate(client):
+    login(client)
+    response = client.post(
+        "/account/settings/terms",
+        data={"csrf_token": csrf(client), "accept": "on"},
+    )
+    assert response.status_code == 302
+    page = client.get("/account/settings")
+    body = page.get_data(as_text=True)
+    assert 'name="accept"' in body
+    assert 'name="ai_consent"' in body
+
+    response = client.post(
+        "/account/settings/terms",
+        data={"csrf_token": csrf(client), "accept": "on", "ai_consent": "on"},
+    )
+    assert response.status_code == 302
+    page = client.get("/account/settings")
+    assert "Autorizo o uso da assistência de IA" in page.get_data(as_text=True)
diff --git a/tests/test_admin_accounts.py b/tests/test_admin_accounts.py
@@ -0,0 +1,161 @@
+import json
+
+import pytest
+
+from app.store.db import get_db
+
+
+ADMIN_COLUMNS = {
+    "plan_code": "TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'livre'",
+    "project_limit": "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0",
+    "project_used": "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0",
+    "ai_limit": "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0",
+    "ai_used": "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0",
+    "is_blocked": "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0",
+}
+
+
+@pytest.fixture()
+def admin_ready(app):
+    app.config["ADMIN_EMAILS"] = {"admin@example.test"}
+    with app.app_context():
+        database = get_db()
+        existing = {row["name"] for row in database.execute("PRAGMA table_info(accounts)")}
+        for name, definition in ADMIN_COLUMNS.items():
+            if name not in existing:
+                database.execute(f"ALTER TABLE accounts ADD COLUMN {name} {definition}")
+        database.commit()
+    return app
+
+
+def csrf(client):
+    with client.session_transaction() as session:
+        return session["csrf_token"]
+
+
+def login(client, email):
+    response = client.post("/auth/dev-login", data={"email": email, "name": email.split("@", 1)[0]})
+    assert response.status_code == 302
+    return csrf(client)
+
+
+def account_id(app, email):
+    with app.app_context():
+        return get_db().execute("SELECT id FROM accounts WHERE email = ?", (email,)).fetchone()["id"]
+
+
+def test_admin_updates_plan_credits_and_block_without_automatic_payment(admin_ready, client):
+    owner_token = login(client, "owner-admin@example.test")
+    client.post("/account/settings/terms", data={"csrf_token": owner_token, "accept": "on"})
+    created = client.post("/projects", data={"csrf_token": csrf(client), "project_type": "case"})
+    assert created.status_code == 302
+    owner_id = account_id(admin_ready, "owner-admin@example.test")
+    with admin_ready.app_context():
+        database = get_db()
+        database.execute(
+            "UPDATE accounts SET project_limit = 6, project_used = 1, ai_limit = 12, ai_used = 2 WHERE id = ?",
+            (owner_id,),
+        )
+        database.commit()
+
+    admin_token = login(client, "admin@example.test")
+    listing = client.get("/admin/accounts")
+    assert listing.status_code == 200
+    assert "owner-admin@example.test" in listing.get_data(as_text=True)
+    assert "6 concedidos" in listing.get_data(as_text=True)
+
+    with admin_ready.app_context():
+        before = dict(get_db().execute("SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE id = ?", (owner_id,)).fetchone())
+    changed_plan = client.post(
+        f"/admin/accounts/{owner_id}/plan",
+        data={"csrf_token": admin_token, "plan_code": "com_ia"},
+    )
+    assert changed_plan.status_code == 302
+    with admin_ready.app_context():
+        after_plan = dict(get_db().execute("SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE id = ?", (owner_id,)).fetchone())
+    assert after_plan["plan_code"] == "com_ia"
+    assert after_plan["project_limit"] == before["project_limit"]
+    assert after_plan["project_used"] == before["project_used"]
+    assert after_plan["ai_limit"] == before["ai_limit"]
+
+    changed_credits = client.post(
+        f"/admin/accounts/{owner_id}/credits",
+        data={"csrf_token": csrf(client), "project_remaining": "3"},
+    )
+    assert changed_credits.status_code == 302
+    with admin_ready.app_context():
+        credits = get_db().execute(
+            "SELECT project_limit, project_used FROM accounts WHERE id = ?", (owner_id,)
+        ).fetchone()
+    assert credits["project_limit"] == 4
+    assert credits["project_used"] == 1
+
+    blocked = client.post(
+        f"/admin/accounts/{owner_id}/block",
+        data={"csrf_token": csrf(client), "blocked": "1"},
+    )
+    assert blocked.status_code == 302
+    with admin_ready.app_context():
+        assert get_db().execute("SELECT is_blocked FROM accounts WHERE id = ?", (owner_id,)).fetchone()[0] == 1
+    unblocked = client.post(
+        f"/admin/accounts/{owner_id}/block",
+        data={"csrf_token": csrf(client), "blocked": "0"},
+    )
+    assert unblocked.status_code == 302
+    with admin_ready.app_context():
+        assert get_db().execute("SELECT is_blocked FROM accounts WHERE id = ?", (owner_id,)).fetchone()[0] == 0
+
+
+def test_admin_management_requires_admin_and_csrf(admin_ready, client):
+    token = login(client, "student-admin@example.test")
+    assert client.get("/admin/accounts").status_code == 403
+
+    owner_id = account_id(admin_ready, "student-admin@example.test")
+    login(client, "admin@example.test")
+    missing_csrf = client.post(
+        f"/admin/accounts/{owner_id}/plan",
+        data={"plan_code": "com_ia"},
+    )
+    assert missing_csrf.status_code == 400
+
+
+def test_account_projects_expose_metadata_but_private_content_requires_sharing(admin_ready, client):
+    owner_token = login(client, "private-admin@example.test")
+    client.post("/account/settings/terms", data={"csrf_token": owner_token, "accept": "on"})
+    created = client.post("/projects", data={"csrf_token": csrf(client), "project_type": "case"})
+    project_id = created.headers["Location"].rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
+    saved = client.post(
+        f"/projects/{project_id}/save",
+        headers={"X-CSRF-Token": csrf(client), "Content-Type": "application/json"},
+        data=json.dumps(
+            {
+                "revision": 1,
+                "payload": {"fields": {"title": "Projeto privado", "facts": "segredo privado"}},
+            }
+        ),
+    )
+    assert saved.status_code == 200
+    owner_id = account_id(admin_ready, "private-admin@example.test")
+
+    admin_token = login(client, "admin@example.test")
+    metadata = client.get(f"/admin/accounts/{owner_id}/projects")
+    body = metadata.get_data(as_text=True)
+    assert metadata.status_code == 200
+    assert "Projeto privado" in body
+    assert "Conteúdo privado · sem acesso" in body
+    assert "segredo privado" not in body
+    assert "payload" not in body
+    assert client.get(f"/admin/projects/{project_id}").status_code == 404
+
+    shared = client  # The session is admin; authenticate the owner for the consent change.
+    owner_token = login(shared, "private-admin@example.test")
+    consent = shared.post(
+        f"/projects/{project_id}/sharing",
+        data={"csrf_token": csrf(shared), "allow_admin_view": "on"},
+    )
+    assert consent.status_code == 302
+    login(shared, "admin@example.test")
+    detail = shared.get(f"/admin/projects/{project_id}")
+    assert detail.status_code == 200
+    assert "segredo privado" in detail.get_data(as_text=True)
+    assert admin_token != owner_token
diff --git a/tests/test_ai.py b/tests/test_ai.py
@@ -0,0 +1,69 @@
+import app.routes.ai as ai_route
+
+
+def login(client, consent=False):
+    client.post("/auth/dev-login", data={"email": "ia@example.test", "name": "IA"})
+    with client.session_transaction() as session:
+        token = session["csrf_token"]
+    data = {"csrf_token": token, "accept": "on"}
+    if consent:
+        data["ai_consent"] = "on"
+    client.post("/account/settings/terms", data=data)
+    return token
+
+
+class FakeDeepSeek:
+    def __init__(self, *_args, **_kwargs):
+        pass
+
+    def complete_json(self, messages, max_tokens=1400):
+        assert messages[1]["content"]["field_id"] == "problem"
+        return {"result": {"answer": "Confira se a pergunta é aberta.", "suggestions": [{"text": "Relacione a pergunta aos fatos."}]}}
+
+
+def test_ai_requires_separate_consent(client):
+    token = login(client, consent=False)
+    created = client.post("/projects", data={"csrf_token": token, "project_type": "case"})
+    project_id = created.headers["Location"].rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
+    response = client.post(f"/projects/{project_id}/ai/review", headers={"X-CSRF-Token": token}, json={"field_id": "problem", "instruction": "Revise"})
+    assert response.status_code == 403
+    assert response.get_json()["error"] == "ai_consent_required"
+
+
+def test_ai_review_uses_fake_provider_after_consent(client, monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ai_route, "DeepSeekClient", FakeDeepSeek)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ai_route, "load_secret", lambda *args: "fake-secret")
+    token = login(client, consent=True)
+    created = client.post("/projects", data={"csrf_token": token, "project_type": "case"})
+    project_id = created.headers["Location"].rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
+    response = client.post(f"/projects/{project_id}/ai/review", headers={"X-CSRF-Token": token}, json={"field_id": "problem", "instruction": "Revise"})
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.get_json()["suggestions"][0]["text"] == "Relacione a pergunta aos fatos."
+
+
+def test_ai_rejects_field_outside_contract(client):
+    token = login(client, consent=True)
+    created = client.post("/projects", data={"csrf_token": token, "project_type": "case"})
+    project_id = created.headers["Location"].rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
+    response = client.post(f"/projects/{project_id}/ai/review", headers={"X-CSRF-Token": token}, json={"field_id": "authors", "instruction": "Revise"})
+    assert response.status_code == 400
+
+
+def test_jev_validation_uses_fixed_questions_and_fake_provider(client, monkeypatch):
+    class FakeJev:
+        def __init__(self, *_args, **_kwargs):
+            pass
+
+        def score(self, state, questions):
+            assert state["field_id"] == "problem"
+            assert "coherence" in questions
+            return {"model": "fake-jev", "answers": {"coherence": {"score": 2}}, "usage": {}}
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ai_route, "JevClient", FakeJev)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ai_route, "load_secret", lambda *args: "fake-secret")
+    token = login(client, consent=True)
+    created = client.post("/projects", data={"csrf_token": token, "project_type": "case"})
+    project_id = created.headers["Location"].rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
+    response = client.post(f"/projects/{project_id}/ai/validate", headers={"X-CSRF-Token": token}, json={"field_id": "problem"})
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.get_json()["answers"]["coherence"]["score"] == 2
diff --git a/tests/test_ai_legacy_contract.py b/tests/test_ai_legacy_contract.py
@@ -0,0 +1,166 @@
+import uuid
+
+import app.routes.ai as ai_route
+from app.services.providers import ProviderError
+
+
+def login(client):
+    client.post("/auth/dev-login", data={"email": "legacy-ai@example.test", "name": "IA"})
+    with client.session_transaction() as session:
+        token = session["csrf_token"]
+    client.post("/account/settings/terms", data={"csrf_token": token, "accept": "on", "ai_consent": "on"})
+    created = client.post("/projects", data={"csrf_token": token, "project_type": "case"})
+    return token, created.headers["Location"].rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
+
+
+class FakeDeepSeek:
+    def __init__(self, *_args, **_kwargs):
+        pass
+
+    def complete_json(self, messages, max_tokens=1400):
+        assert messages[1]["content"]["action"] == "suggest_problem"
+        return {
+            "model": "fake-deepseek",
+            "result": {
+                "answer": "A pergunta pode delimitar o conflito jurídico e o recorte factual.",
+                "suggestions": [{"field_id": "problem", "text": "Qual solução jurídica é aplicável ao conflito descrito?"}],
+                "rewrite": "",
+                "checklist": [],
+            },
+            "usage": {"prompt_tokens": 10, "completion_tokens": 20},
+        }
+
+
+class FakeJev:
+    def __init__(self, *_args, **_kwargs):
+        pass
+
+    def score(self, state, questions):
+        answers = {
+            question_id: {
+                "score": 2,
+                "confidence": 0.8,
+                "probabilities": [0.05, 0.15, 0.55, 0.25],
+                "observation": "A resposta tem relação com o recorte fornecido.",
+            }
+            for question_id in questions
+        }
+        return {"model": "fake-jev", "answers": answers, "usage": {"input_tokens": 10}}
+
+
+class BrokenDeepSeek:
+    def __init__(self, *_args, **_kwargs):
+        pass
+
+    def complete_json(self, messages, max_tokens=1400):
+        return {"model": "broken", "result": {"answer": "sem contrato"}}
+
+
+class DisabledDeepSeek:
+    def __init__(self, *_args, **_kwargs):
+        pass
+
+    def complete_json(self, messages, max_tokens=1400):
+        raise ProviderError("provider_auth", "primário indisponível", 502, retryable=True)
+
+
+class FakeGemini:
+    def __init__(self, *_args, **_kwargs):
+        pass
+
+    def complete_json(self, messages, max_tokens=1400):
+        return {
+            "model": "fake-gemini",
+            "result": {"answer": "Resposta de fallback.", "suggestions": [], "rewrite": "", "checklist": []},
+            "usage": {"prompt_tokens": 8},
+        }
+
+
+def test_specialized_action_returns_suggestion_and_jev_validation(client, monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ai_route, "DeepSeekClient", FakeDeepSeek)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ai_route, "JevClient", FakeJev)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ai_route, "load_secret", lambda *args: "fake-secret")
+    token, project_id = login(client)
+    response = client.post(
+        f"/projects/{project_id}/ai/action",
+        headers={"X-CSRF-Token": token},
+        json={
+            "action": "suggest_problem",
+            "request_id": str(uuid.uuid4()),
+            "project_revision": 1,
+            "context_fields": ["assignment_prompt", "facts", "problem"],
+        },
+    )
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    payload = response.get_json()["response"]
+    assert payload["suggestions"][0]["field_id"] == "problem"
+    assert payload["validation"]["status"] == "nao_avaliado"
+
+
+def test_jev_section_returns_scores_and_probabilities(client, monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ai_route, "JevClient", FakeJev)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ai_route, "load_secret", lambda *args: "fake-secret")
+    token, project_id = login(client)
+    response = client.post(
+        f"/projects/{project_id}/ai/jev-section",
+        headers={"X-CSRF-Token": token},
+        json={"section": "case_description", "request_id": str(uuid.uuid4())},
+    )
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    analysis = response.get_json()["analysis"]
+    assert analysis["criteria"][0]["score"] == 2
+    assert len(analysis["criteria"][0]["probabilities"]) == 4
+
+
+def test_gemini_is_used_once_when_deepseek_returns_invalid_structure(client, monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ai_route, "DeepSeekClient", BrokenDeepSeek)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ai_route, "GeminiClient", FakeGemini)

+    token, project_id = login(client)
+    response = client.post(
+        f"/projects/{project_id}/ai/action",
+        headers={"X-CSRF-Token": token},
+        json={"action": "chat", "request_id": str(uuid.uuid4()), "project_revision": 1, "message": "Como começo?"},
+    )
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.get_json()["response"]["provider"] == "gemini"
+
+
+def test_gemini_fallback_covers_disabled_primary(client, monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ai_route, "DeepSeekClient", DisabledDeepSeek)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ai_route, "GeminiClient", FakeGemini)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ai_route, "load_secret", lambda *args: "fake-secret")
+    token, project_id = login(client)
+    response = client.post(
+        f"/projects/{project_id}/ai/action",
+        headers={"X-CSRF-Token": token},
+        json={"action": "chat", "request_id": str(uuid.uuid4()), "project_revision": 1, "message": "Como começo?"},
+    )
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    payload = response.get_json()["response"]
+    assert payload["provider"] == "gemini"
+    assert payload["fallback_reason"] == "provider_auth"
+
+
+def test_editor_places_ai_inside_stages_not_in_generic_panel(client):
+    token, project_id = login(client)
+    response = client.get(f"/projects/{project_id}")
+    html = response.get_data(as_text=True)
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert 'data-ai-stage-action="suggest_problem"' in html
+    assert 'data-jev-section="case_description"' in html
+    assert 'data-ai-inline="problem"' in html
+    assert 'class="ai-icon-button"' in html
+    assert 'class="ui-disclosure stage-ai-tools"' in html
+    assert 'class="assisted-control"' in html
+    assert 'field-actions' not in html
+    assert 'class="review-progress"' in html
+    assert 'Trilha de fundamentação' in html
+    assert 'data-toggle-delivery' in html
+    assert 'data-jev-report' in html
+    assert html.count("data-legal-research") == 1
+    assert html.index("data-stage=\"decisions\"") < html.index("data-legal-research")
+    assert "assistant-disclosure" not in html
+    assert "JEV" in html  # JEV functionality is now implemented
+    assert "DeepSeek" not in html
+    assert "Gemini" not in html

+from app.domain.case import case_progress, missing_case_fields, normalize_case_fields, normalize_criteria

diff --git a/tests/test_editor_markup.py b/tests/test_editor_markup.py
@@ -0,0 +1,55 @@
+from html.parser import HTMLParser
+
+
+class FormMarkupParser(HTMLParser):
+    def __init__(self):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.forms = []
+        self._open_forms = []
+
+    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
+        if tag != "form":
+            return
+        attributes = dict(attrs)
+        form = {"attributes": attributes, "parent": self._open_forms[-1] if self._open_forms else None}
+        self.forms.append(form)
+        self._open_forms.append(form)
+
+    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
+        if tag == "form" and self._open_forms:
+            self._open_forms.pop()
+
+
+def csrf(client):
+    with client.session_transaction() as session:
+        return session["csrf_token"]
+
+
+def login(client):
+    response = client.post("/auth/dev-login", data={"email": "markup@example.test", "name": "Markup"})
+    assert response.status_code == 302
+    accepted = client.post("/account/settings/terms", data={"csrf_token": csrf(client), "accept": "on"})
+    assert accepted.status_code == 302
+
+
+def test_editor_has_no_nested_forms_and_sharing_is_sibling_form(client):
+    login(client)
+    created = client.post("/projects", data={"csrf_token": csrf(client), "project_type": "case"})
+    editor = client.get(created.headers["Location"])
+    assert editor.status_code == 200
+
+    parser = FormMarkupParser()
+    body = editor.get_data(as_text=True)
+    parser.feed(body)
+
+    assert len(parser.forms) == 2
+    assert all(form["parent"] is None for form in parser.forms)
+
+    editor_form = next(form for form in parser.forms if "data-project-editor" in form["attributes"])
+    sharing_form = next(form for form in parser.forms if "data-sharing-form" in form["attributes"])
+    assert editor_form["parent"] is None
+    assert sharing_form["parent"] is None
+    assert sharing_form["attributes"]["method"] == "post"
+    assert body.find('id="project-sharing"') < body.find("data-project-editor")
+    assert 'data-reload-editor' in body
+    assert 'aria-live="polite"' in body

+def test_typst_export_uses_the_abnt_extension_from_the_reference_project():

diff --git a/tests/test_legal_recommendations.py b/tests/test_legal_recommendations.py
@@ -0,0 +1,137 @@
+import json
+from uuid import uuid4
+
+import app.routes.ai as ai_route
+from app.services.legal_recommendations import recommend
+from app.services.providers import GeminiClient, ProviderError
+
+
+CANDIDATES = [
+    {"id": "vademecum-2023:law", "kind": "legislation", "title": "Responsabilidade civil", "reference": "Código Civil — art. 927", "source_year": 2023, "source": "Índice remissivo · 2023"},
+    {"id": "stj-case", "kind": "case-law", "title": "Dano moral — Processo 1", "abstract": "Ementa oficial do STJ", "source_year": 2024, "source": "Ementas STJ"},
+    {"id": "ufob-book", "kind": "book", "title": "Responsabilidade civil contemporânea", "author": "Autora Exemplo", "source_year": 2021, "source": "Livros jurídicos · 2021"},
+]
+
+
+def login_with_ai(client):
+    client.post("/auth/dev-login", data={"email": "legal@example.test", "name": "Legal"})
+    with client.session_transaction() as session:
+        token = session["csrf_token"]
+    response = client.post("/account/settings/terms", data={"csrf_token": token, "accept": "on", "ai_consent": "on"})
+    assert response.status_code == 302
+    return token
+
+
+def create_project(client, token):
+    response = client.post("/projects", data={"csrf_token": token, "project_type": "case"})
+    assert response.status_code == 302
+    return response.headers["Location"].rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
+
+
+def test_recommend_uses_deepseek_without_calling_gemini():
+    calls = []
+
+    class DeepSeek:
+        def complete_json(self, messages, max_tokens):
+            calls.append("deepseek")
+            return {"model": "deepseek-test", "result": {"law": [{"source_id": "vademecum-2023:law", "why": "Relaciona o tema", "rank": 1}], "jurisprudence": [], "doctrine": [], "warnings": []}, "usage": {"prompt_tokens": 3}}
+
+    result = recommend(
+        {"problem_question": "Qual é a responsabilidade?", "professor_instructions": "Compare posições.", "keywords": [], "request_id": str(uuid4()), "project_revision": 1},
+        {"project_type": "case", "fields": {}},
+        CANDIDATES,
+        deepseek_factory=DeepSeek,
+        gemini_factory=lambda: (_ for _ in ()).throw(AssertionError("Gemini não deveria ser chamado")),
+    )
+    assert calls == ["deepseek"]
+    assert result["provider"]["name"] == "deepseek"
+    assert result["recommendations"]["law"][0]["source_id"] == "vademecum-2023:law"
+
+
+def test_recommend_falls_back_to_gemini_once_on_technical_failure():
+    calls = []
+
+    class DeepSeek:
+        def complete_json(self, messages, max_tokens):
+            calls.append("deepseek")
+            raise ProviderError("provider_busy", "ocupado", 503, retryable=True)
+
+    class Gemini:
+        def complete_json(self, messages, max_tokens):
+            calls.append("gemini")
+            return {"model": "gemini-test", "result": {"law": [], "jurisprudence": [], "doctrine": [{"source_id": "ufob-book", "why": "Oferece base doutrinária", "rank": 1}], "warnings": []}, "usage": {"prompt_tokens": 4}}
+
+    result = recommend(
+        {"problem_question": "Qual é a responsabilidade?", "professor_instructions": "Compare posições.", "keywords": [], "request_id": str(uuid4()), "project_revision": 1},
+        {"project_type": "case", "fields": {}},
+        CANDIDATES,
+        deepseek_factory=DeepSeek,
+        gemini_factory=Gemini,
+    )
+    assert calls == ["deepseek", "gemini"]
+    assert result["provider"]["fallback_used"] is True
+    assert result["provider"]["fallback_reason"] == "provider_busy"
+    assert result["recommendations"]["doctrine"][0]["source_id"] == "ufob-book"
+
+
+def test_legal_route_uses_fake_catalog_and_reserves_one_unit(client, monkeypatch):
+    token = login_with_ai(client)
+    project_id = create_project(client, token)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ai_route, "search_catalog", lambda *args, **kwargs: {"entries": CANDIDATES[:1]})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ai_route, "load_secret", lambda *args: "fake-secret")
+
+    class FakeDeepSeek:
+        def __init__(self, *_args, **_kwargs):
+            pass
+
+        def complete_json(self, messages, max_tokens):
+            return {"model": "fake", "result": {"law": [{"source_id": "vademecum-2023:law", "why": "Pista legal", "rank": 1}], "jurisprudence": [], "doctrine": [], "warnings": []}, "usage": {"prompt_tokens": 1}}
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ai_route, "DeepSeekClient", FakeDeepSeek)
+    response = client.post(
+        f"/projects/{project_id}/ai/legal-recommendations",
+        headers={"X-CSRF-Token": token},
+        json={"request_id": str(uuid4()), "project_revision": 1, "problem_question": "Qual é a responsabilidade?", "professor_instructions": "Compare.", "keywords": [], "catalog_source_ids": []},
+    )
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    body = response.get_json()
+    assert body["provider"]["name"] == "deepseek"
+    assert body["recommendations"]["law"][0]["source_id"] == "vademecum-2023:law"
+
+    from app.store.db import get_db
+    with client.application.app_context():
+        row = get_db().execute("SELECT ai_used FROM accounts WHERE email = ?", ("legal@example.test",)).fetchone()
+        assert row["ai_used"] == 1
+
+
+def test_attach_catalog_source_requires_explicit_endpoint(client, monkeypatch):
+    token = login_with_ai(client)
+    project_id = create_project(client, token)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ai_route, "entries_by_ids", lambda ids: [CANDIDATES[2]])
+    response = client.post(
+        f"/projects/{project_id}/ai/legal-recommendations/attach",
+        headers={"X-CSRF-Token": token},
+        json={"source_id": "ufob-book"},
+    )
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.get_json()["ok"] is True
+
+
+def test_gemini_client_parses_json_and_uses_api_key_header():
+    class Response:
+        def __enter__(self):
+            return self
+
+        def __exit__(self, *_args):
+            return None
+
+        def read(self, _limit):
+            return json.dumps({"candidates": [{"content": {"parts": [{"text": '{"ok":true}'}]}}], "usageMetadata": {"promptTokenCount": 2}}).encode()
+
+    def opener(request, timeout):
+        assert request.headers["X-goog-api-key"] == "Bearer secret" or request.headers["X-goog-api-key"] == "secret"
+        assert timeout == 30
+        return Response()
+
+    result = GeminiClient("secret", opener=opener).complete_json([{"role": "user", "content": "teste"}])
+    assert result["result"] == {"ok": True}

diff --git a/tests/test_oauth.py b/tests/test_oauth.py
@@ -0,0 +1,68 @@
+from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlsplit
+
+from app.services.google_oauth import GoogleOAuthClient, valid_redirect_uri
+
+
+def configure_google(app):
+    app.config.update({
+        "GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID": "client-id",
+        "GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET": "client-secret",
+        "GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI": "https://example.test/oauth/google/callback",
+    })
+
+
+def test_google_start_requires_configuration(client):
+    response = client.get("/oauth/google/start")
+    assert response.status_code == 302
+    assert "google_login=unconfigured" in response.headers["Location"]
+
+
+def test_google_start_uses_state_nonce_and_pkce(app):
+    configure_google(app)
+    with app.test_client() as client:
+        response = client.get("/oauth/google/start")
+        assert response.status_code == 302
+        query = parse_qs(urlsplit(response.headers["Location"]).query)
+        assert query["client_id"] == ["client-id"]
+        assert query["code_challenge_method"] == ["S256"]
+        assert len(query["state"][0]) >= 32
+        assert len(query["nonce"][0]) >= 32
+        assert len(query["code_challenge"][0]) == 43
+        with client.session_transaction() as session:
+            flow = session["google_oauth"]
+        assert flow["state"] == query["state"][0]
+        assert flow["nonce"] == query["nonce"][0]
+
+
+def test_google_callback_uses_fake_verified_claims(app, monkeypatch):
+    configure_google(app)
+    claims = {"sub": "google-sub", "email": "ana@example.test", "name": "Ana"}
+    monkeypatch.setattr(GoogleOAuthClient, "exchange_code", lambda self, code, verifier, nonce: claims)
+    with app.test_client() as client:
+        start = client.get("/oauth/google/start")
+        query = parse_qs(urlsplit(start.headers["Location"]).query)
+        callback = client.get(f"/oauth/google/callback?state={query['state'][0]}&code=fake-code")
+        assert callback.status_code == 302
+        assert callback.headers["Location"].endswith("/account")
+        with client.session_transaction() as session:
+            assert session["account_id"]
+            assert session["csrf_token"]
+
+
+def test_google_redirect_validation_rejects_external_http_and_query_strings():
+    assert valid_redirect_uri("https://example.test/oauth/google/callback")
+    assert valid_redirect_uri("http://localhost:5000/oauth/google/callback")
+    assert not valid_redirect_uri("http://example.test/oauth/google/callback")
+    assert not valid_redirect_uri("https://example.test/oauth/google/callback?next=/")
+    assert not valid_redirect_uri("https://example.test/other")
+
+
+def test_google_callback_rejects_state_mismatch(app):
+    configure_google(app)
+    with app.test_client() as client:
+        client.get("/oauth/google/start")
+        response = client.get("/oauth/google/callback?state=wrong&code=fake-code")
+        assert response.status_code == 302
+        assert "google_login=failed" in response.headers["Location"]
+        with client.session_transaction() as session:
+            assert "google_oauth" not in session

+import json
+
+
+def login(client):
+    response = client.post("/auth/dev-login", data={"email": "ana@example.test", "name": "Ana"})
+    assert response.status_code == 302
+    accepted = client.post("/account/settings/terms", data={"csrf_token": csrf(client), "accept": "on"})
+    assert accepted.status_code == 302
+    return response
+
+
+def csrf(client):
+    with client.session_transaction() as session:
+        return session["csrf_token"]
+
+
+def test_login_create_and_open_case(client):

+    response = client.post("/projects", data={"csrf_token": csrf(client), "project_type": "case"})

+    editor = client.get(response.headers["Location"])
+    assert editor.status_code == 200
+    body = editor.get_data(as_text=True)
+    assert "Linha do Tempo dos Fatos" not in body
+    assert "Argumentação da tese A" in body
+    assert "Argumentação da tese B" in body
+    assert "Debate em grupo" in body
+    assert "Dissertação" in body

+
+def test_editor_uses_sources_from_personal_library(client):

+    editor = client.get(response.headers["Location"])
+    body = editor.get_data(as_text=True)
+    assert "Fonte do Case" in body
+    assert 'data-fact-sources' not in body
+    assert 'data-project-source' in body
+
+
+def test_editor_can_create_source_without_opening_library(client):
+    login(client)
+    created = client.post("/projects", data={"csrf_token": csrf(client), "project_type": "case"})
+    project_id = created.headers["Location"].rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
+    response = client.post(
+        f"/projects/{project_id}/sources",
+        headers={"X-CSRF-Token": csrf(client)},
+        json={"title": "Fonte inline", "author": "Autoria", "kind": "book", "notes": "Fichamento curto"},
+    )

+    source = response.get_json()["source"]

+    saved = client.post(
+        f"/projects/{project_id}/save",
+        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", "X-CSRF-Token": csrf(client)},
+        json={"revision": 1, "payload": {"fields": {}, "source_ids": [source["id"]]}},
+    )
+    assert saved.status_code == 200
+    assert "Fonte inline" in client.get(f"/projects/{project_id}").get_data(as_text=True)
+
+
+def test_save_rejects_stale_revision(client):
+    login(client)
+    created = client.post("/projects", data={"csrf_token": csrf(client), "project_type": "case"})
+    project_url = created.headers["Location"]
+    project_id = project_url.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
+    payload = {"version": 1, "fields": {"title": "Case inicial"}}
+    headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json", "X-CSRF-Token": csrf(client)}
+    first = client.post(f"/projects/{project_id}/save", headers=headers, data=json.dumps({"revision": 1, "payload": payload}))
+    assert first.status_code == 200
+    stale = client.post(f"/projects/{project_id}/save", headers=headers, data=json.dumps({"revision": 1, "payload": payload}))
+    assert stale.status_code == 409
+    assert stale.get_json()["error"] == "project_conflict"

+

+def test_project_sources_and_criteria_are_saved_with_ownership_filter(client):

+def test_project_creation_redirects_unaccepted_account_to_terms(client):

+    )
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    body = client.get(f"/projects/{project_id}").get_data(as_text=True)

+
+def test_account_shows_schedule_calendar_and_completed_tasks(client):
+    login(client)
+    created = client.post("/projects", data={"csrf_token": csrf(client), "project_type": "case"})
+    project_id = created.headers["Location"].rsplit("/", 1)[-1]

+        f"/projects/{project_id}/save",
+        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", "X-CSRF-Token": csrf(client)},
+        json={"revision": 1, "payload": {"fields": {}, "schedule": {"report_date": "2099-10-30", "tasks": [{"id": "task-1", "title": "Conferir fontes", "date": "2099-10-29", "done": True}]}}},
+    )
+    assert saved.status_code == 200

+
+def test_delete_project_requires_csrf_and_removes_owned_project(client):
+    login(client)
+    created = client.post("/projects", data={"csrf_token": csrf(client), "project_type": "case"})

+    from app.store.db import get_db

+def test_delete_unknown_project_returns_not_found(client):

diff --git a/tests/test_providers.py b/tests/test_providers.py
@@ -0,0 +1,55 @@
+import json
+
+import pytest
+
+from app.services.providers import DeepSeekClient, JevClient, ProviderError, load_secret
+
+
+class FakeResponse:
+    def __init__(self, payload):
+        self.payload = json.dumps(payload).encode()
+
+    def __enter__(self):
+        return self
+
+    def __exit__(self, *_):
+        return None
+
+    def read(self, _limit):
+        return self.payload
+
+
+def fake_opener(payload):
+    def opener(request, timeout):
+        assert request.get_method() == "POST"
+        assert request.headers["Authorization"] == "Bearer secret"
+        assert timeout == 30
+        return FakeResponse(payload)
+    return opener
+
+
+def test_deepseek_client_parses_structured_json_without_network():
+    client = DeepSeekClient("secret", opener=fake_opener({"model": "deepseek-chat", "choices": [{"message": {"content": '{"answer":"ok"}'}}], "usage": {"prompt_tokens": 1}}))
+    result = client.complete_json([{"role": "user", "content": "teste"}])
+    assert result["result"] == {"answer": "ok"}
+
+
+def test_jev_client_preserves_structured_answers():
+    client = JevClient("secret", opener=fake_opener({"model": "jev-latest", "answers": {"q1": {"score": 2}}, "usage": {"input_tokens": 1}}), timeout=30)
+    result = client.score({"text": "teste"}, {"q1": {"type": "score"}})
+    assert result["answers"]["q1"]["score"] == 2
+
+
+def test_provider_rejects_invalid_json_content():
+    client = DeepSeekClient("secret", opener=fake_opener({"choices": [{"message": {"content": "não-json"}}]}))
+    with pytest.raises(ProviderError) as error:
+        client.complete_json([])
+    assert error.value.code == "invalid_response"
+
+
+def test_secret_file_is_loaded_without_printing_value(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    secret_file = tmp_path / "key"
+    secret_file.write_text("file-secret\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    monkeypatch.delenv("TEST_SECRET", raising=False)
+    monkeypatch.setenv("TEST_SECRET_FILE", str(secret_file))
+    assert load_secret("TEST_SECRET", "TEST_SECRET_FILE") == "file-secret"

+import json

+            "DATABASE": str(tmp_path / "test.sqlite3"),
+            "ALLOW_DEV_AUTH": True,
+        }
+    )

+

+def test_demo_buttons_have_all_legacy_public_models_and_safe_payload(client):

+    model_ids = {model["id"] for model in data}

+    assert model_ids == {"civil-personality", "projeto-paper-modelo", "paper-final-modelo"}
+    for model_id in model_ids:

+    assert 'data-model-document="civil-personality"' in html
+    assert 'data-model-workflow="projeto-paper-modelo"' in html
+    assert 'data-model-workflow="paper-final-modelo"' in html
+    assert "public-demo-dialog" in html
+    assert len(next(model for model in data if model["id"] == "civil-personality")["sections"]) >= 5
+    assert "ADPF 130/DF" in html

+    assert "data-public-model-step" in Path("static/js/app.js").read_text(encoding="utf-8")

+
+def test_filled_models_keep_their_original_workflow(client):

@@ -0,0 +1,68 @@
+from datetime import date
+
+from app.domain.schedule import account_calendar, normalize_schedule, schedule_deadlines
+
+
+def test_schedule_normalizes_dates_and_discards_invalid_tasks():
+    result = normalize_schedule({"report_date": "2026-10-30", "debate_date": "bad", "tasks": [{"title": "Ler", "date": "2026-11-01"}, {"title": "Inválida", "date": "x"}]})
+    assert result["report_date"] == "2026-10-30"
+    assert result["debate_date"] == ""
+    assert len(result["tasks"]) == 1
+
+
+def test_schedule_is_empty_for_unknown_payload():
+    assert normalize_schedule({"report_date": "30/10/2026"})["tasks"] == []
+
+
+def test_paper_schedule_keeps_project_and_final_dates_and_task_state():
+    result = normalize_schedule(
+        {
+            "deliveryDate": "30/10/2026",
+            "finalDate": "2026-11-30",
+            "tasks": [{"id": "t1", "title": "Revisar", "date": "2026-10-29", "done": True, "templateKey": "paper-review"}],
+        },
+        project_type="paper_project",
+    )
+    assert result["report_date"] == "2026-10-30"
+    assert result["final_date"] == "2026-11-30"
+    assert result["tasks"][0]["done"] is True
+    assert result["tasks"][0]["template_key"] == "paper-review"
+    assert [item["label"] for item in schedule_deadlines(result, "paper_project", "p1", "Paper")] == ["Projeto de Paper", "Paper Final"]
+
+
+def test_account_calendar_groups_dates_and_upcoming_entries():
+    projects = [{
+        "deadlines": schedule_deadlines(
+            {"report_date": "2026-10-30", "final_date": "2026-11-30"},
+            "paper_project",
+            "p1",
+            "Pesquisa",
+        )
+    }]
+    result = account_calendar(projects, date(2026, 10, 26))
+    assert result["has_dates"] is True
+    assert result["month_label"] == "outubro de 2026"
+    assert result["upcoming"][0]["label"] == "Projeto de Paper"
+    assert any(cell.get("entries") for cell in result["cells"] if cell)
+
+    future_only = account_calendar(
+        [{"deadlines": schedule_deadlines({"final_date": "2026-11-30"}, "paper_final", "p1", "Pesquisa")}],
+        date(2026, 10, 26),
+    )
+    assert future_only["has_dates"] is True
+    assert future_only["month_has_dates"] is False
+
+
+def test_account_calendar_heatmap_uses_edit_counts_not_planned_dates():
+    result = account_calendar(
+        [],
+        [{"date": "2026-10-26", "count": 1}, {"date": "2026-10-27", "count": 7}],
+        date(2026, 10, 27),
+    )
+    cells = {cell["number"]: cell for cell in result["cells"] if cell}
+    assert result["has_dates"] is False
+    assert result["has_activity"] is True
+    assert cells[26]["edit_count"] == 1
+    assert cells[26]["edit_level"] == 1
+    assert cells[27]["edit_count"] == 7
+    assert cells[27]["edit_level"] == 4
diff --git a/tests/test_sharing.py b/tests/test_sharing.py
@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+
+def csrf(client):
+    with client.session_transaction() as session:
+        return session["csrf_token"]
+
+
+def login(client, email):
+    client.post("/auth/dev-login", data={"email": email, "name": email.split("@")[0]})
+    return csrf(client)
+
+
+def accept_terms(client, token):
+    client.post("/account/settings/terms", data={"csrf_token": token, "accept": "on"})
+
+
+def test_owner_can_share_and_admin_can_comment_without_editing_text(client):
+    owner_token = login(client, "owner@example.test")
+    accept_terms(client, owner_token)
+    created = client.post("/projects", data={"csrf_token": owner_token, "project_type": "case"})
+    project_id = created.headers["Location"].rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
+    shared = client.post(f"/projects/{project_id}/sharing", data={"csrf_token": owner_token, "allow_admin_view": "on", "allow_admin_comments": "on"})
+    assert shared.status_code == 302
+    client.application.config["ADMIN_EMAILS"] = {"admin@example.test"}
+    admin_token = login(client, "admin@example.test")
+    accept_terms(client, admin_token)
+    listing = client.get("/admin/projects")
+    assert listing.status_code == 200
+    assert project_id in listing.get_data(as_text=True)
+    detail = client.get(f"/admin/projects/{project_id}")
+    assert detail.status_code == 200
+    comment = client.post(f"/admin/projects/{project_id}/comments", data={"csrf_token": admin_token, "body": "Confira a fundamentação."})
+    assert comment.status_code == 302
+    owner_token = login(client, "owner@example.test")
+    editor = client.get(f"/projects/{project_id}")
+    assert "Confira a fundamentação." in editor.get_data(as_text=True)
+
+
+def test_non_admin_cannot_list_shared_projects(client):
+    token = login(client, "student@example.test")
+    accept_terms(client, token)
+    assert client.get("/admin/projects").status_code == 403
diff --git a/tests/test_smoke.py b/tests/test_smoke.py
@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+def test_healthcheck(client):

+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.get_json() == {"status": "ok", "service": "assistente-academico"}
+

+def test_public_shell_is_server_rendered(client):

+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    body = response.get_data(as_text=True)
+    assert "Case e Paper, em um só lugar." in body
+    assert "Seus projetos são privados por padrão." in body
+
+
+def test_database_starts_without_legacy_tables(app):
+    from app.store.db import get_db
+
+    with app.app_context():
+        names = {row[0] for row in get_db().execute(
+            "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'"
+        )}
+    # Core tables plus new tables from v12 migration
+    expected_tables = {
+        "app_meta",
+        "accounts",
+        "projects",
+        "sources",
+        "project_sharing",
+        "project_comments",
+        "ai_usage_reservations",
+        "provider_usage",
+        "project_edit_days",
+        "sqlite_sequence",
+        # New tables from v12 migration
+        "project_revisions",
+        "deletion_requests",
+        "notification_outbox",
+        "account_grants",
+    }
+    assert names == expected_tables
+    assert not any("legacy" in name.lower() for name in names)
diff --git a/tests/test_workflow_parity.py b/tests/test_workflow_parity.py
@@ -0,0 +1,95 @@
+from app.store.db import get_db
+
+
+def start(client, kind="case"):
+    client.post("/auth/dev-login", data={"email": "roteiro@example.test", "name": "Roteiro"})
+    with client.session_transaction() as session:
+        token = session["csrf_token"]
+        account_id = session["account_id"]
+    client.post("/account/settings/terms", data={"csrf_token": token, "accept": "on"})
+    created = client.post("/projects", data={"csrf_token": token, "project_type": kind})
+    return created.headers["Location"], token, account_id
+
+
+def test_case_restores_single_panel_and_all_original_phases(client):
+    url, _, _ = start(client)
+    body = client.get(url).get_data(as_text=True)
+    assert body.count('data-stage="') == 11
+    assert 'class="workspace"' in body
+    assert 'data-previous-step' in body and 'data-next-step' in body
+    assert 'data-stage="thesis_a"' in body and 'data-stage="thesis_b"' in body
+    assert 'data-stage="dissertation"' in body
+    assert 'data-stage="dissertation_development"' not in body
+    assert 'data-stage="description"' in body and 'hidden' in body
+    assert 'data-case-field="thesis_a"' in body
+    assert 'data-workflow-check="facts-original"' in body
+    assert 'data-fact' not in body
+    assert 'timeline' not in body
+
+
+def test_save_keeps_theses_checks_and_discards_timeline(client):
+    url, token, account_id = start(client)
+    response = client.post(url + "/save", headers={"X-CSRF-Token": token}, json={"revision": 1, "payload": {"fields": {"thesis_a": "Tese A", "thesis_b": "Tese B"}, "checks": {"facts-original": True, "unknown": True}, "timeline": [{"fact": "Excluir"}], "development_sections": [{"title": "Fundamento", "body": "Texto"}]}})
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    from app.store.projects import get_project
+    with client.application.app_context():
+        project = get_project(account_id, url.rsplit("/", 1)[-1])
+    assert project["fields"]["thesis_a"] == "Tese A"
+    assert project["checks"] == {"facts-original": True}
+    assert project["development_sections"][0]["body"] == "Texto"
+    assert "timeline" not in project
+
+
+def test_paper_mode_preserves_research_planning_and_identity(client):
+    url, token, account_id = start(client, "paper_project")
+    headers = {"X-CSRF-Token": token}
+    saved = client.post(url + "/save", headers=headers, json={"revision": 1, "payload": {"fields": {"title": "Paper", "hypothesis": "Hipótese original"}}})
+    revision = saved.get_json()["revision"]
+    switched = client.post(url + "/paper-mode", headers=headers, json={"revision": revision, "project_type": "paper_final"})
+    assert switched.status_code == 200
+    revision = switched.get_json()["revision"]
+    page = client.get(url).get_data(as_text=True)
+    assert 'data-stage="paper_final_introduction"' in page
+    assert 'Consultar Projeto de Paper' in page
+    saved = client.post(url + "/save", headers=headers, json={"revision": revision, "payload": {"fields": {"abstract": "Resumo"}}})
+    assert saved.status_code == 200
+    from app.store.projects import get_project
+    with client.application.app_context():
+        project = get_project(account_id, url.rsplit("/", 1)[-1])
+    assert project["fields"]["hypothesis"] == "Hipótese original"
+    assert project["fields"]["abstract"] == "Resumo"
+    assert client.post(url + "/paper-mode", headers=headers, json={"revision": revision, "project_type": "paper_project"}).status_code == 409
+
+
+def test_profile_does_not_collect_automatic_messaging_contact(client):
+    _, token, account_id = start(client)
+    accepted = client.post("/account/settings/terms", data={"csrf_token": token, "accept": "on", "whatsapp_phone": "5598981417363", "whatsapp_opt_in": "on"})
+    assert accepted.status_code == 302
+    page = client.get("/account/settings").get_data(as_text=True)
+    assert "whatsapp_phone" not in page
+    with client.application.app_context():
+        columns = {row["name"] for row in get_db().execute("PRAGMA table_info(accounts)")}
+    assert not columns.intersection({"whatsapp_phone", "whatsapp_opt_in", "whatsapp_opt_in_at", "whatsapp_opt_out_at"})
+
+
+def test_blocked_account_cannot_continue_existing_session(client):
+    _, _, account_id = start(client)
+    with client.application.app_context():
+        db = get_db()
+        db.execute("UPDATE accounts SET is_blocked = 1 WHERE id = ?", (account_id,))
+        db.commit()
+    assert client.get('/account').status_code == 403
+    with client.session_transaction() as session:
+        assert 'account_id' not in session
+    assert client.post('/auth/dev-login', data={'email': 'roteiro@example.test'}).status_code == 403
+
+
+def test_export_separates_report_and_dissertation(client):
+    url, token, _ = start(client)
+    client.post(url+'/save', headers={'X-CSRF-Token': token}, json={'revision': 1, 'payload': {'fields': {'facts': 'Narrativa do relatório', 'dissertation_intro': 'Introdução individual', 'dissertation_conclusion': 'Conclusão individual'}, 'development_sections': [{'id': 'topic-1', 'title': 'Fundamentação', 'body': 'Desenvolvimento individual'}]}})
+    report = client.get(url+'/export?phase=report').get_data(as_text=True)
+    dissertation = client.get(url+'/export?phase=dissertation').get_data(as_text=True)
+    assert 'Narrativa do relatório' in report and 'Introdução individual' not in report
+    assert 'Introdução individual' in dissertation and 'Narrativa do relatório' not in dissertation
+    assert dissertation.index('Introdução individual') < dissertation.index('Desenvolvimento individual') < dissertation.index('Conclusão individual')
+    assert client.get(url+'/export?phase=unrecognized').status_code == 400
